title: Junior Algorithm Development Intern
description:
What if your internship project could influence how genomic variants are detected in a real clinical technology?

At SOPHiA GENETICS, we are building the future of AI-assisted, data-driven medicine. Our technology helps healthcare professionals make sense of complex multimodal data, with the ambition of improving outcomes for patients with cancer and rare diseases.

Behind that mission are some difficult scientific and computational questions.

One of them is this: how do we make sure our algorithms identify complex genomic variants as accurately and efficiently as possible?

That is where you come in.

Join our Data Science – Algorithm Development team in Rolle, Switzerland, for a six-month internship as a Junior Algorithm Developer.

You will work on a real challenge within our Whole Genome Sequencing (WGS) product: benchmarking our in-house structural variant (SV) calling solutions against leading external tools for germline variant calling.

The evidence you generate will help our team understand where different approaches perform well, where they do not, and ultimately inform decisions about how our WGS technology should evolve.

You will get hands-on with genomic data, algorithms and production-scale computational infrastructure.

You will:

  • Build the benchmark. Install and run external WGS variant-calling pipelines on SOPHiA GENETICS' compute infrastructure and create a reproducible setup for comparison.
  • Put the tools to the test. Evaluate germline variant-calling accuracy and runtime using our data and reference sets.
  • Go beyond "which tool is better?" Compare external approaches with our in-house SV calling solutions and investigate where each performs differently — and why.
  • Turn data into decisions. Translate your results into evidence-based recommendations that can help improve the strategy, design, implementation and performance of SV calling within our WGS germline products.
  • Make your work visible. Present your findings to colleagues across the team and department, including senior management.

Requirements

You might be studying bioinformatics, computational biology, computer science, statistics or a related field. You do not need to arrive knowing everything about structural variant calling - we care just as much about how you think and how quickly you learn.

You will probably enjoy this internship if:

  • You like digging into data and asking "why?", rather than stopping when you have a result.
  • Statistics and probability make sense to you, and you enjoy using them to solve real problems.
  • You are comfortable working with the UNIX command line and have some experience analysing larger datasets.
  • You have experience with Python or statistical libraries - or are motivated to deepen it.
  • You are curious about genomics; knowledge of structural variant calling, WGS or VCF is a plus rather than a prerequisite.
  • You have a scientist's mindset: you are willing to ask questions that may sound naïve, test assumptions, and report what the data actually shows, even when the answer is not the one you expected.
  • You communicate and collaborate well with others and are comfortable working in English.

Benefits

Six months from now, we want you to leave knowing considerably more than when you arrived.

You will learn how an end-to-end NGS data-analysis workflow is built and used in an industrial setting, develop a deeper understanding of state-of-the-art structural variant calling tools and algorithms, and gain practical experience designing a rigorous benchmarking study.

More importantly, you will see how scientific evidence becomes a product decision.

You'll work in an environment where genomics, data science, AI and cloud technologies come together, alongside people solving these problems every day.

Company-wide events and activities - take part in company events, Town Halls, internal initiatives and social activities alongside the rest of our employees.

All our internships and apprenticeships are paid, with compensation aligned with local market practices and standards.

Location: Rolle, Switzerland

Start: As soon as possible

Contract type: Internship contract, full time, 6 months.

Apply with your CV and any supporting information you'd like us to consider.

Selected candidates will meet members of our Talent Management Coordinator, the hiring leader and relevant colleagues and stakeholders during the interview process.

English is our primary working language, so please submit your CV in English.

title: Modeling & Simulation Analyst
description:
Job Type:

Term (Fixed Term)

Position Description

Are you passionate about using your modeling and simulation skills to address critical policy challenges? RAND is seeking talented analysts with expertise in modeling and simulation to join our team and contribute to impactful research in national security policy.

RAND analysts contribute to and lead innovative projects that deliver objective, reliable insights for the public and policymakers at multiple levels. They embrace diverse challenges on topics ranging from space vehicles to surface warfare that require strong analytic capabilities, technical knowledge, and academic or industry experience in modeling and simulation, mathematics, data science, and other applied sciences.

Why RAND?

· Reputation for Excellence: Be part of a non-profit, non-partisan organization renowned for its rigorous and objective research.

· Dynamic Opportunities: Collaborate in multidisciplinary teams on diverse projects that challenge and expand your skills.

· Poised for Impact: Your analysis will inform thousands of policymakers, clients, and other stakeholders around the world.

Responsibilities:

Technical Analysts use their skills in science, technology, engineering, and mathematics to:

  • Develop, apply, and analyze the outputs of modeling and simulation tools to examine complex systems, assess alternatives, evaluate risks and tradeoffs, and inform decision-making.

  • Develop understanding of national and homeland security operations and apply that knowledge to structure and design models and validate outputs.

  • Assist in communicating the results of these analyses to decision-makers through written products, briefings, visualizations, and other media.

Term:

This position is a 3-year term position with the possibility of renewal.

Qualifications

Expertise in one or more of the listed methodological areas AND one or more of the domain areas is highly desired:

  • Methodological Areas

    • Modeling, simulation, and analysis of complex systems, especially using the Advanced Framework for Simulation and Modeling (AFSIM)

    • Programming and model development using Python, R, MATLAB, Julia, C++, Java, or similar languages and tools

    • Agent-based, discrete-event, Monte Carlo, system-dynamics, or other computational modeling approaches

  • Domain Areas:

    • Space systems, aerospace systems, autonomous systems, or other defense-related technical domains

    • Logistics, supply chains, readiness, force planning, transportation, or operational analysis

    • Systems engineering, requirements analysis, test and evaluation, or technology assessment

    • Data visualization, dashboard development, or communication of complex analytic findings

All analyst positions at RAND require excellent analytic skills; the ability to communicate clearly and effectively in English, both orally and in writing; the ability to work effectively as a member of a multi-disciplinary team; and a strong commitment to RAND's core values of quality and objectivity. Experience with components of the Department of War is highly desired.

Successful applicants will demonstrate experience or strong potential in modeling and simulation, including the development, use, validation, and interpretation of models to address complex technical, operational, or policy problems.

Education Requirements

A master’s degree (or bachelor’s degree with at least five years of relevant professional analytic experience) in engineering, operations research, applied mathematics, physical sciences, computer science, data science, or related field is required. With a master's degree, at least two years relevant professional experience is preferred. This experience should demonstrate the applicant’s ability to develop, apply, analyze, or communicate the results of quantitative models, simulations, data analyses, or other analytically rigorous research products.

Security Clearance

Candidates must be able to obtain and maintain a U.S. security clearance. Please note that U.S. citizenship is required to obtain and maintain a government security clearance. Candidates with an active U.S. security clearance are preferred.

Location

Washington, DC; Santa Monica, CA; Pittsburgh PA

Writing Sample Required

Successful applications will include documentation in the application package of academic and professional activities that meet stated qualifications. A writing sample is required for this position. This sample can use a recent, previously written paper or report (e.g., journal article, master’s thesis, or paper written for coursework, prior employment, or internship). Applicants with fields of study or work experience in which they have not produced written products (e.g., model development), or in which written products have dissemination restrictions, may submit a short written summary (i.e., less than one page) of one or more recent products they have developed. Applicants are encouraged to describe their specific role, the analytic or modeling methods used, and the product’s purpose or impact, as appropriate

ABOUT THE ROLE

Script Assist is hiring a Full-Stack Engineer with strong production experience in Node.js, TypeScript and React to build and evolve a complex multi-tenant B2B SaaS platform used by UK clinics, pharmacies and operational teams.

We are looking for engineers with approximately 3–5 years of professional experience who have worked inside a real shared SaaS product — not just simple CRUD applications or separate bespoke projects for individual clients.

This is an AI-first engineering environment. We expect engineers to use modern AI coding agents throughout the development lifecycle — from understanding unfamiliar code and planning changes to implementation, testing, debugging and reviewing results.

AI should accelerate your work, while you remain responsible for ensuring that the software is correct, safe and maintainable.

ABOUT SCRIPT ASSIST

Script Assist is a UK healthcare technology company building software and operational infrastructure for complex private clinical and pharmacy services.

Our platform:

• Supports tens of thousands of recurring subscriptions each month alongside high-volume clinical and pharmacy workflows.

• Supports multiple medications, treatment pathways, clinics, pharmacies, prescribers, patients and operational teams within one shared platform.

• Covers prescribing, patient onboarding, medication workflows, dispensing, inventory, subscriptions, payments, fulfilment, communications, reporting, permissions and external integrations.

• Supports different organisational configurations and workflows while keeping the underlying product reliable, secure and maintainable.

This is not a prototype or a simple dashboard product. Features interact with permissions, tenant configuration, existing workflows, integrations and production data.

Healthcare experience is not required. Experience building genuinely complex software is.

WHAT YOU WILL BUILD

• Backend services and business logic using Node.js, NestJS and TypeScript.

• React and TypeScript interfaces used by real operational teams.

• Multi-tenant features with correct tenant isolation and tenant-specific configuration.

• Stateful workflows involving multiple stages, roles, permissions and exception paths.

• REST APIs, third-party integrations, webhooks and asynchronous/background processing.

• Reliable product behaviour around retries, validation, edge cases and partial failures.

• Features across subscriptions, payments, pharmacy operations, inventory, fulfilment and clinical workflows.

• Automated tests and observability that make production changes safer.

MULTI-TENANT SAAS EXPERIENCE

Multi-tenant SaaS experience is a core requirement for this role.

We are looking for candidates who have actually developed a production product used by multiple customer organisations.

You should have experience with:

• A shared product and codebase used by multiple tenants/customers.

• Tenant-aware data access or isolation.

• Different permissions, roles, configurations or feature access between tenants.

• Customer-specific behaviour without creating a completely separate product for every client.

• Several interconnected modules, workflows or integrations.

• Production releases where changes needed to remain compatible with existing customers.

Important: Working on multiple separate client projects does not automatically mean you have multi-tenant SaaS experience. We will ask you to explain how tenancy worked in the product you built.

AI-FIRST ENGINEERING

We are looking for engineers whose development workflow has materially changed because of AI.

AI should be a regular implementation tool, not something used only occasionally to explain an error.

You will use AI to:

• Understand – Inspect unfamiliar modules, trace code paths and understand existing patterns.

• Plan – Break requirements into implementation steps, identify dependencies and consider edge cases.

• Implement – Generate substantial implementation work rather than manually typing routine code.

• Test – Create and extend unit, integration and edge-case test coverage.

• Debug – Analyse errors, logs, failing tests and unfamiliar execution paths.

• Verify – Review diffs, run tests and validate behaviour yourself.

AI output is never accepted blindly. You remain accountable for the quality, correctness and maintainability of your work.

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

• 3–5 years of professional software engineering experience.

• 2+ years of hands-on production Node.js development.

• 2+ years of production React / React.js development.

• 2+ years of production TypeScript development.

• Real experience building a multi-tenant SaaS product.

• Strong understanding of backend business logic, APIs, databases and production debugging.

• Experience owning features end-to-end rather than only implementing small isolated tickets.

• Clear written and spoken English.

• Strong AI-assisted engineering experience across planning, implementation, testing and debugging.

NICE TO HAVE

• NestJS, Express or Fastify.

• PostgreSQL, MongoDB or another production database.

• Redis, queues, background jobs or event-driven processing.

• REST APIs, GraphQL, webhooks and third-party integrations.

• Docker, CI/CD and cloud environments.

• RBAC, permissions, feature flags and tenant configuration.

• Testing, logging, monitoring and production incident investigation.

We do not require experience with one particular cloud, database or queue technology. We care more about the quality and complexity of the systems you have actually built.

WHY JOIN SCRIPT ASSIST?

• Build on a live multi-tenant SaaS platform where your work reaches real customers quickly.

• Work across backend and frontend rather than being confined to one narrow subsystem.

• Take meaningful end-to-end ownership of features and workflows.

• Work in an AI-first engineering environment focused on leverage and delivery quality.

• Solve complex operational problems involving integrations, state, permissions and customer variation.

• Join a growing international product team with opportunities to take on greater ownership as the platform scales.

If you have built and shipped complex, production-grade multi-tenant SaaS products using Node.js, TypeScript and React, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Senior Research Associate
description:
Job Title

Senior Research Associate

Agency

Texas A&M University

Department

Construction Science

Proposed Minimum Salary

$40.00 hourly

Job Location

College Station, Texas

Job Type

Temporary/Casual Staff (Fixed Term)

Job Description

What We Want

The Senior Research Associate for the Construction Science Department assists research teams with performing site investigations, collecting field data, and providing inspection training guidance. This person will coordinate with contractors and project owners to visit civil construction sites to collect images, videos, test reports, and other necessary information to develop training materials. In addition to coordination, this person will help students and researchers travel to sites, safely enter and exit sites, and identify necessary construction elements for data collection. Finally, this person will assist with construction material procurement and testing if necessary.

Responsibilities

Collect and perform civil construction material testing

  • Obtain civil construction materials for testing.

  • Perform necessary lab tests on construction materials.

  • Teach research students how to perform the necessary tests.

  • Assist students and research teams performing work on civil construction projects or with civil construction materials.

Visits civil construction sites

  • Secures a travel vehicle to take research team members to construction sites.

  • Coordinates with research team members schedules to visit construction sites.

  • Safely takes research team members to and from construction sites.

  • Help research team members gather data, videos, images, etc. while on site.

Coordinates with project representatives for field sites

  • Contact construction project representatives to coordinate site visits and explain the scope of the research work.

  • Establish an expected date for the site visit and understand all visit protocols.

Identify Civil Construction Sites and Active Construction for Training Development

  • Reviews civil construction plan sets and pays estimates to determine the scope of work, and which activities are currently active.

  • Identify the location of each potential project, the owner, and prime contractor, and find contact information.

  • Presents potential projects to the research group to identify field visits.

Review training material for accuracy and practicality

  • Review the training materials produced by the research team for field accuracy and practicality.

What You Need To Know

Salary: $40/hour.

Cover Letter/Resume: A cover letter and resume will assist us in our review of your application materials. You may upload them on the application under the CV/Resume section.

Other Details: This is a part-time temporary/casual position not to go past 4.5 months.

Qualifications

Required Education and Experience:

  • Bachelor’s degree in construction, engineering, or an engineering related field OR an equivalent combination of education and experience.

  • 4 years of construction materials inspection and testing or civil construction experience.

Preferred Qualifications

  • 15 years of construction materials inspection and testing or civil construction experience.

  • 2 years of experience as a construction inspector on civil construction projects.

  • 5 years of experience working in the research field (this experience can occur concurrently with the 15 years of experience in the field).

  • 5 years of experience working with undergraduate and/or graduate students.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:

  • Ability to positively and professionally interact with clients and staff.

  • Working knowledge of office software and instructional programs.

  • Ability to multitask and work cooperatively with others.

Who We Are

Established in 1946, the Texas A&M University Department of Construction Science has led the way in excellence of construction in higher education. As part of Texas A&M College of Architecture both graduate and undergraduate programs were among the first in the nation to be accredited by the American Council for Construction Education (ACCE). With approximately 1,400 undergraduate and 200 graduate students, our department continues to lead the way as one of finest programs of construction education in the nation. We challenge our students, staff and faculty to maintain such standards and we are delighted to have those join us, who can help us in our pursuits. Learn more about us by visiting our website at .

Our Commitment

Texas A&M University is committed to enriching the learning and working environment by promoting a culture that respects all perspectives, talents & lived experiences. Embracing varying opinions and perspectives strengthens our core values which are: Respect, Excellence, Leadership, Loyalty, Integrity, and Selfless Service.

Instructions to Applicants: Applications received by Texas A&M University must either have all job application data entered or a resume attached. Failure to provide all job application data or a complete resume could result in an invalid submission and a rejected application. We encourage all applicants to upload a resume’ or use a LinkedIn profile to pre-populate the online application.

All positions are security-sensitive. Applicants are subject to a criminal history investigation, and employment is contingent upon the institution’s verification of credentials and/or other information required by the institution’s procedures, including the completion of the criminal history check.

Never short of ambition, the success of our business is delivered through the diverse and talented team of over 1,800 global colleagues.

Purpose of the job

The Lead Data Analytics Engineer is a senior technical leadership role responsible for advancing Enterprise Data Modelling, Analytics Automation and Engineering Empowerment across Global Analytics.

Working directly with the Head of Analytics Engineering, the role translates the Analytics Engineering strategy into technical direction, reusable capabilities and modern engineering practices. The role enables squads to independently deliver trusted, scalable Data Products while maintaining enterprise consistency and engineering excellence.

Key Responsibilities:

1. Enterprise Data Modelling

• Lead the enterprise approach to analytical data modelling, including domain models, dimensional models and semantic layers.

• Establish reusable modelling patterns and common business entities that create consistency across Data Products.

• Reduce duplication and improve the performance, scalability and maintainability of analytical models.

• Provide technical leadership for complex and cross-domain modelling challenges.

2. Analytics Automation & AI

• Lead the Analytics Automation agenda, transforming how analytics is developed, tested, deployed, documented and monitored.

• Apply Snowflake Cortex, LLMs, intelligent agents and automation to improve engineering productivity and quality.

• Build reusable automation capabilities and accelerators rather than one-off solutions.

• Identify and industrialise emerging technologies that materially improve Analytics Engineering.

3. Engineering Empowerment

• Create frameworks, tools, templates and reusable components that enable squads to deliver independently and faster.

• Improve developer experience and simplify the journey from development to production.

• Remove recurring technical bottlenecks through self-service and reusable engineering capabilities.

• Enable domain teams to build trusted Data Products within established engineering standards.

4. Technical Leadership & Modernisation

• Act as a senior technical authority for Analytics Engineering, providing direction on complex solutions and technical decisions.

• Drive engineering standards, modernisation, platform performance and reduction of technical debt.

• Mentor engineers and raise technical capability through communities of practice and knowledge sharing.

• Partner with the Head of Analytics Engineering to shape the technical roadmap and future engineering capability.

Key Technology Areas:

Snowflake • DBT • SQL • Python • Git/CI/CD • Semantic Layers • Data Contracts • Data Quality & Observability • Snowflake Cortex • LLMs & AI Agents • AWS

Skills & Experience:

Must Have

• Strong hands-on Analytics Engineering/Data Engineering experience with deep expertise in data modelling, Snowflake, dbt and SQL.

• Proven experience building automation, reusable engineering frameworks and scalable analytical architectures.

• Strong technical leadership experience, including influencing multiple teams, solving complex engineering challenges and mentoring senior engineers.

• Experience applying GenAI, LLMs, AI agents or Snowflake Cortex to engineering automation.

• A hands-on, outcome-driven engineering leader who leads from the front by designing, building, and delivering solutions. This role requires an individual contributor mindset, someone who is equally comfortable defining strategy and implementing it through working code, prototypes, and production-ready solutions.

Nice to Have

• Python and modern data observability/lineage experience.

• Experience enabling self-service engineering across distributed analytics teams.

Success Measures

• Data Modelling: Greater reuse and consistency of enterprise models with reduced duplication.

• Automation: Measurable reduction in manual engineering effort and improved delivery velocity.

• Empowerment: Squads increasingly able to independently build and operate trusted Data Products.

• Engineering Excellence: Improved reliability, performance, cost efficiency and overall engineering maturity.

• Technical Leadership: Recognised as the technical lead who drives delivery through hands-on contribution, accelerates engineering outcomes, and enables teams by building reusable capabilities rather than relying solely on governance or oversight.

• Innovation: Successful delivery and adoption of AI-powered engineering capabilities, automation frameworks, and modern engineering practices that create measurable business value.

title: Data Engineer
description:
Company Overview

Zenith Infotech (S) Pte Ltd, founded in 1997, provides expert IT professionals and solutions to enhance productivity for clients including large IT firms, consulting organizations, system integrators, government agencies, and MNCs.

Job Summary
We are looking for an experienced Data Engineer / Data Platform Engineer who can design, lead, and implement enterprise data warehouse, data lake, and data store solutions. You will be responsible for designing scalable data architectures and building data pipelines that consolidate, archive, integrate, and distribute data for analytics, reporting, and applications.

You will work closely with project teams, technical teams, and business stakeholders to translate evolving data requirements into robust and sustainable data solutions, while ensuring data quality, accessibility, security, and governance.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, lead, and implement data warehouse, data lake, and data store solutions to support enterprise data collection, integration, archival, analytics, and application requirements.
  • Define data architecture, data models, storage structures, and integration patterns aligned with business and technical requirements.
  • Design and develop the Domain Group Data Store as an authoritative source for data collection, consolidation, and distribution.
  • Build and manage data pipelines to replicate and consolidate data from national platforms, enterprise systems, and internal data sources into centralized data stores.
  • Develop ETL/ELT processes to transform, cleanse, validate, and integrate data for unified access and downstream consumption.
  • Enable secure and efficient sharing, enrichment, and distribution of data to support applications, analytics, reporting, and other data consumers.
  • Collaborate with project and application teams to understand data requirements and develop appropriate data integration and delivery solutions.
  • Engage stakeholders to identify new data requirements and translate them into scalable data models, pipelines, and storage solutions.
  • Establish and maintain data quality, integrity, availability, and performance across data platforms.
  • Contribute to data governance, security access control, metadata management, and data lifecycle management practices.
  • Lead technical discussions and provide guidance on data engineering architecture, technology selection, and implementation approaches.
  • Troubleshoot and optimize data pipelines, queries, storage, and processing workloads to ensure reliable and efficient data delivery.

Preferred Competencies and Qualifications

  • Degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related discipline.
  • Minimum 3 years of experience in data engineering, data warehousing, data lake, or data platform development.
  • Proven experience designing and implementing data warehouses, data lakes, or enterprise data stores, with at least one end-to-end data platform or data warehouse implementation.
  • Experience with ETL/ELT technologies and designing data pipelines for integrating data from multiple sources.
  • Strong understanding of data architecture, data modelling, data integration, data warehousing, and data lifecycle management.
  • Hands‑on experience with database technologies and data storage platforms, including relational and/or cloud-based data platforms.
  • Familiarity with data sharing, integration technologies, APIs, and enterprise data platforms.
  • Foundational knowledge of data security, access control, cybersecurity, and data governance.
  • Ability to lead technical design and implementation activities and work effectively with cross-functional teams.
  • Strong planning, coordination, stakeholder management, and communication skills.
  • Strong analytical and problem solving abilities, with the ability to work independently and take ownership of deliverables.

Key Technical Capabilities

Candidates should ideally demonstrate experience across several of the following areas:

  • Data Warehouse / Data Lake / Data Store Architecture
  • Data Modelling and Database Design
  • ETL / ELT Pipeline Development
  • Data Integration and Replication
  • SQL and Relational Databases
  • Cloud Data Platforms
  • Data Quality and Data Governance
  • API and Enterprise Data Integration
  • Data Security and Access Control
  • Performance Optimization and Data Operations

Other Information

PRIMARY PURPOSE: To coordinate customized temporary housing solutions for displaced policyholders in a fast-paced, service-driven environment. This role demands strong communication, research, negotiation, and multitasking skills to ensure insureds are matched with suitable like, kind, and quality accommodations. The Housing Coordinator serves as both a client advocate and housing specialist—blending empathetic support, strategic property research, and lease coordination to secure safe, comfortable, and comparable housing while delivering an elevated service experience with urgency and professionalism.


ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS and RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Support and promote Sedgwick’s mission, strategic vision, and value proposition to adjusters and policyholders.
  • Serve as a key point of contact for policyholders during their relocation, ensuring consistent communication, clear expectations, and empathetic support.
  • Qualify housing needs by gathering details about the insured’s lifestyle, household makeup, accessibility needs, pet considerations, and preferred amenities.
  • Conduct detailed market research using listing platforms, vendor databases, and internal tools to locate viable, like-kind-and-quality housing options.
  • Collaborate with corporate and independent housing vendors, landlords, and leasing agents to secure short-term rentals under time-sensitive circumstances.
  • Apply negotiation skills to secure favorable lease terms, maximize policy benefits, and stay within Additional Living Expense (ALE) guidelines.
  • Customize housing options that align with both policy coverage and the insured's expectations: balancing budget, availability, and quality. Maintain high touch service throughout the policyholder’s stay, proactively resolving issues and supporting lease extensions, furniture adjustments, and service needs.
  • Draft and review lease agreements and related documents with attention to detail and policy compliance.
  • Enter and maintain accurate data in housing databases, CRM tools, and internal platforms.
  • Stay informed of local rental trends, landlord regulations, and insurance housing best practices to advise clients and partners effectively.
  • Handle multiple claims and assignments at once with professionalism and urgency.
  • Serves as the point of contact for VIP clientele.

Two (2) years experience in leasing, real estate, customer service, or account management. Previous experience in insurance, temporary housing, corporate lodging, or real estate strongly preferred.

  • Exceptional verbal and written communication skills; capable of calming distressed clients with professionalism and compassion.
  • High emotional intelligence with the ability to adapt tone and approach to diverse client situations.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, Access) and adept at learning new housing and CRM platforms.
  • Advanced internet research capabilities to locate viable rental properties in limited markets.
  • Detail-oriented and organized with strong documentation habits.
  • Ability to multitask in a fast-paced environment with shifting priorities.
  • Negotiation and relationship management skills with vendors, property managers, and landlords.
  • Solutions-oriented mindset with a focus on timely, proactive service delivery.

title: Hiring: Senior Analytics Engineer
description:
Relay is fundamentally reshaping how goods move in an online era. Backed by Europe’s largest-ever logistics Series A ($35M), led by deep-tech investors Plural (whose portfolio spans fusion energy and space exploration), Relay is scaling faster than 99.98% of venture-backed startups. We're assembling the most talent-dense team the logistics industry has ever seen

Relay’s Mission is to free commerce from friction . Today, high delivery costs act as a hidden tax on e-commerce, quietly shaping what can be sold online and limiting who can participate. We envision a world where more goods move more freely between more people , making the online shopping experience seamless and accessible to everyone.

THE TEAM
• ~110 people , more than half in engineering, product and data
• 45+ advanced degrees across computer science, mathematics and operations research
• Thousands of data points captured, calculated, analysed and predicted for every single parcel we handle
• An intellectually vibrant culture of first‑principles thinking , tight feedback loops and relentless experimentation

The Opportunity

At Relay, we rely on data to guide how every parcel moves through our network — from when it enters the system to when it's delivered at the doorstep. Our data infrastructure is the backbone that powers everything from real-time operational decisions to strategic business insights to networks of autonomous AI agents.

We're looking for a Senior Analytics Engineer to sit within our Last Mile squad; our biggest and most data rich squad. Your role will help contribute to the success of the key agentic workflows that power our Last Mile marketplace.

You'll be joining at an exciting moment as we grow rapidly and expand our network across the UK.

Who Will Thrive in this role?

  • Design core data models - Partner with engineers and business leaders within the Last Mile squad to design and build foundational data models that power analytics, data science and AI workflows

  • Build the foundations for our key AI systems - Our Last Mile marketplace is becoming increasingly agentic, you will be a key owner of the inputs that power these systems

  • Drive data quality - Implement testing, monitoring, and alerting to ensure our data is accurate, timely, and trustworthy

  • Collaborate - Work with team members across the business to understand their data needs and deliver solutions

  • Shape our practices — Help define and evolve our analytics engineering processes and standards as we scale

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years of experience as an analytics engineer, data engineer, data analyst or similar role

  • Extensive experience with SQL , particularly with BigQuery and PostgreSQL

  • Demonstrated experience with dbt , with a track record of building and maintaining efficient, scalable, and reliable DAGs

  • Python proficiency for data manipulation, scripting, and automation

  • Experience with data visualisation tools such as Tableau, Looker, or similar

  • Experience in effective communication , particularly in gathering requirements and guiding non-technical stakeholders to the right data solutions

  • Familiarity with using AI tools to accelerate your workflow

Nice to Have:

  • Experience with orchestration tools like Dagster, Airflow, or similar

  • Experience building real-time or near-real-time data pipelines

  • Familiarity with machine learning workflows and feature engineering

  • Experience embedded in teams building customer facing products

  • Previous experience of learning and modelling an unfamiliar operational domain

  • A desire to see the real world impact of what you work on!

Compensation, Benefits & Workplace

  • Generous equity, richer than 99% of European startups , with annual top-ups to share Relay’s success.

  • Private health & dental coverage , so comprehensive you’d need to be a partner at a Magic Circle law firm to match it.

  • 25 days of holidays

  • Enhanced parental leave .

  • Hardware of your choice .

  • Extensive perks (gym subsidies, cycle-to-work, Friday office lunch, covered Uber home and dinner for late nights, and more).

Find your calling at Mercy!

Mercy Hospital – Springfield Missouri is recruiting an emergency medicine physician! We are a level I trauma center for Missouri and Arkansas and one of the busiest EDs in the Midwest. Mercy Hospital - Springfield:

Springfield, Missouri

title: Raadiovõrgu insener
description:
Otsime Raadiovõrgu inseneri.

Mina olen Oliver Lekk, mobiilivõrgu osakonna juht ning otsin inimest, kes on valmis koos meiega kasvama. Oleme toetav ja tulevikku vaatav tiim, kelle eesmärk on luua ja arendada Eesti kõige olulisemaid sidevõrke. Tagame 2G, 4G ja 5G võrkude töökindluse, juurutame uusi tehnoloogiaid ning viime mobiilside järgmisele tasemele, et Eesti inimesed ja ettevõtted saaksid iga päev usaldusväärselt ühenduses olla.

Sinu mõju

Selle rolli fookus on:

  • 2G, 4G ja 5G mobiilsidevõrkude planeerimine, juurutamine ja seadistamine;
  • uute tugijaamade võrku integreerimine ja kasutuselevõtt;
  • tarkvarauuenduste ning parameetrimuudatuste elluviimine;
  • võrgu KPI-de jälgimine ja võrgu jõudluse optimeerimine;
  • rikete ja jõudlusprobleemide tuvastamine ning kõrvaldamine;
  • panustamine võrgu automatiseerimisse ja protsesside tõhustamisse;
  • teostatud tööde, konfiguratsioonide ja testitulemuste dokumenteerimine ning dokumentatsiooni ajakohasena hoidmine;
  • koostöö projektijuhtide, välitehnikute, klientide ja teiste meeskondadega.


Mis aitab sul selles rollis edu saavutada

  • Erialane kõrgharidus telekommunikatsiooni, elektroonika, infotehnoloogia või sarnases valdkonnas.
  • Teadmised mobiilsidevõrkude (2G, 4G ja 5G) arhitektuurist, toimimispõhimõtetest ja tehnoloogiatest.
  • Üldised teadmised IP-võrkudest, andmesidest ja Linuxi keskkonnast.
  • Tehnilise dokumentatsiooni koostamise ja haldamise oskus.
  • Eesti ja inglise keele oskus nii kõnes kui kirjas.
  • Kasuks tuleb kogemus mobiilivõrkude seadistamise, integreerimise, optimeerimise või haldamisega.
  • Kasuks tuleb kogemus võrgu automatiseerimise, skriptimise (nt Python) või DevOps-lähenemisega.


Mida me pakume

Meiega liitudes ootab sind hoolikalt kokku pandud hüvede pakett, paindlik hübriidtöö võimalus ja palju muud, mis aitab sul hoida head tasakaalu töö ja eraelu vahel. Lisaks on sul võimalus teenida lisaboonust, mis peegeldab sinu panust ja Telia tulemusi.

Ready to make better happen?

Ootame sinu kandideerimist hiljemalt 01.10.2026. Soovitame kandideerida siiski esimesel võimalusel, sest sobiva kandidaadi leidmisel võime konkursi varem sulgeda.
Palun kandideeri meie ametliku värbamisplatvormi Workday kaudu, sest me ei käsitle CV-sid, mis laekuvad emaili või mõne muu kanali kaudu. Niimoodi saame tagada, et sinu isikuandmed on turvaliselt hoitud.
Taustakontroll ja soovituste kontrollimine on osa värbamisprotsessist.

Kui soovid rolli kohta rohkem teada, võta ühendust: Oliver Lekk, mobiilivõrgu osakonna juht, Oliver.Lekk@telia.ee

Võrdsete võimaluste tagamine

Telias hindame inimesi nende professionaalsete oskuste ja arengupotentsiaali põhjal. Toetame mitmekesisust ning tagame, et iga inimese vajadused oleksid arvestatud sõltumata tema taustast, isikuomadustest või elukogemusest. Koos loome kaasava töökeskkonna, kus sinu erilisus on meie tugevus.

Join us and let’s make better happen – together!

title: Clinical Specialist, Atlanta, Georgia - Bracco Medical Technologies
description:
Why Join Bracco Medical Technologies?

We care as much about our employees as we do our patients. Our culture fosters a work environment where employees can thrive, be passionate and have fun along the way. Each member of the Bracco Medical Technologies team has the power to make a difference......every day!

The Clinical Specialist (CS) is responsible for integrating the company's technology into the Cardiac Cath, Hybrid OR and IR Labs of new and existing ACIST accounts. The CS installs ACIST equipment/devices, educates customers on the optimal usage and builds relationships at multiple call points to ensure long term customer satisfaction. The CS contributes to consumable product goal attainment through consultative selling, education and procedural support in an assigned territory and as a team member in identified key accounts.

Ideally, the successful candidate will live in the Atlanta, Georgia metro area.

Primary Duties & Responsibilities:

Sales Support

  • Provide procedural support with Interventional Cardiologists, Interventional Radiologist, and Vascular/Cardiothoracic Surgeons, and other staff during product adoption visits to ensure proper and optimal use of ACIST equipment/devices
  • Develop relationships with multiple call points during product adoption visits E.g.; Physician, Management, Tech, RN, education, Bio-Med etc.
  • Identify training needs within each assigned account and execute necessary activities to support product adoption and effectiveness.
  • Identify non adopters in assigned accounts and employ a consultative selling strategy to convert them into adopters; this includes consulting and collaborating with customer to uncover their specific needs and identify working solutions
  • Develop and execute strategies in conjunction with Territory Sales Manager to drive consumable utilization that aligns with sales projections
  • Ensure all product issues or concerns are properly addressed to ensure long term customer satisfaction
  • Maintain thorough record of all activities in customer relationship management system (Salesforce.com)
  • Maintain accurate customer profile focused on utilization of ACIST equipment/devices
  • Serve as a consultative resource utilizing the Vital Signs process and completing baseline assessments per protocol in the Account Database (SalesForce.com)

Installation and Training

  • Provide installation of the company’s medical equipment within assigned territory and as a team member in key account installations. Includes but is not limited to site & staff assessment, system unpack, test, set up, integration with OEM equipment, coordination, execution and documentation of training for all staff
  • Present features and benefits to customers, educate /train customers on proper usage of the equipment/device, document proficiency and establish follow up plan to maintain customer satisfaction
  • Working side by side with the Interventional Cardiologist, Interventional Radiologist, and Vascular/Cardiothoracic Surgeons and staff to execute a comprehensive training plan to ensure proficiency and safety in the use of ACIST devices
  • Ensure all staff are utilizing the ACIST device with best practice techniques and with utmost regard for patient safety
  • Collaborate with Territory Sales Manager to ensure maximum integration of technology in new accounts
  • Maintain records of all installation details in customer relationship management system (Salesforce.com).

Customer Support

  • Address on-going customer needs through cross-functional communication and collaboration. Examples include but are not limited to:
  • Proactive communications with engineering on product requirements
  • Communicating with Service for deployment of service-related activities
  • Communicating “voice of customer” feedback to Marketing
  • Frequent communications with Sales Administration to secure accessories and manage logistics

Clinical Support

  • In conjunction with Territory Sales Manager, provide case and clinical support during product demonstrations and evaluations to prospective customers
  • Keep current on all product literature, promotional material and industry developments

Qualifications (Knowledge, Skills & Abilities):

Minimum

  • RCIS, RN, RT or related health care license
  • 3 years clinical experience in the interventional or peripheral cardiovascular laboratory or thorough knowledge of current interventional practices and procedures

Job Description

About Texas A&M University–Kingsville

Texas A&M University–Kingsville (TAMUK), the oldest institution of higher learning in South Texas and a proud member of the Texas A&M University System, stands as the region’s premier university. TAMUK offers the widest range of academic programs and degrees in South Texas, provides exceptional learning and residential facilities, conducts impactful research, awards substantial scholarships, and has awarded more than 80,000 degrees in the institution’s 100-year history. The university is recognized for its unwavering commitment to student success, meaningful research, and deep community engagement. With a welcoming campus culture and strong regional partnerships, TAMUK offers faculty and staff a unique opportunity to make a lasting difference in the lives of students and the broader South Texas region.

Location: The University is located in historic Kingsville, a friendly, safe city of 25,000 that is the home of the legendary King Ranch. Corpus Christi and its beaches are just 40 miles to the northeast, and the border with Mexico is 120 miles to the south at Brownsville or 119 miles to the west at Laredo.

For more information, click here.

Position Overview

Perform independent or supervisory roles in research activities that require an advanced level of knowledge in entomology, pest management, horticulture, statistics, and experimental design. These roles are predominantly intellectual and varied in nature, necessitating consistent use of discretion and judgment. Performs skilled, administrative, and managerial support in research. Plans and directs certain phases in a research project. This is a grant funded position for 12-months and continuation of the position beyond 12-months is contingent upon continuation of funding. This position is located at Texas A&M University-Kingsville Citrus Center in Weslaco, Texas.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

Research Support and Data Collection

  • Assists in the design, planning, coordinating, and execution of experiments or trials in support of various research projects in the laboratory, field, or greenhouse.

  • Collects samples and measurement data for laboratory or greenhouse experiments and field trials.

  • Records, compiles, and maintains data sets and observations for experiments or trials.

  • Assists undergraduate and/or graduate students and other laboratory, technical, or field staff involved in research.

Data Analysis and Reporting

  • Uses computers and laboratory or technical equipment to perform data analysis, statistical analysis, and technical evaluation of research experiments and results.

  • Evaluates, summarizes, and records results of technical evaluations, data, or statistical analyses.

  • Summarizes project results/findings in progress reports.

  • Assists in preparing and writing reports or proposals to funding agencies.

Publications, Outreach, and Presentations

  • Assists in preparing outreach/grower articles or scientific manuscripts for journals.

  • Assists in preparing oral or poster presentations for scientific or grower meetings.

  • Prepares and gives oral presentations on research-related topics to Citrus Center visitors.

Equipment and Laboratory Operations

  • Assembles, installs, operates, maintains, and repairs research equipment.

Purchasing and Financial Recordkeeping

  • Purchases equipment or supplies required for research projects.

  • Maintains records and invoices of purchases related to research projects.

Other Duties

  • Performs other duties as assigned.

Qualifications

Required Education

Bachelor’s degree in agricultural sciences, biology, ecology, entomology, horticulture, pest management, plant science or an applicable field or equivalent combination of education and experience.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Three years of related experience.

  • Prior lab and field experience in research projects related to agricultural sciences, entomology, horticulture, pest management, or plant sciences.

  • Knowledge of laboratory maintenance and equipment.

  • Ability to effectively use a computer and applicable software to create databases, present data, and perform other computer-related tasks.

  • Ability to multitask and work cooperatively with others.

  • Master’s degree in entomology or pest management from an accredited college or university.

  • Experience in scouting, identification and / or management of citrus pests or diseases.

  • Experience in greenhouse crop production or citrus management practices.

  • Experience in PCR, gel electrophoresis, nucleic acid extraction, and other molecular biology techniques.

  • Experience in setup and maintenance of drip or sprinkler irrigation systems.

  • Pesticide applicator license.

Required Licenses and Certifications

  • Texas driver’s license

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • Ability to effectively communicate both orally and in writing.

  • Ability to positively and professionally interact with growers, students, staff and faculty.

  • Excellent communication and presentation skills.

  • Strong interpersonal and organizational skills.

  • Working knowledge of Microsoft Office software.

  • Ability to orally comprehend and express information and use inductive and deductive reasoning.

  • Ability to multitask and work cooperatively with others.

  • Working knowledge of microscopes.

Other Requirements

Physical Requirements

  • Ability to work in greenhouses or outdoors exposed to various weather conditions, potential allergens, elevated noise levels, and heat

  • Ability to travel independently to other and/or remote locations by driving

  • Ability to move light, medium or heavy objects with assistance.

  • Ability to use microscopes for extended periods

Other Requirements and Factors

  • This position is security sensitive

  • This position will require export-control authorization prior to starting employment.

  • This position requires compliance with state and federal laws/codes and Texas A&M University System/TAMU policies, regulations, rules and procedures

  • All tasks and job responsibilities must be performed safely without injury to self or others in compliance with System and University safety requirements

  • This position may require work beyond normal office hours and/or work on weekends

  • This position is funded from grant and/or contract funding, which is renewed through provisions of the grantor of the contract. Therefore, this position is contingent upon continuation of funding from these grants and/or contracts, as well as satisfactory job performance

Data Engineer III

About the Role
We're looking for a Data Engineer III to join our Data Engineering team, which builds and governs the data foundation that powers the business. You'll work within our stack — Python ingestion pipelines, Airflow orchestration, and Snowflake/Databricks — helping move data reliably and securely from source to decision-ready output.
You'll implement features and fixes against a given design, handle known classes of pipeline issues on your own, and escalate genuinely novel problems with clear context rather than working them in isolation. You're also expected to start contributing meaningfully in code review — catching real bugs, not just style nits.

What You'll Do

  • Implement new ingestion sources end-to-end against a senior engineer's design — connector code, DAG, schema, monitoring, and catalog registration — extending the team's existing framework where a new source needs a pattern it doesn't yet support

  • Investigate pipeline failures independently, recognize known classes of issues, and ship the documented fix without needing to escalate

  • Before shipping a new pipeline, identify downstream consumers and what would break if data were late or wrong, and flag gaps like this during spec review — before writing code

  • Write clear handovers when escalating a genuinely unresolved issue — what you tried, what you ruled out, and where things diverge — so a senior can pick up without re-discovery

  • Review peers' pipeline PRs and catch non-obvious issues (e.g., missing idempotency checks, race conditions) that could cause incorrect downstream data

  • Turn ambiguous "why is this data wrong?" questions into structured investigations — tracing data lineage from source to warehouse and communicating back what you found

  • Surface concerns in spec review as specific, well-reasoned questions rather than staying silent or blocking progress

  • Support data security and governance work (e.g., PII masking, access controls) and contribute to data delivery work, including reverse ETL integrations

  • Build strong working relationships with internal stakeholders and help scope and clarify requirements for new work

  • Mentor DE2s on their first significant projects — pairing on tricky decisions and helping them apply team conventions

What We're Looking For

  • 3–5 years of professional software or data engineering experience

  • Strong SQL and Python skills, with solid experience building and operating production data pipelines

  • Comfort investigating and root-causing pipeline issues independently before escalating

  • Experience with workflow orchestration tools (Airflow or similar) and a cloud data warehouse/lakehouse (Snowflake, Databricks, or similar)

  • Solid understanding of data pipeline concepts: idempotency, schema evolution, backfills, and data quality/testing

  • Experience giving substantive code review feedback, not just style or formatting comments

  • Strong communication skills — can write a clear technical handover, ask sharp questions in spec review, and explain a data lineage investigation to a non-technical stakeholder

  • A track record of taking ownership of known-class problems end-to-end rather than needing step-by-step direction


Nice to Have


  • Experience extending or building reusable pipeline frameworks/templates

  • Exposure to reverse ETL tools or patterns, PII masking, or data access governance (RBAC)

  • Exposure to observability/monitoring tooling (e.g., Datadog) for pipeline health and alerting

  • Some experience mentoring or informally supporting more junior engineers

  • Background in gaming, betting, e-commerce, or another regulated/high-compliance industry


Why Join Us


  • Real ownership over known-class problems, with senior/staff support available for the genuinely novel ones

  • Work on high-visibility, high-trust systems that the business depends on

  • A culture built around clear tenets: standardize before you scale, own the outcome (not just the ticket), and clarity over complexity

  • Clear growth path into Senior Data Engineer, with room to start mentoring and shaping team practices along the way

description:

We exist to make food the world loves. But we do more than that. POSITION OVERVIEW

Food Safety Quality (FSQ) Technician

Why Join Our Team

At General Mills Winnipeg, you’ll be part of the team that proudly makes Pillsbury Pizza Pops for Canadians. Invented right here in Winnipeg, Pizza Pops are now produced exclusively at our plant for markets across Canada. With multiple varieties and hundreds of thousands made daily, your work will help bring a beloved Canadian favorite to families nationwide.

You’ll join a welcoming, culturally diverse team, with more than 15 languages represented across the plant. At General Mills, we believe in growth—for our business, our communities and especially our people. If you’re ready to learn new skills, take on challenges, contribute to a safety-first culture and build a meaningful career, Winnipeg is a great place to start and grow.

As part of our Leadership team, you will:

The Food Safety and Quality (FSQ) Technician supports the Winnipeg Plant by helping ensure products, processes, and operations meet General Mills’ food safety and quality standards. Provide technical support to plant operations, the FSQ engineer and manager in day-to-day plant floor activities. Provide leadership in the areas of Food Safety and Quality Management with an emphasis on consumer requirements, continuous product quality improvement and productivity improvement.

KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES

  • Monitoring Product Quality - measure key quality characteristics of the process.
  • Maintaining Testing Equipment in a Functional and Calibrated Order - responsible for keeping all test machines used for monitoring quality calibrated and properly maintained. This can involve using test standards to check readings and adjust tools accordingly.
  • Process Management – inspect and audit processes and products to ensure they conform to the company's food safety and quality standards.
  • Food Safety Incident Control - investigate food safety incidents, collaborate with Production, Sanitation and Maintenance to establish corrective actions and implement those actions to provide product and brand protection.
  • Supplier Conformance – prepare raw material acceptance reports to ensure conformance to standard.
  • Continuous Improvement - Support plant initiatives on root cause analysis and corrective and preventive action activities
  • Conduct food safety and quality inspections, verifications, and monitoring activities.
  • Support environmental monitoring, sampling, and follow-up actions.
  • Investigate quality or food safety concerns and assist with root-cause analysis and corrective actions.
  • Support product traceability, quality holds, positive release, and documentation requirements.
  • Partner with Production, Sanitation, Maintenance, Engineering, and other teams to resolve issues and sustain standards.
  • Verify compliance with Good Manufacturing Practices, sanitation requirements, procedures, and plant standards.
  • Record and communicate results accurately using applicable quality and manufacturing systems.
  • Support training, process verification, trials, and continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Lab cleaning and maintenance as needed
  • Support plant tests, capability studies and start-ups, as needed, including additional analytical test requests
  • Approval of product against specifications
  • Data entry into MQIS (statistical analysis database)
  • Lead execution of plant label verification program
  • Partner with team leaders and technicians to influence quality decisions and support production
  • Assist in development, maintenance, and execution of plant audit programs to assure effective execution of quality and food safety programs, such as Quality Index, FSRA (Food Safety and Regulatory Assessment), HACCP verification, Integrated Pest Management, GMPs
  • Sanitation responsibilities
  • Execute environmental monitoring swabbing in assigned areas. Follow up on mitigation and vectoring sites
  • Control of documentation and document review to support Preventive Control Requirements
  • Ownership and responsibility for tasks, programs and high-quality work output
  • Strong organizational skills with an ability to handle multiple priorities
  • Willingness and ability to be flexible and adapt to changing job requirements
  • Provide leadership and support to the manufacturing teams to effectively resolve product quality and food safety issues. Provide technical and system analysis support for root-cause investigations and foreign material contamination incidents
  • Sensory panel participation and program support
  • Lead and execute assigned programs to support the Food Safety Management System
  • Ability to work all shifts (monthly rotating shift)
  • Additional duties as assigned

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor’s degree in Food Science, Food Technology or related field.
  • 1+ years of experience in manufacturing in a Quality role would be an asset.
  • Demonstrated decision making, initiative and leadership abilities.
  • Problem Solving Expertise (YY, Fishbone, Intervention Report, FI, etc) is a plus
  • Quality tools like PMO, Regulatory, and/or Dairy experience is a plus
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a dynamic environment
  • Highly motivated self-starter with strong organization and prioritization skills
  • Assertive, self-confident, and willing to offer opinions and insights with a team
  • Ability to influence, develop, and motivate peers
  • Desire to work cross functionally with all plant functions to support plant operations

PREFFERED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Strong manufacturing background and a strong knowledge of Quality and Food Safety systems.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects and priorities.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills.
  • Ability to experiment, assess risks and make data-based recommendations and decisions.
  • Strong productive discourse and conflict management skills



ELIGIBILITY

Applicants must meet minimum age qualifications in the country in which the job is located.

title: Hiring: Full Stack WordPress Developer
description:
About Us

Skift is the leading business intelligence and media company in travel, delivering news, research, and global events that power smarter decisions across the industry. We convene senior leaders and innovators who rely on Skift for clarity, insight, and meaningful connection in a fast-moving global market.

The Opportunity

We’re looking for a highly skilled, proactive Full Stack WordPress Developer to join Skift. This role is ideal for an engineer who thrives in a collaborative environment and wants a major voice in the technical decisions shaping our digital platforms. You will work alongside our existing development and editorial teams. We are actively looking for candidates based in the UK.

Why This Role Matters

As a reader-first company relying on hard and metered paywalls across a portfolio of properties—including Skift.com, Airline Weekly, Skift Research, Daily Lodging Report, and Skift Meetings—our technical infrastructure is the lifeblood of our business. By building robust back-end architecture and intuitive custom features, you ensure that our teams can seamlessly publish influential travel industry coverage, while delivering a high-performing, secure experience to our global audience.

Some of What You’ll Do

Architecture & Custom Development


  • Build and maintain our suite of WordPress sites with a heavy focus on back-end architecture and peak performance.

  • Develop custom themes, custom post types, taxonomies, hooks, filters, and dynamic WordPress templates.

  • Model and flawlessly manage structured content using Advanced Custom Fields (ACF) Pro.

Integration & Modern Tooling


  • Build and integrate RESTful APIs seamlessly within the WordPress ecosystem.

  • Develop and maintain custom Gutenberg blocks to empower our content creators.

  • Utilize modern development tooling, including wp-scripts, Webpack, Composer, and BEM CSS architecture using Sass.

Collaboration & Code Quality


  • Partner directly with our editorial and design teams to scope, create, and deploy new pages and features.

  • Uphold rigorous WordPress performance, security, and coding standards across all properties (including WPVIP environments).

  • Participate actively in collaborative code reviews and version control workflows using Git and GitHub, while supporting existing projects when external teams require assistance.

What You’ll Bring


  • Proven WordPress Expertise: Deep experience building hybrid WordPress themes, custom Gutenberg blocks, and structured content modeling (ACF).

  • Back-End Mastery: Expert-level proficiency in PHP 8+, MySQL, REST APIs, and core WordPress architecture.

  • Front-End Competency: Strong working knowledge of JavaScript (ES6+), jQuery, SCSS/PostCSS, and a comfort level with shipping for older browser baselines.

  • Agility and Organization: The ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously, meet strict deadlines, and thrive while working asynchronously across U.S. and European time zones.

  • Strong Communication Skills: You are friendly, highly organized, and can articulate technical choices clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

  • Bonus: Experience with ReactJS, NodeJS, MongoDB, HubSpot, or a portfolio of public GitHub repositories we can review is a significant plus.

Success Metrics


  • Platform Stability & Performance: Consistent upkeep of high-performing, secure code that adheres to strict WordPress and WPVIP standards across all our subscription platforms.

  • Feature Velocity: On-time deployment of reliable custom themes, blocks, and API integrations that directly support our editorial and design goals.

  • Code Quality: Clean, scalable architecture, demonstrated through successful peer code reviews and effective use of Git/GitHub workflows.

  • Seamless Collaboration: Proactive, clear communication and a proven ability to work efficiently and independently across multiple time zones.

What We Offer


  • Opportunity to grow within a respected and innovative media company.

  • Exposure to the intersection of media, events, and travel intelligence.

  • Collaborative, supportive, and remote-friendly work environment.

How We Work

Skift's culture is diverse, cohesive, and full of people who love what they do and bring the best of themselves to work. We are remote but very connected and caring about each other.

How To Apply

If this role sounds like a fit, we’d love to hear from you. PLEASE SEND US A COVER LETTER ALONG WITH YOUR RESUME sharing why you’re interested and how your experience aligns with Skift's mission.

Skift is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to building a team that reflects the diversity of travelers around the world. We welcome applicants from all life experiences and encourage members of traditionally underrepresented backgrounds to apply.

Here’s what you can expect next

If selected to interview, a Skift team member will reach out to schedule next steps.

WHY JOIN US

If you're looking for a place to grow, make an impact, and work with people who care, we'd love to meet you!

ABOUT THE ROLE

We are looking for a Senior Data Engineer to lead the replacement of a third-party digital ingestion tool with a custom-built ETL pipeline. This person will document existing logic, evaluate build-vs-buy options such as Fivetran, and build a standalone pipeline within an existing AWS environment. Strong SQL and DSP or programmatic advertising experience are central to this role.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • - Document current ingestion logic inside the legacy tool (TapClicks), including sources, endpoints, schemas, and transformation logic.
  • - Build the ETL pipeline to replace the legacy system, handling ingestion from the Amazon API, other DSP platforms, and related digital data sources.
  • - Evaluate and decide between off-the-shelf solutions (e.g., Fivetran) and custom-built ETL systems alongside the Infrastructure Lead.
  • - Design the pipeline as a standalone, owned system to power client-facing dashboards.
  • - Provide flexible engineering support for application and backend work within the AWS environment when directed.
  • - Coordinate with data science teams to ensure ingestion output aligns with the attribution and scoring logic of downstream models.
  • - Work seamlessly within the existing AWS environment (ECS, S3, RDS) rather than standing up parallel infrastructure.

MUST HAVES

  • - 4+ years of strong SQL and large-scale data ingestion/pipeline experience (batch ETL, orchestration, schema design).
  • - Direct or adjacent experience with digital advertising / DSP data (e.g., Amazon DSP, Amazon Advertising API, or comparable programmatic platforms).
  • - Working knowledge of AWS data services (RDS/Postgres, S3, ECS) sufficient to build within an existing cloud environment.
  • - Ability to contribute to application and backend work beyond pure ETL to support broader platform needs.

title: NOW HIRING: UNIQLO Macarthur - Seasonal Store Associates (Full-time/Casual)
description:
UNIQLO is a global brand built on LifeWear - simple, high-quality clothing designed to make everyday life better.

The Role:

The Seasonal Store Associates is the customer service specialist of the store. They are responsible for exceeding customer expectations by listening to customer needs, providing in-depth information about our products, and always operating as a brand ambassador.

Key Responsibilities:

• Meeting and greeting all customers in a friendly manner.

• Maintaining excellent shop floor standards and cleanliness.

title: Principal Reliability Engineer - Bracco Medical Technologies
description:
Why Join Bracco Medical Technologies?

We care as much about our employees as we do our patients. Our culture fosters a work environment where employees can thrive, be passionate and have fun along the way. Each member of the Bracco Medical Technologies team has the power to make a difference......every day!

The Principal Reliability Engineer (PE) is the champion for product quality and reliability across BMT. The PE serves as a technical leader, partnering with Systems Engineering, Quality, and cross-functional teams to define quality and reliability goals, requirements, and strategies across the BMT product portfolio.

In this role, the PE will maintain deep expertise in reliability methods, testing, field performance, risk management, and failure analysis to support business and customer needs. The PE will lead the development and execution of reliability strategies throughout the product lifecycle—from product development through post-market performance—ensuring that field and reliability data drive measurable product improvements.

Primary Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Define and lead Design for Reliability (DFR) methodologies and framework that supports new product development across hardware and software
  • Mentor engineers to improve engineering skills, methodologies, and domain knowledge
  • Develop the business case and plan for reliability programs and communicate benefits to senior management in the engineering and quality organizations
  • Review and approve reliability planning, testing, and analysis activities within both New Product Development and sustaining programs
  • Ensure quality and reliability requirements are incorporated into BMT products, and construct useful methods to quantify product quality and reliability across the portfolio
  • Contribute to the execution of Technical Design Reviews to ensure they are complete and effective
  • Develop and define the strategy and roadmap for incorporating and deploying new tools, methods, and processes to address the quality and reliability needs of BMT
  • Be a technology advocate in business and customer interactions
  • Attract, develop, and retain engineering talent
  • Be the champion and key stakeholder in the technical design reviews for products in the portfolio while providing opportunities and guidance to engineers in presenting and explaining technology designs and how decisions were made.
  • Take responsibility for internal and external stakeholder communication on key technical updates and issues, adapting the message to ensure effective communication to different audiences.
  • Effectively manage risk management activities and ensure decisions are made, implemented and tracked to conclusion for technical issues throughout the project.
  • Define reliability metrics and targets using field, complaint, service, and test data
  • Lead and/or support reliability investigations for significant and recurring field failures and drive product reliability improvements based on post-market performance
  • Drive
  • Provide reliability input to risk management and risk-control decisions
  • Measure subsystem and end-to-end system reliability to demonstrate customer impact

Qualifications (Knowledge, Skills & Abilities):

Minimum

  • Bachelors’ degree in engineering, preferably systems, electrical, mechanical, bio-medical, or software, reliability, or related scientific discipline
  • Experience mentoring and coaching engineers. (i.e., Ability to coach and guide others how to develop protocols, execute system tests and write effective reports)
  • 5+ years of experience with the Design for Reliability (DFR) and associated reliability processes
  • 5+ years in a product development system engineering role
  • Experience analyzing field, complaint, and service data to identify reliability trends and failure modes.
  • Demonstrated experience leading root cause investigations in partnership with engineering and quality and corrective actions for complex product failures
  • Working knowledge ofreliability, risk management, and design controls, including ISO 14971 and ISO 13485
  • Demonstrated experience with risk management and systems engineering processes
  • Ability to grow productive, trusting, and open relationships with a wide variety of constituencies
  • Demonstrated ability to communicate effectively across a business enterprise, adapting your message to the audience in both written and verbal media
  • High degree of organizational skills and high attention to detail
  • Ability to handle multiple tasks and prioritize work for self and team effectively
  • Ability to work both independently and as part of a team across the business unit

Preferred

PhD in EE, Systems Engineering, , Reliability, SW, Physics, or related scientific discipline

  • 10+ years of Reliability experience
  • Experience working with physicians and customers in a product development role
  • Demonstrated capability gathering and distilling Voice-of-customer experience to actionable items within a product development team
  • Experience in developing and interpreting clinical research to advance capabilities and claims of medical devices
  • Demonstrated ability to transition technology research into commercial product offerings
  • Demonstrated ability to coach, teach, and grow early career engineers into senior positions
  • Experience with design of experiments, data analysis, statistical methods & presentation of results
  • Familiarity with functional database and software tools for managing projects, requirements, risk, etc.
  • Understanding of product development milestones and basic business financials
  • Experience with government regulatory agencies and audit processes (i.e. FDA, FAA, NRC, etc.)
  • Experience in Reliability /Serviceability as applicable to medical equipment
  • CRE, ASQ or Six Sigma certification as a Black Belt or Master Black Belt

Other

  • Ability to Travel ~10%

Our 100% paid family leave options for parents, grandparents and eligible family members provide support for growing families as well.

  • Choose –You won’t find “stuffy” here whether your position requires a hybrid or in-the-office working arrangement. That means business casual for your attire and flexibility in your schedule, wherever possible.

description:
