  • Collaborative mindset and strong interpersonal skills.

title: Senior Frontend Developer
description:
Are you a builder at heart? Someone who enjoys turning ideas into working products, trying out new technologies and taking ownership from idea to implementation?

At ahead, we're looking for a Senior Frontend Engineer who wants to help us further develop our SaaS platform and explore how an AI-first approach can change the way we build software. We're actively experimenting with new tools and ways of working. Some are already part of our daily development, others we're still figuring out. What matters to us is being open to trying new things, keeping what works and challenging what does not.

If you enjoy building products, exploring new approaches and taking responsibility for your work, we'd be happy to hear from you.

What you'll do

  • Build and ship. Develop and continuously improve our intranet SaaS platform, used by organizations to connect, engage and inspire their employees.
  • Take ideas to production. Turn concepts into working solutions -- from early exploration and prototyping through implementation, testing and release.
  • Build AI-first. Use AI throughout your development workflow to explore ideas, write and review code, test, debug and document.
  • Work with leading AI development tools such as Claude and Codex and evaluate new technologies and approaches as they emerge.
  • Help shape the product. Work closely with product management and the wider team to understand problems, challenge assumptions and define solutions -- not just implement predefined tickets.
  • Improve how we build. Experiment with new technologies, tools and workflows that can help us move faster, improve quality or build a better product.

Our current technology stack includes React, TypeScript, Jest, Next.js and Microsoft Azure -- but our stack is not set in stone. We continuously evaluate the best technologies and tools available.

What we're looking for

We're looking for a builder, not just a developer. You have several years of experience building modern web applications and strong JavaScript / TypeScript and React skills. More importantly, you're curious about where software development is heading and want to be part of that change.

You:

  • Have strong experience (3+ years) building and shipping modern web applications with React and TypeScript.
  • Think in products and user outcomes, not just technical requirements.
  • Have an AI-first mindset and actively explore how AI and new tools can improve the way you build software.
  • Are curious and open to experimenting with new technologies, tools and approaches -- and pragmatic about what adKworks.
  • Take ownership of your work and are comfortable making decisions independently.
  • Enjoy working independently as well as collaborating with a team, exchanging feedback and challenging assumptions constructively.
  • Speak good English. German is a plus, but not a requirement.

A degree in computer science or a related field is welcome, but what you've built and how you think matters more to us than your formal education.

How we work

You'll join our team in Barcelona in a hybrid setup, combining time together in our central office with the flexibility to work from home. We're a team that values ownership, curiosity and execution. We exchange ideas openly, challenge each other constructively and give people the freedom to make things happen.

We want to work with the best tools available today -- not the tools that happened to be standard five years ago. That means continuously experimenting with new AI models, coding agents, development environments and workflows.

Technology will keep changing. We expect you to change with it and ideally be one of the people pushing us forward.

If you're a builder who wants to explore what software engineering looks like in an AI-first world, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Program Manager
description:
For over 75 years, Easterseals Hawaii (ESH) has endeavored to change the way the world defines and views disability by making profound, positive differences in people’s lives every day. We provide care to diverse communities with justice, equity, and inclusion as guiding principles, managing 18 programs statewide that deliver remote and in-person services to infants, children, youth, and adults with diverse disabilities or special needs and their families.

The Early Intervention Program Manager coordinates all components of a developmental, educational, Primary Service Provider Coaching program for families with children from birth to three years of age who have a developmental delay or are at risk for delay. The Program Manager is Directly responsible for daily operations of the program, including supervising personnel, coordination of direct services, program planning, budgeting, ensuring compliance and implementation of policies and procedures.


ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS

  • Manages Early Intervention team and day to day operations at assigned program location and escalates issues and concerns as needed to Director.
  • Supervises and participates in the Primary Service Provider Coaching model of early intervention service delivery with a multidisciplinary team of care coordinators, social workers , early interventionists and administrative team members.
  • Completes observation checklists with team members quarterly and engages in reflective supervision meetings monthly with program team members.
  • Attends weekly Family Support Team meetings (FSTs) and reviews Individualized Family Support Plans (IFSP) to ensure compliance.
  • Collaborates with community resources to address program and participants’ needs.
  • Keeps updated with current practices and develops methods and procedures of best practices and principles, integrating them into program as applicable.
  • Participates in the budget development process and operates program within the budget.
  • Works collaboratively and successfully to ensure program compliance with all company, funder and accreditation requirements.
  • Timely completion of all program reporting to company, funder and accreditation
  • Oversees program data entry and monthly billing procedures.
  • Reviews all invoices, request for payments (accounts payable) and contractual invoices. Verifies expenses/codes.
  • Reviews all quality assurance surveys – summarizes information and develops action plan.
  • Performs quarterly child record chart audits with the SAM tool and ensures documentation guidelines are consistently implemented.
  • Keeps current with all program regulations and audit requirements.
  • Collaborates with other internal staff around information and referral, public relations, education, and community relations. Conducts presentations, as needed.
  • Must report in person to assigned office location a minimum of 4 days per week, up to 5 days per week, dependent on program needs as directed by management team.
  • Must report in person to assigned office location within 24 hours as directed by EIS.

QUALIFICATIONS

Minimum Education, Experience & Training Equivalent to:

  • Bachelor’s degree in social work, special education, business or health related field from an accredited program or equivalent. Master’s degree preferred.
  • One year of progressive experience working with children with disabilities.
  • Minimum of three years’ experience with supervisory responsibilities. Prefer five years of progressive experience with at least one year in a leadership position.
  • Experience working with children with developmental delays in the field of early intervention preferred.

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities:

  • Significant knowledge of developmental delays and disabilities, familiarity with ADA and Individuals with Disabilities Educational Act (IDEA) guidelines, and inclusion.
  • Experience with the Primary Service Provider Coaching model of Early Intervention service delivery, using an approach that involves giving and receiving peer and family coaching.
  • Communicate effectively verbally and in writing using the primary language in the workplace; American Sign Language or bilingual ability preferred.
  • Exercise confidentiality and discretion pertaining to the work environment and maintain all HIPAA requirements.
  • Appropriately interpret and implement policies, procedures, and regulations of ESH.
  • Consistently demonstrate good judgment and decision-making skills.
  • A commitment to the values of the organization while demonstrating good judgment, flexibility, patience and discretion when dealing with confidential and sensitive matters.
  • Knowledgeable and skilled in computer and Microsoft (MS Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint).
  • Capacity and willingness to work in an exciting, fast paced high energy environment while effectively multitasking and meeting assigned deadlines.
  • Personable; able to work comfortably with individuals at all levels within the organization.

Physical Requirements:

  • Frequent bending, reaching, squatting, kneeling, and twisting in order to observe, assess, and interact with clients.
  • Ability to stand or sit for extended periods of time, stand for up to 6-8 hours a day.
  • Occasional lifting, carrying, and loading/unloading toys and materials up to and including 50 lbs.
  • Visual and auditory ability to work with clients, staff, and others in the workplace continuously.
  • Frequent driving to and from office and client homes.
  • Capacity to utilize computers, cell or landline phones, fax and copy machines to communicate.
  • Frequent proofreading and checking documents for accuracy.
  • Frequent exposure to disability disorders in clients; occasional emergency situations; occasional exposure to trauma; in person client contact and decision making; and constant concentration required when working with clients.
  • Ability to respond immediately and appropriately to emergencies as defined by Family of Companies Emergency Procedure Guide.

Conditions of Employment

  • Must obtain and maintain criminal record clearance through the Department of Justice (DOJ). The HR Department must analyze DOJ/FBI live scan reports in accordance with applicable Federal, State, and Local laws, as well as fitness for the position.
  • May travel to multiple work sites and client homes; reliable transportation required.
  • Must have valid Hawaii Driver’s License/insurance and maintain a clean driving record, current auto insurance and current vehicle inspection.
  • Must pass health screenings, obtain vaccinations, and provide annual TB clearance based on company policies.
  • Must obtain and maintain clearance through the Office of Inspector General.
  • Must attend all ESH and Family of Companies required training.

Full time

88,000-95,000 Annually

title: Staff Embedded Firmware & System Software Engineer — Platform Controller and SoC Stack
description:
About the role

We are building the software stack that runs on next-generation silicon. Based on Zephyr-platform management controller responsible for secure boot, system software on the application processor — bootloader, kernel drivers, PCIe subsystem, and IOMMU configuration — that turns raw silicon into a platform an operating system can run on.

What you’ll do

Firmware and platform control

  • Design, implement, and maintain Zephyr RTOS firmware for a platform management controllers, including device drivers, subsystem integration, and application-level services.
  • Write and upstream-quality-review drivers against Zephyr's driver model — devicetree bindings, Kconfig, init levels and priorities, struct device APIs.

System software and high-speed interconnect

  • Bring up and debug PCIe links on first silicon — LTSSM progression, link training failures, lane reversal and polarity, equalization, speed and width negotiation.
  • Implement and maintain PCIe host controller and endpoint drivers: enumeration, configuration space, BAR allocation, MSI/MSI-X interrupt routing, AER and error handling, ASPM and link power states.
  • Configure and validate IOMMU behavior — address translation, DMA remapping, device isolation domains, page-table management, fault reporting and recovery.
  • Develop system software across the boot and runtime path: bootloader, firmware-to-OS handoff, ACPI or device tree description, kernel drivers, and the DMA and memory-management interfaces they depend on.
  • Debug DMA correctness and coherency problems end to end, from device transaction through translation to system memory.

Silicon and process

  • Perform post-silicon bring-up: first-boot debug, clock and reset validation, bus enumeration, triage of RTL-versus-firmware ambiguity with design teams.
  • Debug hard problems using JTAG/SWD, ETM/ITM trace, protocol analyzers, and logic analyzers — including intermittent, timing-dependent, and multi-master failures.

Required qualifications

  • 8–10 years of professional embedded firmware and/or system software development in C, with meaningful exposure to modern C++ or Rust.
  • Deep, hands-on RTOS experience on 32-bit microcontrollers (Arm Cortex-M or RISCV) scheduling, priority assignment, ISR design, synchronization primitives, and the failure modes each one produces.
  • Proven driver development experience against a formal driver model, including bus drivers and interrupt-driven peripherals.
  • System software fundamentals: virtual memory and address translation, DMA and cache coherency, the kernel/users pace boundary, and how a platform gets from reset vector to a running OS.
  • Working knowledge of PCIe architecture — enumeration, configuration space, BARs, MSI/MSI-X, and the transaction model — sufficient to debug why a device is not appearing or not moving data.
  • Understanding of what an IOMMU is for and what it costs: translation, isolation, and the DMA failure modes that appear when it is misconfigured.
  • Demonstrated ability to read a hardware specification or register map and translate it into correct, testable software without handholding.
  • Applied AI/ML knowledge — Strong AI based coding.
  • BS or MS in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or equivalent practical experience.

Preferred qualifications

Strong candidates will have direct experience with several or some of the following.

· PCIe and interconnect

· IOMMU and virtualization

· System software

· RTOS and platform

· Peripherals and subsystems

description:
MPS is is looking for a Senior DevOps Engineer to help build, automate, and operate secure, scalable cloud infrastructure supporting a large U.S. retail platform. This is a hands-on individual contributor role for an experienced infrastructure professional with deep expertise in Microsoft Azure, Azure DevOps, Terraform, Kubernetes, cloud networking, security, and CI/CD automation. You will partner closely with engineering teams, architects, and senior stakeholders to enable reliable production deployments, resolve infrastructure dependencies, and continuously improve the platform while operating within strict retail security and compliance standards.

Your Impact

  • Design, implement, and support scalable and secure Azure cloud infrastructure for enterprise applications.
  • Build consistent, repeatable environments using Terraform and Infrastructure as Code (IaC).
  • Deploy and manage containerized workloads using Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS).
  • Develop and maintain automation solutions that improve operational efficiency, reliability, and scalability.
  • Drive cloud modernization initiatives and infrastructure best practices across the platform.

Security, Networking & Platform Services

  • Implement secure cloud environments using Azure Key Vault, Network Security Groups (NSGs), Private Endpoints, and secure access patterns.
  • Design and support Azure networking components, including DNS, Virtual Networks, subnetting, connectivity, and Private Link services.
  • Manage and secure application connectivity across distributed cloud environments.
  • Support API integrations and platform services used by enterprise-scale applications.
  • Implement cloud security controls and ensure compliance with healthcare security and privacy requirements.
  • Collaborate with security and architecture teams to maintain highly secure production environments.

CI/CD & Production Delivery

  • Build and maintain deployment pipelines using Azure DevOps and modern CI/CD practices.
  • Automate infrastructure, application, and platform deployments across multiple environments.
  • Support end-to-end production release processes, ensuring environments are secure, reliable, and deployment-ready.
  • Troubleshoot infrastructure, deployment, and platform issues, driving rapid resolution of blockers and dependencies.
  • Implement monitoring, operational excellence, and deployment governance practices.

Collaboration & Technical Ownership

  • Partner with developers, architects, platform teams, and senior stakeholders to align infrastructure solutions with business objectives.
  • Communicate technical risks, dependencies, and infrastructure readiness to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives focused on reliability, security, scalability, and automation.
  • Participate in infrastructure design discussions and support architecture decision-making.

Skills & Experience

  • 7+ years of experience in DevOps, Cloud Infrastructure, Site Reliability Engineering, Platform Engineering, or related roles.
  • 3+ years of hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure in enterprise environments.
  • Strong experience with Azure DevOps for CI/CD pipeline implementation and deployment automation.
  • Advanced experience with Terraform and Infrastructure as Code (IaC).
  • Strong understanding of cloud networking, security architecture, identity, and access management.
  • Experience deploying and managing containerized applications using Docker and Kubernetes.
  • Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills within large-scale cloud environments.
  • Ability to work independently, manage competing priorities, and drive technical issues to resolution.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills with engineering teams, architects, and business stakeholders.

Set Yourself Apart With

  • Azure certifications such as AZ-104, AZ-305, AZ-400, or AZ-500.
  • Experience with Cloudflare, Redis Cache, API Management, or API Gateway technologies.
  • Experience supporting highly available, mission-critical production platforms at enterprise scale.
  • Exposure to monitoring and observability platforms such as Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, Application Insights, Grafana, or Prometheus.
  • Experience partnering directly with solution architects on cloud infrastructure strategy and platform modernization initiatives.

title: SharePoint & Power Platform Developer

title: Maintenance Helper - 1st Year
description:
Connect to a career at City Utilities! CU has been connecting our community to the services they need for every day life since 1945. From electricity to power our lives, clean water to be healthy, natural gas to stay warm, internet to keep businesses connected, to transit services to get them where they need to go.

Pay Details:

1st Year: $25.43/hour

2nd Year: $25.83

Thereafter: $26.24

Work Schedule:

Monday- Thursday or Tuesday -Friday, 6:30AM -5PM


Job Description:

PURPOSE OF POSITION:

Under the direction of the Supervisor – Power Generation Environmental or designee, assists with day-to-day operations of power generation facilities.

ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS:

1. Operates various pieces of equipment including but not limited to: dump truck, water truck, street sweeper, vacuum truck, backhoe, fork lift, brush hog/tractor and lawn maintenance equipment (including slope mower and hydroseeder).
2. Assists with cleaning of coal/ash handling facilities.
3. Performs minor maintenance and servicing of equipment utilized.
4. Performs minor facility repair including carpentry, 110/220-volt electric, and domestic plumbing. Paints equipment and building structures.
5. Assists with plant custodial duties on as needed basis.
6. Performs other related duties as required or assigned by management.
7. Works safely and encourages safe work of others.

QUALIFICATIONS:

Education and Experience:

Must have a high school diploma or equivalent. One or more years of recent experience in the operations and minor maintenance of industrial equipment is required. Experience operating hand and power tools is required. Power plant experience is preferred.

Licensing/Certification:

Must have a valid Missouri CDL, Class B including air brakes, OR:
a. The ability to obtain a Missouri Commercial Learner’s Permit (CLP) within six weeks of employment AND
b. The ability to obtain a CDL, Class B including air brakes within six months of employment. This requires approximately 15 hours (total) classroom training and completion of behind-the-wheel training (hours to be determined) as required by City Utilities.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:

  • Ability to:

    • Organize assigned work and perform it in a timely manner.

    • Work independently with minimal supervision.

    • Work courteously with customers and coworkers.

    • Show good judgment in decisions.

    • Maintain a clean working environment of assigned area.

    • Effectively utilize a range of digital tools and platforms, including but not limited to Microsoft Office Suite, enterprise software, artificial intelligence-enhanced applications, and self-service systems. Must possess a willingness and capacity to learn and adapt to emerging technologies, including mobile devices, cloud-based systems, and data-driven platforms relevant to utility operations.

  • Knowledge of

    • Power plant operations, safety procedures and guidelines.

    • Carpentry and minor electrical maintenance.

    • Custodial duties.

  • Dependability due to size of workforce.

  • Maintain adherence to all company policies.

Physical Requirements:

Physical requirements include: pushing, pulling, lifting 55 pounds regularly and up to 90 pounds occasionally, stooping, bending, working at heights, and being able to visually differentiate between color-coded electrical and electronic equipment associated with this job. Must be able to respond to audible and visual alarms, including safety and production alarms. Must be able to work within the rated capacity of the utility’s aerial lifts, ladders, fall restraint devices, and/or other job-related equipment.

Working Conditions:

Work is performed indoors and outdoors in all types of weather. Exposure to industrial plant atmosphere when working inside. Exposed to low and high voltages, heat, noise, and toxic chemicals. May be required to wear a respirator. Must be clean-shaven such that facial hair will not interfere with the respirator seal during annual fit testing of respiratory protection and when required to wear the respirator on the job.

Safety Sensitive Position:

A safety-sensitive position involves the performance of duties which may have a direct and immediate impact on the safety of the public and other public employees. This is a safety sensitive position.

Miscellaneous Requirements:

  • Subject to Department of Transportation’s Drug and Alcohol Testing Program requirements.

  • Required to wear uniform clothing provided by City Utilities, including flame retardant/arc rated clothing. Management retains the right to require replacement due to wear or staining.

  • Employee must remain alert and aware of their surroundings at all times and maintain the ability to respond to changing circumstances in a timely manner.

  • Must wear appropriate Personal Protective Equipment.

  • Shift work and/or overtime may be required.

  • Must be able to work successfully with diverse groups of people.

  • All eligible candidates must pass all applicable test which may include paper and practical tests.

TESTING

Testing may be required.

EEO

City Utilities offers equal employment opportunities to individuals without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, ancestry, national origin, disability, age, veteran status, genetic information or marital status. Learn more about CU and EEO.

title: Data Engineer - Airflow / AWS / Python
description:

Location: Madrid Spain

We are looking for an experienced Data Engineer with a minimum of 3 years' commercial experience to join our data engineering team. title: Credit Control Administrator
description:

title: Associate Director, Quality
location: Gaithersburg, Maryland, United States of America
description:
Job Title: Associate Director Quality

Introduction to role:

Are you ready to take on a pivotal role in ensuring the highest standards of quality management for our external suppliers? As an Associate Director Quality, you will be responsible for overseeing quality activities that support the execution of Quality Management for suppliers across various categories, including Formulation, Fill, Finish & Packing. Your role will involve managing quality systems, conducting supplier assessments, and interacting with regulatory agencies. You'll also serve as a subject matter expert, collaborating with cross-functional teams to drive process improvements and ensure compliance with GMP and regulatory requirements. Are you prepared to make a significant impact on our product supply chain?

Accountabilities:

  • Responsible for Quality Supplier Management including but not limited to: Annual Assessments; Quality Agreements; trending and reporting of data; assessing, reviewing and improving quality systems at Suppliers; attendance at Quality and Business Review Meetings.
  • Maintains a high level of understanding of relevant production processes and quality systems.
  • Performs the Quality review and/or approval of the following cGMP documentation for their Suppliers: Change Requests, Product Quality Reviews or Supplier Quality Review (DMS), CMC documentation (ERV) associated with changes or product establishment at Suppliers, Development and technology transfer documentation, along with Director, Supply and Quality Systems, EQ, Quality Investigations (Deviations, Product Quality Complaints), Validation Plans, Protocols and Reports.
  • Collaborates with and influences other Quality professionals across the organization to ensure consistent application and execution of key quality systems.
  • Responsible for quality issues escalation and resolution at the Suppliers, to ensure right product at the right time is delivered into the Product Supply Chain.
  • Proactively ensures GMP and regulatory compliance during the planning, execution and closeout phases of projects at their Supplier(s).
  • As a member of a Supplier Management team, responsible for supporting cost saving initiatives, value creation, performance standards, continuous improvements, and issue resolutions at their Supplier(s).
  • Collaborates with, and influences, other PCO/assigned area members to facilitate process improvements and risk assessments; benchmarks internal and external Quality practices to identify innovative efficient and effective practices.
  • Stays abreast of evolving regulatory compliance practices and recommends implementation strategies to EQ/AZ site leaders.
  • Collaborates in data analysis and report creation on quality metrics and key performance indicators.
  • Develops and maintains effective business relationships with Suppliers.
  • Specific to the support and management of External Quality QMS, may be responsible for one or more of the following: Site Stability Management System. Manages quality data and records in relevant quality management support systems (e.g. Veeva Vault etc) as required. Assist in the production of, or contribution to, AZ quality documentation (including EQ/EQ SOPs, Q & C Manual Procedures, etc). Participates in EQ self-inspection program, auditing processes and procedures.
  • Develops and maintains a high level of understanding of the technical production process and quality systems being utilized within the External Supply & Manufacturing (ESM) and External Quality (EQ) organisations. Accountable for Quality decision-making; works directly with the Supplier Management leader and other team members to deliver objectives. Ensures compliance with all GMP Compliance and Regulatory requirements by providing proper coaching, mentoring and consultation to the Supplier Management Team. Provides functional direction as required.
  • Planning for, supporting and participating in Regulatory Agency inspections of their Suppliers and AZ sites (regarding Quality management for supply of external materials to the Sites).
  • As needed, perform Quality Audits within their technology area, as a Guest Auditor on the GQA lead audit team.
  • Serve as EQ representative on Issue Management Teams.
  • Provide expert Quality input to NPI, Asset Strategy and/or Value Delivery projects. This includes identifying and assessing Suppliers, establishing Supplier’s way of working with External Quality and supporting the Supplier through to regulatory approval.
  • Liaise with Suppliers to ensure successful delivery of projects.
  • Make decisions and advise the Supplier Management Team regarding quality and pharmaceutical technology issues within their area of expertise.

Essential Skills/Experience:

  • Bachelor's degree in a science / technical field such as Pharmacy, Biology, Chemistry or Engineering (Note: there may be specific additional requirements depending on the regulations in each country).
  • Proven broad experience in either the pharmaceutical operations environment or pharmaceutical Quality Assurance role.
  • 10 years of experience in a similar role.
  • Strong demonstrated knowledge of cGMPs, Quality Systems and the pharmaceutical supply chain environment. Also, strong understanding of industry standards such as Pharmacopeia, ISO standards, etc.
  • Excellent oral and written communication skills [English and local language(s)].
  • Demonstrated experience working cross functionally and managing significant improvement initiatives (e.g. project management skills).
  • Strong problem-solving skills.
  • Strong negotiating/influencing skills.
  • Ability to work independently under his/her own initiative.
  • Ability to travel nationally and internationally as required up to 25% of their time.

Desirable Skills/Experience:

  • Experience working in a PCO/PET organization or Lean/Six Sigma training.
  • Multi-site / multi-functional experience.
  • Proven experience in Quality Assurance or combination of Quality and Technical.
  • Master's Degree in Quality Assurance/Regulatory Affairs or other advanced scientific field.

The annual base pay (or hourly rate of compensation) for this position ranges from 129,556.80 - 194,335.20 USD annual base salary. Hourly and salaried non-exempt employees will also be paid overtime pay when working qualifying overtime hours. Base pay offered may vary depending on multiple individualized factors, including market location, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. In addition, our positions offer a short-term incentive bonus opportunity; eligibility to participate in our equity-based long-term incentive program (salaried roles), to receive a retirement contribution (hourly roles), and commission payment eligibility (sales roles). title: BUSINESS & AI CONSULTANT INTERN

Paul Hype Page & Co. is seeking a Regional Business & Entrepreneurship Intern to gain first-hand exposure to how a regional professional services business operates and grows. This is not a conventional internship centred on routine administrative work or a narrowly defined job scope. The role is designed for individuals who are commercially curious, adaptable and interested in developing a broader understanding of business. You will work across different functions, contribute to real projects and gain exposure to areas such as operations, client management, business development, marketing, technology, process improvement and regional initiatives.

Key responsibilities

  • Develop a strong understanding of the firm's services, business model and internal operations.

  • Support cross-functional projects involving operations, client servicing, business development and internal improvement initiatives.

  • Conduct market, competitor and business research to support commercial decision-making.

  • Assist in identifying opportunities to improve internal processes and overall business efficiency.

  • Work with colleagues and clients across different markets and cultural backgrounds.

  • Support regional and cross-border initiatives where required.

  • Take ownership of assigned projects and contribute ideas beyond the immediate scope of work.

  • Strong willingness to learn and take on new challenges.

  • Adaptable and comfortable working outside a narrowly defined job scope.

Benefits

  • First-hand exposure to the operations of a regional professional services business.

  • Practical commercial and entrepreneurial experience.

  • Opportunities to work on meaningful projects rather than purely administrative assignments.

description:
About Fanatics Momentum
Fanatics Momentum is building the UAE's leading regulated commercial gaming operator. Licensed by the General Commercial Gaming Regulatory Authority (GCGRA), we operate across lottery, iGaming, sportsbook, and digital content, combining Momentum's regional foundation with Fanatics' global product, technology, and scale. The business is ambitious, well-resourced, and moving fast. If you want to help build a category-defining operator in one of the world's most exciting regulated gaming markets, this is the right time to join.

Lead Product Manager, Sportsbook

Overview

As Lead Product Manager, Sportsbook, you’ll own a substantial part of the Sportsbook proposition and help build a locally relevant sports wagering experience for the UAE. Your challenge: How do we build a Sportsbook that feels simple to new customers, powerful to experienced bettors and relevant to the sports people care about most?

You’ll combine customer insight, trading capability, commercial judgement and product craft to shape the roadmap and deliver meaningful improvements. You’ll work closely with Trading, Design, Engineering, Data and Commercial teams to bring the Sportsbook proposition to life.

The ideal candidate is a strong product thinker who can combine strategy and delivery, use behavioural data to make informed decisions and navigate ambiguity. You understand how to balance customer experience, commercial outcomes and the capabilities required to deliver a compelling Sportsbook.

What you’ll own:

  • Sportsbook strategy and roadmap within your domain
  • Sports, event and market discovery
  • Bet placement, betslip and bet tracking
  • Singles, multiples and Bet Builder
  • In-play and cash-out experiences
  • Recommendations, boosts and personalised discovery
  • Customer research, experimentation and delivery
  • Partnership with Trading on market depth, pricing and proposition

Within 12 months, you will have:

  • Established clear priorities across your Sportsbook domain
  • Improved discovery and bet placement journeys
  • Increased activation, frequency and retention
  • Shipped meaningful product improvements at pace
  • Built a strong Product, Trading, Design and Engineering partnership

Required Qualifications

  • 7+ years of Product Management experience with a strong track record building consumer digital products.
  • Direct Sportsbook experience is strongly preferred.
  • Experience combining product strategy and delivery in complex, fast-moving environments.
  • Experience using behavioural data, customer research and experimentation to inform product decisions.
  • Strong product craft across strategy, discovery, experimentation, analytics, consumer UX, prioritisation and commercial thinking.
  • Experience working effectively with technical and commercial partners, including Engineering, Design, Data and Trading.
  • Experience making product decisions in ambiguous environments and balancing competing customer and business needs.
  • Experience leveraging AI to accelerate analysis, research, documentation and experimentation.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in Sportsbook or trading, in-play wagering, Bet Builder, personalisation, or international regulated markets.

If you possess some of these qualifications but not all of them, we still encourage you to apply!

At Fanatics Momentum, we’re proud to be a fair, transparent, and inclusive employer. We value diversity, collaboration, and innovation, and we’re committed to creating an environment where every team member can thrive. If you’re ready to grow your career and help us build Momentum, we’d love to hear from you.

title: Clinical Pharmacy Specialist- Ambulatory Care
description:
Find your calling at Mercy!

Works with members of the health care team to provide safe and effective drug therapy. Serves as a drug information resource to pharmacy, nursing, and medical staffs as well as to patients. Performs duties and responsibilities in a manner consistent with our mission, values, and Mercy Service Standards.

Position Details:

Clinical Pharmacy Specialist - Ambulatory Care

📍 Mercy Springfield | Springfield, MO

Requirements & Qualifications

Education

  • Doctor of Pharmacy (PharmD) or Bachelor of Science in Pharmacy from an accredited School of Pharmacy

Licensure

  • Current Pharmacist license in the state of practice
  • Missouri pharmacists must obtain a Medication Therapy Services Certificate within 90 days of hire

Experience

  • Minimum of 5 years of active clinical practice in a specialty area
  • Ambulatory Care experience strongly preferred

Certifications

  • Active Board of Pharmacy Specialties (BPS) Certification preferred, ideally within specialty practice area
  • Candidates eligible to sit for the certification exam will also be considered

Preferred Qualifications

  • Five or more years of advanced clinical pharmacy experience
  • Completion of residency training preferred
  • Experience serving as a clinical preceptor for pharmacy students and residents
  • Recent scholarly activity, including:
    • Poster presentation at a state or national meeting within the last two years, and/or
    • Publication in a state or national journal
  • Teaching appointment with an affiliated healthcare college (pharmacy, nursing, medicine, or related field) preferred

Be Part of Something Greater

At Mercy, we believe healing begins with compassionate care and clinical excellence. As a Clinical Pharmacy Specialist - Ambulatory Care, you will work collaboratively with physicians, nurses, and interdisciplinary care teams to optimize medication therapy, improve patient outcomes, and serve as an expert resource for patients and healthcare professionals.

This advanced clinical role offers the opportunity to practice at the top of your license while contributing to education, quality improvement initiatives, and organizational excellence.

What You'll Do

Clinical Pharmacy Practice

  • Review patient records and evaluate medication therapy appropriateness
  • Develop and implement individualized medication treatment plans
  • Identify, prevent, and resolve medication-related problems
  • Monitor patient outcomes and adjust pharmacotherapy recommendations as needed
  • Conduct comprehensive medication assessments and Medication Therapy Services
  • Collaborate with physicians and healthcare providers on drug selection, dosing, administration, contraindications, and drug interactions
  • Provide medication counseling and education to patients and caregivers
  • Serve as a clinical resource and subject matter expert within ambulatory care practice areas

Interdisciplinary Collaboration

  • Partner with physicians, nurses, and care teams to ensure optimal patient outcomes
  • Participate in ministry-wide clinical initiatives, specialty councils, Pharmacy & Therapeutics committees, and quality improvement efforts
  • Maintain strong working relationships across departments and care settings

Education & Leadership

  • Serve as an active preceptor for pharmacy students and residents
  • Support continuing education through presentations, lectures, and staff training
  • Assist in developing staff competencies and clinical education programs
  • Contribute to scholarly and professional development activities

Quality, Safety & Compliance

  • Monitor medication use and intervene when clinically appropriate
  • Participate in medication use evaluations, adverse drug event reporting, and quality assurance initiatives
  • Support regulatory compliance and accreditation standards
  • Adhere to confidentiality, patient safety, and risk management policies

Technology & Documentation

  • Utilize Epic and pharmacy information systems for clinical documentation and order verification
  • Leverage clinical resources such as Micromedex and other drug information databases
  • Maintain accurate patient records and therapy documentation

What Makes You Successful

  • Strong clinical judgment and critical thinking skills
  • Passion for ambulatory patient care and medication optimization
  • Excellent communication and collaboration abilities
  • Commitment to continuous learning and professional growth
  • Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced healthcare environment
  • Dedication to Mercy's mission, values, and service standards

Why Mercy?

At Mercy, you'll join a caring team committed to transforming healthcare through compassion, innovation, and excellence. We offer the opportunity to make a meaningful impact on patients' lives while advancing your clinical expertise in a supportive and collaborative environment.

Apply today and help us bring healing through advanced pharmaceutical care.

Why Mercy?

From day one, Mercy offers outstanding benefits - including medical, dental, and vision coverage, paid time off, tuition support, and matched retirement plans for team members working 32+ hours per pay period.

Join a caring, collaborative team where your voice matters. At Mercy, you'll help shape the future of healthcare through innovation, technology, and compassion. As we grow, you'll grow with us.

Vem är du?

För att trivas i rollen är du en naturlig ledare som sprider positiv energi, även när tempot är högt. Du älskar struktur och logistik (vilket gör schemaläggningen till en rolig utmaning), men tappar aldrig det personliga mötet med gästen.

Vi tror att du har:

  • Tidigare erfarenhet av arbete i en hotellreception, gärna i en ledande eller ansvarsfull roll.

  • Flytande kunskaper i svenska och engelska, både i tal och skrift.

· Du är flexibel, stresstålig, brinner för god service, är ansvarsfull och jobbar för höga kvalitetsmål samt alltid ger ett glatt och positivt intryck. Vi ser gärna att du har erfarenhet från liknande utmaningar sedan tidigare. Ett plus är om du har kunskaper i systemet Infor, HMS eller andra hotellbokningssystem.

Vad vi erbjuder dig

Hos oss får du chansen att kliva in i en dynamisk miljö där din röst räknas. Du får stor möjlighet att påverka ditt eget arbete och receptionens framtid. Vi erbjuder en stöttande ledning, ett härligt team och goda utvecklingsmöjligheter inom hotellkedjan/hotellet.

Vi söker en tjänst på 100% , dag- och kvällsarbete samt helger. Varierande arbetstider förekommer.

title: Sr. Frontend Developer
description:
APPLY HERE FOR PRIORITY REVIEW & RESPONSE


IMPORTANT – PLEASE READ BEFORE APPLYING


If you want your application reviewed on priority and want a faster response, apply through the form above.


Please do not send emails or messages regarding your application. We have a structured recruitment system, and applications submitted through the form are processed on priority. You will receive a response whether your profile is shortlisted or not shortlisted.


Please read the complete JD carefully and fill out the application form accurately and thoughtfully. Your responses are an important part of our evaluation.


ARE YOU AN ELITE FRONTEND ENGINEER WHO CAN OWN MORE THAN JUST UI?

At Crebos, we’re not looking for someone who simply receives designs, converts them into screens, and completes tickets.


We’re looking for a Senior Frontend Developer with exceptional expertise in React.js and React Native, strong knowledge of the complete modern React ecosystem, AI proficiency, extreme ownership, product thinking, and a business-oriented mindset.


You should understand the customer problem, translate requirements into exceptional digital experiences, make strong technical decisions, anticipate risks, and take ownership from requirement clarification through production delivery.


At Crebos, we call these people our Spartans – elite performers who take ownership, raise standards, and make the entire team stronger.


ABOUT CREBOS INTERNATIONAL

Crebos is an international software development company headquartered in the Netherlands, working on innovative and complex digital products.


We believe in ownership, accountability, customer value, engineering excellence, business thinking, AI leverage, and continuous improvement.


THE MINDSET & TRAITS WE EXPECT

• Business Clarity – Understand why something is being built, the customer/business problem, and the value it should create.

• Success Definition – Clearly understand what “done” and successful mean before development starts.

• Scope Discipline – Understand requirements, dependencies, assumptions, and edge cases while avoiding unnecessary complexity.

• Extreme Ownership – Own outcomes end-to-end. Don't hide behind design, backend, QA, or requirements. Escalate blockers early and drive problems to resolution.

• Risk Awareness – Identify technical risks, UX issues, performance bottlenecks, integration dependencies, compatibility issues, and edge cases before they affect customers.

• Delivery Predictability – Make realistic commitments, communicate deviations early, and consistently deliver production-ready work.

• Systems Thinking – Build reusable components, scalable architecture, design systems, standards, and solutions rather than repeatedly solving the same problems.

• AI Leverage – Use AI effectively across development, debugging, testing, code reviews, research, documentation, refactoring, and automation to measurably improve speed and quality.

• Continuous Improvement – Turn bugs, feedback, and delivery lessons into better standards, processes, automation, and reusable solutions.


FRONTEND + PRODUCT + CUSTOMER EXPERIENCE MINDSET

Your responsibility does not end when the UI matches the design. The frontend is where customers experience the product.

You should naturally think about:

• User experience and customer journeys

• Pixel-accurate and responsive implementation

• Frontend architecture and reusable components

• Performance and Core Web Vitals

• Accessibility and usability

• Cross-browser and cross-device compatibility

• Mobile experience and platform differences

• State and data management

• API integration and error handling

• Loading, empty, failure, and edge states

• Security and frontend best practices

• Automated testing and maintainability

• Production monitoring and debugging

• Scalability and long-term technical quality


A feature should be fast, intuitive, responsive, reliable, accessible, maintainable, tested, and production-ready.


TECHNICAL EXPERTISE WE EXPECT

We need someone really solid in React.js, React Native, and the complete modern React ecosystem.


Strong practical knowledge of:

• React.js, React Native & Next.js

• JavaScript (ES6+) & TypeScript

• React Hooks and modern React patterns

• Redux / Redux Toolkit / Context API

• React Query / TanStack Query or similar tools

• Component architecture, reusable libraries, and design systems

• Storybook or similar component tooling

• HTML5, CSS3, responsive design, Flexbox and Grid

• Tailwind CSS, CSS Modules, Styled Components or similar approaches

• REST APIs and frontend/backend integration

• Authentication and authorization flows

• WebSockets and real-time functionality

• React Native navigation, native modules, permissions, deep linking, push notifications, and platform-specific behaviour

• Android and iOS build/release processes

• Jest, React Testing Library, and modern testing approaches

• Git, CI/CD, npm/yarn/pnpm, and modern build tooling

• Performance profiling, optimization, browser tools, and production debugging

• Basic cloud, deployment, CDN, caching, server, and production-environment understanding


KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

• Develop and maintain high-quality web and mobile applications using React.js, React Native, Next.js, JavaScript, and TypeScript.

• Build scalable frontend architecture and clean, reusable, maintainable components.

• Translate UI/UX designs into pixel-accurate, responsive, high-performance customer experiences.

• Develop production-grade React Native applications for iOS and Android.

• Integrate APIs, authentication, third-party services, analytics, and real-time functionality.

compatibility.

• Debug complex browser, mobile, integration, performance, and production issues and solve their root causes.

• Own frontend outcomes from requirement clarification and architecture through testing, deployment, and production.

• Collaborate with UI/UX, backend, QA, DevOps, product, and business teams.


WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

• 5+ years of strong frontend development experience.

• Deep production expertise in React.js and React Native.

• Strong experience with Next.js, JavaScript, TypeScript, modern React patterns, state management, and the broader React ecosystem.

• Strong understanding of frontend architecture, design systems, performance, security, accessibility, testing, and maintainability.

• Experience building responsive web applications and production-grade mobile applications.

• Strong understanding of API integration, authentication, state/data management, asynchronous workflows, and error handling.

• Ability to independently debug complex frontend, React Native, performance, integration, and production issues.

• Strong understanding of UI/UX, customer journeys, customer value, product thinking, and business outcomes.

• Proven ability to own complex frontend problems from requirements through production.

• Strong communication, mentoring, teamwork, and technical leadership skills.

AI PROFICIENCY IS IMPORTANT

AI is not optional for modern senior engineers at Crebos.


You should be highly proficient with AI-assisted development tools and use them effectively for development, debugging, testing, code reviews, research, documentation, automation, and problem-solving.


We want someone who can demonstrate measurable productivity and quality improvements through AI while still applying strong engineering judgment and independently validating AI-generated solutions.


AI should multiply your capability – not replace your technical understanding.


WHY JOIN CREBOS?

At Crebos, you’ll get an environment, platform, responsibility, and level of exposure designed to accelerate your growth beyond what you would typically experience in a conventional development role.

• High-Performance Environment – Work with people who value ownership, accountability, customer value, speed, and quality.

• Exceptional Growth Platform – Accelerate your technical, leadership, product, business, and professional growth.

• Real Ownership & Business Exposure – Don't just convert designs into screens. Understand the product, customer, and business and own outcomes.

• International Exposure – Be part of a Netherlands-headquartered organization working on international projects.

• AI-First Engineering Mindset – Use AI and modern technology to multiply your impact.

• Challenging Projects – Work on scalable applications across Fintech, SaaS, B2B, and other complex domains.

• Competitive Compensation & Growth – Competitive salary, annual appraisals, quarterly performance bonuses, and continuous learning opportunities.

• Employee Benefits – Best-in-class leave policies, team outings, daily family meal program, overtime compensation, and health insurance coverage up to ₹5 lakhs.

IMPORTANT NOTICE

• Full-time position based in Mohali, India (Hybrid options may be available for exceptional candidates).

• This role carries significantly higher expectations than a conventional frontend development position.

• We expect React.js & React Native excellence, extreme ownership, product thinking, customer orientation, business understanding, risk awareness, predictable delivery, systems thinking, AI proficiency, and continuous improvement.


We are not building an average engineering team. We are building a team of Spartans.

People who take ownership. Understand the business. Care deeply about customers. Think before they build. Identify risks early. Deliver what they commit to. Use AI to multiply their impact. And continuously raise the standards of themselves and everyone around them.


If you are looking only for a comfortable frontend job where you receive designs, develop screens, complete tickets, and move on, this may not be the right role for you.


But if you want to challenge yourself, accelerate your growth, take real ownership, build exceptional customer experiences, and become an elite frontend engineer and technical leader, Crebos will give you the platform to do it.

For any concerns relating to Republic Services’ commitment to equal opportunity employment, you may contact the AWARE Line at 1-866-3-AWARE-4.

ABOUT THE COMPANY

Republic Services, Inc. (NYSE: RSG) is a leader in the environmental services industry. We provide customers with the most complete set of products and services, including recycling, waste, special waste, hazardous waste and field services. Our industry-leading commitments to advance circularity and support decarbonization are helping deliver on our vision to partner with customers to create a more sustainable world.


In 2025, Republic’s total company revenue was $16.6 billion, and adjusted EBITDA was $5.3 billion. We serve 13 million customers and operate more than 1,000 locations, including collection and transfer stations, recycling and polymer centers, treatment facilities, and landfills.


Although we operate across North America, the collection, recycling, treatment, or disposal of materials is a local business, and the dynamics and opportunities differ in each market we serve. By combining local operational management with standardized business practices, we drive greater operating efficiencies across the company while maintaining day-to-day operational decisions at the local level, closest to the customer.


Our customers, including small businesses, major corporations and municipalities, want a partner with the expertise and capabilities to effectively manage their multiple recycling and waste streams. They choose Republic Services because we are committed to exceeding their expectations and helping them achieve their sustainability goals. Our 42,000 team members understand that it's not just what we do that matters, but how we do it.


Our company values guide our daily actions:

  • Safe: We protect the livelihoods of our colleagues and communities.
  • Committed to Serve: We go above and beyond to exceed our customers’ expectations.
  • Environmentally Responsible: We take action to improve our environment.
  • Driven: We deliver results in the right way.
  • Human-Centered: We respect the dignity and unique potential of every person.

We are proud of our high employee engagement score of 86. We have an inclusive and diverse culture where every voice counts. In addition, our team positively impacted 5.1 million people in 2024 through the Republic Services Charitable Foundation and local community grants. These projects are designed to meet the specific needs of the communities we serve, with a focus on building sustainable neighborhoods.


STRATEGY

Republic Services’ strategy is designed to generate profitable growth. Through acquisitions and industry advancements, we safely and sustainably manage our customers’ multiple waste streams through a North American footprint of vertically integrated assets.

We focus on three areas of growth to meet the increasing needs of our customers: recycling and waste, environmental solutions and sustainability innovation.

With our integrated approach, strengthening our position in one area advances other areas of our business. For example, as we grow volume in recycling and waste, we collect additional material to bolster our circularity capabilities. And as we expand environmental solutions, we drive additional opportunities to provide these services to our existing recycling and waste customers.


Recycling and Waste

We continue to expand our recycling and waste business footprint throughout North America through organic growth and targeted acquisitions. The 13 million customers we serve and our more than 5 million pick-ups per day provide us with a distinct advantage. We aggregate materials at scale, unlocking new opportunities for advanced recycling. In addition, we are cross-selling new products and services to better meet our customers’ specific needs.


Environmental Solutions

Our comprehensive environmental solutions capabilities help customers safely manage their most technical waste streams. We are expanding both our capabilities and our geographic footprint. We see strong growth opportunities for our offerings, including PFAS remediation, an increasing customer need.


Sustainability Innovation

Republic’s recent innovations to advance circularity and decarbonization demonstrate our unique ability to leverage sustainability as a platform for growth.


The Republic Services Polymer Center is the nation’s first integrated plastics recycling facility. These innovative sites process rigid plastics from our recycling centers, producing recycled materials that promote true bottle-to-bottle circularity. We also formed Blue Polymers, a joint venture with Ravago, to develop facilities that will further process plastic material from our Polymer Centers to help meet the growing demand for sustainable packaging. We are building a network of Polymer Centers and Blue Polymer facilities across North America.


Our customers are increasingly looking for decarbonization solutions, and we are leveraging our network of landfills to meet that need. Republic is committed to harnessing landfill gas, a natural byproduct of decomposing waste, and converting it to energy. Republic has partnered with renewable gas developers to construct Renewable Natural Gas (RNG) plants at our landfills, expanding beyond the 77 projects we currently have to make progress towards our goal to beneficially reuse 50% more biogas by 2030 (2017 baseline year).


RECENT RECOGNITION

  • Barron’s 100 Most Sustainable Companies
  • CDP Discloser
  • Dow Jones Best-In-Class Indices
  • Ethisphere’s World’s Most Ethical Companies
  • Fortune World’s Most Admired Companies
  • Great Place to Work
  • Sustainability Yearbook S&P Global

title: Editor in Chief-Quantum Science & Engineering
description:
Job Description:

We believe in bold ideas, diverse perspectives, and the drive to transform knowledge into impact. Here, your curiosity fuels progress, your voice shapes innovation, and your ambition helps redefine what’s possible within science and learning. We are a culture that obsesses over impact, challenges, and drives what’s next to power infinite possibilities for our customers, colleagues and society at large.

About the Role:

We are looking for a dynamic and ambitious Editor-in-Chief with a strong research background in quantum science and technology to lead Advanced Quantum Technologies.

This exciting role offers the opportunity to shape the scientific direction and strategic development of a leading interdisciplinary journal covering the rapidly evolving fields of quantum science, engineering, and technology.

The role combines scientific expertise, editorial experience, knowledge of the publishing landscape, and strong leadership, communication, and networking skills. The Editor-in-Chief will take overall responsibility for the journal’s editorial strategy and development, working closely with colleagues across Wiley to raise its profile and visibility, attract high-quality submissions, and strengthen its engagement with the international quantum research community.

The Editor-in-Chief is expected to participate actively in conferences, institute visits, and broader outreach activities, while overseeing manuscript assessment, peer review, and editorial decision-making. Ensuring the adoption of best practices and the highest standards of scientific quality, research integrity, and publication ethics will be a core responsibility of the role.


Job Responsibilities

  • Provide overall scientific, editorial, and strategic leadership for Advanced Quantum Technologies.
  • Develop and implement the journal’s editorial strategy from both scientific and publishing perspectives, in alignment with the objectives of the broader physical sciences journal portfolio.
  • Strengthen the journal’s scientific position, reputation, visibility, and influence within the international quantum research community.
  • Identify important and emerging research directions across quantum science and technology and translate these developments into editorial priorities and content-acquisition initiatives.
  • Drive the acquisition of high-quality research articles, reviews, perspectives, and other authoritative content through targeted commissioning, professional networks, and strategic outreach.
  • Develop special issues, special collections, and other editorial initiatives in collaboration with leading researchers, guest editors, editorial board members, and internal colleagues.
  • Establish and maintain strong relationships with authors, peer reviewers, editorial board members, research institutions, scientific societies, and other key stakeholders.
  • Build and engage an internationally representative editorial board that supports the journal’s scientific scope and strategic objectives.
  • Leverage subject-matter expertise, professional networks, awareness of developments in the field, and desk research to drive submissions growth and attract high-quality content.
  • Represent Wiley, Advanced Quantum Technologies, and the broader physical sciences portfolio at international conferences and through in-person and virtual outreach activities at universities and research institutes.
  • Oversee the editorial assessment of submitted manuscripts, manage the peer review process, and make fair, timely, and well-informed editorial decisions.
  • Ensure consistently high standards of scientific quality, editorial judgment, research integrity, publication ethics, and author service.
  • Monitor the journal’s editorial and market performance, identify opportunities and challenges, and develop effective plans to support its sustainable growth.
  • Collaborate closely with colleagues across editorial, publishing, marketing, communications, operations, and other departments to support the development of the journal and the wider portfolio.
  • Provide editorial leadership, guidance, and support to members of the journal team, fostering an inclusive, collaborative, and high-performing working environment.
  • Contribute to broader portfolio initiatives and support innovation in scholarly publishing, Open Access, Open Research, and research communication.

Required Skills and Experience

  • A PhD in quantum physics, quantum engineering, photonics, materials physics, electrical engineering, computer science, or another discipline closely related to quantum science and technology.
  • Relevant postdoctoral research experience in quantum science, quantum engineering, quantum technology, or a closely related area.
  • A strong research background and publication record, together with a deep understanding of the current quantum research landscape and its emerging directions.
  • Broad scientific knowledge across relevant areas, such as quantum computing, quantum information, quantum communication, quantum sensing, quantum simulation, quantum materials, quantum photonics, and quantum engineering.
  • Relevant editorial experience in scientific publishing, including experience in manuscript assessment, peer review management, editorial decision-making, content commissioning, or journal development.
  • A solid understanding of scholarly publishing processes, research integrity, publication ethics, and best practices in peer review.
  • The scientific credibility and communication skills required to engage confidently and effectively with leading researchers across the international quantum research community.
  • Strong strategic thinking and the ability to translate scientific and publishing developments into editorial priorities and practical journal-development plans.
  • Demonstrated ability to establish productive relationships with authors, reviewers, editorial board members, and other stakeholders.
  • Excellent leadership, communication, interpersonal, and networking skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to work effectively in a collaborative environment and to achieve results through personal influence, sound judgment, and active engagement.
  • A self-motivated, diplomatic, proactive, and flexible approach, with excellent organizational, prioritization, efficiency, and time-management skills.
  • An excellent command of written and spoken English, including the ability to communicate complex scientific and editorial matters clearly and confidently.
  • Familiarity with Open Access publishing models, Open Research practices, and current developments in scholarly communication.
  • Willingness to travel domestically or internationally to attend conferences, visit research institutions, and represent the journal and Wiley within the scientific community.
  • A keen interest in science and science communication, together with a strong motivation to promote innovation, integrity, inclusivity, and excellence in scholarly publishing.

What This Role Offers

This position provides an opportunity to lead the scientific and strategic development of Advanced Quantum Technologies and shape its future direction within the rapidly growing global quantum research landscape.

The successful candidate will work with an experienced international publishing team and engage directly with leading researchers, institutions, and scientific communities worldwide. The role also offers the opportunity to contribute to the broader development of Wiley’s physical sciences portfolio and to advance innovation and best practices in scholarly publishing.


We power infinite possibilities.


For more than 200 years, we've transformed knowledge into discoveries that shape the world. Today, our global team of innovators, creators, and experts is driving what's next in science, education, and publishing—creating impact that reaches everywhere.

We're not just observers of progress. We're the ones accelerating scientific breakthroughs, advancing learning, and sparking innovation that redefines entire fields and improves lives.


Here, your talent matters. Your ideas have room to grow. And your work creates breakthroughs that can change everything.

Wiley is an equal opportunity/affirmative action employer. We evaluate all qualified applicants and treat all qualified applicants and employees without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, genetic information, or based on any individual's status in any group or class protected by applicable federal, state or local laws. Wiley is also committed to providing reasonable accommodation to applicants and employees with disabilities. Applicants who require accommodation to participate in the job application process may contact tasupport@wiley.com for assistance.

We are proud that our workplace promotes continual learning and internal mobility. We offer meeting-free Friday afternoons allowing more time for heads down work and professional development, and through a robust body of employee programing we facilitate a wide range of opportunities to foster community, learn, and grow.

We are committed to fair, transparent pay, and we strive to provide competitive compensation in addition to a comprehensive benefits package. It is anticipated that most qualified candidates will fall within the range, however the ultimate salary offered for this role may be higher or lower and will be set based on a variety of non-discriminatory factors, including but not limited to, geographic location, skills, and competencies. Wiley proactively displays target base pay range for United Kingdom, Canada and USA based roles.

title: Senior Devops Engineer (Azure + Terraform)
description:

  • Build consistent and repeatable environments using Terraform and Infrastructure as Code (IaC).
  • Support containerized workloads using Docker and Azure Container Apps.
  • Drive infrastructure automation and operational improvements that increase reliability and delivery efficiency.

Security, Networking & Platform Services

  • Implement secure cloud environments using Network Security Groups (NSGs), Azure Key Vault, and secure access patterns.
  • Support API integrations through API Gateway and distributed cloud services.
  • Work with Cloudflare for edge security and traffic management.
  • Implement and support Redis Cache for application performance and scalability.

CI/CD & Production Delivery

  • Support end-to-end production deployment processes, ensuring environments are ready, secure, and reliable.
  • Troubleshoot infrastructure and deployment issues and proactively drive blockers and dependencies to resolution.

Collaboration & Technical Ownership

  • Partner with developers, platform teams, architects, and senior stakeholders to align infrastructure decisions with business and delivery needs.
  • Communicate infrastructure risks, dependencies, and environment readiness clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement across cloud reliability, security, scalability, and automation.

Skills & Experience

  • 6–8+ years of experience in DevOps, Cloud Infrastructure, Platform Engineering, or related roles.
  • Strong hands-on experience with Azure architecture and cloud infrastructure.
  • Advanced experience with Terraform / Infrastructure as Code.
  • Hands-on experience with Docker and Azure Container Apps or similar container platforms.
  • Strong understanding of cloud networking and security, including NSGs and Key Vault.
  • Experience with GitHub Actions and CI/CD automation.
  • Experience with API Gateway, Cloudflare, and Redis is highly valuable.
  • Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills in complex enterprise environments.
  • Ability to work independently, manage dependencies, and drive technical issues to resolution.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, including the ability to work with architects and senior stakeholders.

Set Yourself Apart With

  • Experience supporting healthcare or pharmacy platforms.
  • Familiarity with healthcare cloud environments (HCP) and regulated enterprise environments.
  • Experience working with complex security, privacy, and compliance requirements.
  • Exposure to highly available, production-critical applications at enterprise scale.
  • Experience partnering directly with architects on cloud infrastructure and deployment strategy.
  • Strong understanding of cloud security and infrastructure best practices.

ABOUT THE COMPANY

Republic Services, Inc. (NYSE: RSG) is a leader in the environmental services industry. We provide customers with the most complete set of products and services, including recycling, waste, special waste, hazardous waste and field services. Our industry-leading commitments to advance circularity and support decarbonization are helping deliver on our vision to partner with customers to create a more sustainable world.


In 2025, Republic’s total company revenue was $16.6 billion, and adjusted EBITDA was $5.3 billion. We serve 13 million customers and operate more than 1,000 locations, including collection and transfer stations, recycling and polymer centers, treatment facilities, and landfills.


Although we operate across North America, the collection, recycling, treatment, or disposal of materials is a local business, and the dynamics and opportunities differ in each market we serve. By combining local operational management with standardized business practices, we drive greater operating efficiencies across the company while maintaining day-to-day operational decisions at the local level, closest to the customer.


Our customers, including small businesses, major corporations and municipalities, want a partner with the expertise and capabilities to effectively manage their multiple recycling and waste streams. They choose Republic Services because we are committed to exceeding their expectations and helping them achieve their sustainability goals. Our 42,000 team members understand that it's not just what we do that matters, but how we do it.


Our company values guide our daily actions:

  • Safe: We protect the livelihoods of our colleagues and communities.
  • Committed to Serve: We go above and beyond to exceed our customers’ expectations.
  • Environmentally Responsible: We take action to improve our environment.
  • Driven: We deliver results in the right way.
  • Human-Centered: We respect the dignity and unique potential of every person.

We are proud of our high employee engagement score of 86. We have an inclusive and diverse culture where every voice counts. In addition, our team positively impacted 5.1 million people in 2024 through the Republic Services Charitable Foundation and local community grants. These projects are designed to meet the specific needs of the communities we serve, with a focus on building sustainable neighborhoods.


STRATEGY

Republic Services’ strategy is designed to generate profitable growth. Through acquisitions and industry advancements, we safely and sustainably manage our customers’ multiple waste streams through a North American footprint of vertically integrated assets.

We focus on three areas of growth to meet the increasing needs of our customers: recycling and waste, environmental solutions and sustainability innovation.

With our integrated approach, strengthening our position in one area advances other areas of our business. For example, as we grow volume in recycling and waste, we collect additional material to bolster our circularity capabilities. And as we expand environmental solutions, we drive additional opportunities to provide these services to our existing recycling and waste customers.


Recycling and Waste

We continue to expand our recycling and waste business footprint throughout North America through organic growth and targeted acquisitions. The 13 million customers we serve and our more than 5 million pick-ups per day provide us with a distinct advantage. We aggregate materials at scale, unlocking new opportunities for advanced recycling. In addition, we are cross-selling new products and services to better meet our customers’ specific needs.


Environmental Solutions

Our comprehensive environmental solutions capabilities help customers safely manage their most technical waste streams. We are expanding both our capabilities and our geographic footprint. We see strong growth opportunities for our offerings, including PFAS remediation, an increasing customer need.


Sustainability Innovation

Republic’s recent innovations to advance circularity and decarbonization demonstrate our unique ability to leverage sustainability as a platform for growth.


The Republic Services Polymer Center is the nation’s first integrated plastics recycling facility. These innovative sites process rigid plastics from our recycling centers, producing recycled materials that promote true bottle-to-bottle circularity. We also formed Blue Polymers, a joint venture with Ravago, to develop facilities that will further process plastic material from our Polymer Centers to help meet the growing demand for sustainable packaging. We are building a network of Polymer Centers and Blue Polymer facilities across North America.


Our customers are increasingly looking for decarbonization solutions, and we are leveraging our network of landfills to meet that need. Republic is committed to harnessing landfill gas, a natural byproduct of decomposing waste, and converting it to energy. Republic has partnered with renewable gas developers to construct Renewable Natural Gas (RNG) plants at our landfills, expanding beyond the 77 projects we currently have to make progress towards our goal to beneficially reuse 50% more biogas by 2030 (2017 baseline year).

  • Ethisphere’s World’s Most Ethical Companies
  • Fortune World’s Most Admired Companies

description:
Enterprise is a national nonprofit that exists to make a good home possible for the millions of families without one.
