Job Description Summary

The Development Risk Management, Director will manage construction risk for affordable housing projects developed with Low-Income Housing Tax Credits (LIHTC). The principal goal is to monitor construction progress, identify and help resolve issues as they arise, and support the successful completion and long-term viability of projects as low-income housing.

Preferred location is Columbia, MD; however, other locations may be considered based on the candidate’s experience and specific job responsibilities.

Job Description

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Architecture, Engineering, Construction Management, or equivalent experience is required; master’s degree a plus.
  • Registered Architect or Professional Engineer preferred.
  • 2–6 years of related experience with increasing levels of responsibility, preferably including on-site construction oversight.
  • 2 or more years of Development Risk Management experience with LIHTC funds.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage a wide variety of construction-related individuals, issues, and situations.
  • Solid understanding of the standards, processes, and challenges specific to the development of affordable housing preferred
  • Knowledge of and experience with green building standards helpful.
  • Familiarity with local and regional housing/building agencies and contractors.
  • Ability to work effectively in a team environment.
  • Highly motivated with the ability to work independently.
  • Advanced oral and written communication skills.
  • Highest level of professional integrity.

Job Description

  • Oversee the collection and review of monthly inspection reports, evaluation of proposed change orders, and review of other construction information for projects in the development phase.
  • Participate in the preparation and upfront review of construction-related due diligence, including contracts, plans and specifications, and development team qualifications, to support underwriting.
  • Continually evaluate the construction portfolio to identify projects with emerging or existing issues. Coordinate with internal teams to assess impacts and develop solutions that incorporate appropriate mitigation strategies, including cost considerations.
  • Proactively identify issues that may arise during the construction phase, including cost overruns, construction delays, design problems, sponsor/general partner issues, contractor concerns, governmental agency matters, financing difficulties, utility constraints, severe weather, environmental conditions, and other development-related issues.
  • Facilitate resolution of disputes among stakeholders (General Partner, General Contractor, vendors and agencies).
  • Provide support and guidance to asset management staff, as needed, to help resolve construction and development issues on stabilized projects.
  • Provide written quarterly summaries of issues and progress against strategy for development projects identified as on, or potentially headed for, the watchlist.
  • Interface with proprietary investors to communicate construction risk updates, address project-level questions, and support alignment on mitigation strategies and project performance.
  • Work collaboratively with internal teams, including regional asset management, finance, workouts, credit, accounting, underwriting, and other specialized teams, to address problem projects across all stages of the project life cycle.

Please note this position requires periodic travel to job sites throughout the continental United States (approximately 10%) and intermittent travel to company functions (1–2 times per year).

Salary Transparency

You will be joining a team of talented professionals motivated by serving the community and addressing the need for affordable housing.

Enterprise offers a comprehensive total rewards package for you and your family. The pay range for this position is $135,000-$160,000. The salary range represents the low and high end of what may be paid for this position. It is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the pay range, and compensation decisions may be influenced by a variety of factors, including skills, qualifications, experience, and location.

Total Rewards at Enterprise

This range is just one component of our total rewards package, which also includes annual performance bonuses and generous paid leave programs.

Our benefits form a major part of the total rewards package. These include dental, health, and vision care plans, as well as family-building benefits such as adoption and surrogacy support. Enterprise supports flexible work arrangements to promote work-life balance and offers health advocacy, an Employee Assistance Program (EAP), and mental health benefits. We round out our package with financial education, wellness programs, and auto-enrollment in the company’s 401(k) plan with employer matching contributions.

Finally, you will have access to learning and development opportunities, including tuition reimbursement for job-related courses and certifications. Thank you for your interest in joining the Enterprise team and contributing to our mission to serve others.

Review high-impact business analyses prior to stakeholder delivery to identify methodological errors, data quality anomalies, or improper join logic.

Perform root-cause analysis on pipeline failures, missing data transformations, and downstream propagation breaks, coordinating fixes through engineering backlogs.

Serve as the technical consultative link between identity platform capabilities, core data engineering teams, and enterprise business analysts.

Define, track, and automate repeatable quality assurance checks across cloud data lakes and distributed data sharing feeds.

SQL & Data Profiling: Advanced SQL mastery for complex join logic, data lineage tracing, data validation, and source-to-visual reconciliation.

Programming & Processing: Python and PySpark for data transformation, pipeline troubleshooting, and automated quality validation.

Data Architecture & Governance: Medallion architecture (Bronze/Silver/Gold), Delta Lake / Delta Share, Data Contracts, and Data Lineage tooling.

Pipeline Diagnostics: Diagnostic troubleshooting across cloud data warehouses, ETL/ELT pipelines, and distributed data environments.

Documentation & Tooling: Confluence, Atlan, Jira, or enterprise data catalog and data dictionary management platforms.

Nice to Have

Prior experience in automotive, digital marketing, or customer data platform (CDP) environments.

Exposure to applied data science methodologies, predictive analytics, or identity resolution graph algorithms.

Experience working in client-facing technical delivery or data consulting roles within enterprise accounts.

Soft Skills

Advanced English proficiency (written and verbal).

Exceptional stakeholder communication skills with the ability to explain complex technical data anomalies to non-technical business leaders.

Meticulous attention to detail and a high standard for data accuracy and reliability.

Strong analytical problem-solving mindset with high technical curiosity and self-direction.

Collaborative mindset capable of bridging gaps between engineering, product, and business analytics teams.

description:

If you are a current Staff, Faculty or Temporary employee at the University of Miami, please click here to log in to Workday to use the internal application process. To learn how to apply for a faculty or staff position, please review this tip sheet.

Coral Recruit Technician – Research Associate I

Coral Reef Futures Lab

The Coral Recruit Technician is an integral part of the University of Miami’s Land-Based Coral Facility team at The Rosenstiel School on Virginia Key, FL. This position supports reef research and restoration conducted by the Coral Reef Futures Lab. Specifically, the coral recruit technician carries out the sexual propagation and subsequent care of Caribbean coral juveniles within the lab’s aquaculture facility and research spaces. This is a key period in coral development during which the employee’s attention to detail, drive, and determination contribute directly to the production and survival of coral recruits.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Assist with the production, rearing, and outplanting of sexually derived coral recruits
  • Perform daily husbandry and maintain aquarium systems. Monitor coral health to identify and address issues as they arise.
  • Coordinate daily and weekly husbandry activities, including developing and assigning tasks to student volunteers. Must adhere to and instruct based on standard operating procedures for coral systems.
  • Assist with the diagnosis and resolution of plumbing, electrical, and other operational issues associated with aquarium systems.
  • Coordinate with graduate students and other staff in the Coral Reef Futures Lab to support ongoing research efforts.
  • Respond as a team member to system equipment failures in an on-call capacity, with the ability to think critically to diagnose and resolve issues in coordination with other team members.
  • Participate in evening and nighttime coral spawning, fertilization, and larval care activities, with occasional work schedule changes to work on weekends or public holidays to accommodate these activities during the spawning season.

Requirements & qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in marine biology, environmental science, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
  • U.S. citizenship, or valid U.S. work authorization.
  • Knowledge of coral biology, aquaculture, marine science, and/or related fields.
  • Strong organizational and interpersonal skills.
  • Ability to communicate effectively and professionally with team members, researchers, and members of the public.
  • Accountability and attention to detail, particularly when working with living organisms and time-sensitive husbandry needs.
  • Ability to troubleshoot and communicate or delegate tasks effectively.
  • Ability to work for several hours a day in outdoor shadehouse facilities in South Florida, which can be particularly warm and humid during the summer.

Preferred qualifications/competencies:

  • Experience with coral spawning and rearing sexually derived coral recruits
  • Experience with saltwater aquaria, coral husbandry, life support systems, and/or water quality
  • AAUS Scientific Diving certification
  • MOCC Boating certification

Work Environment:

Although this position includes work with indoor systems, laboratories, and spawning tanks, most time will be spent at the outdoor land-based coral facility. Additional opportunities exist to support field efforts. South Florida weather can be unpredictable and at times extreme, and consequently sun-protective clothing and head coverage via sunhat or hooded shirt are required. Employees should be prepared to work up to 4-5 hours at a time outdoors, and on occasion outside of the regular work week, being accountable for responding to equipment alerts, and involvement in nighttime spawning activities. Position occasionally involves physically demanding duties, including lifting and transporting items weighing up to 50 pounds.

The University of Miami is recognized as one of the nation’s premier research institutions and academic health systems and is among the largest employers in South Florida.

With more than 20,000 faculty and staff, the University is committed to excellence and guided by a mission to positively impact the lives of students, patients, and communities locally and globally.

We are dedicated to fostering a culture where every individual feels valued and empowered to contribute meaningfully. United by shared values, the University community works together to build an environment defined by purpose, collaboration, and service.

title: Business Analyst 3 (Contractor) - 529701783R
description:
RESPEC is seeking a Business Analyst 3 where you will play a central role in one of Texas's largest public health agencies as it modernizes how it uses data to make decisions. You'll serve as the critical link between business stakeholders and technical teams — translating complex data and process challenges into clear requirements that drive real improvements in how the agency serves Texans. If you thrive on digging into raw data, mapping business processes, and turning ambiguity into actionable documentation, this role puts you right at the center of that work.

Core Responsibilities

You'll review, analyze, and evaluate business systems and evolving user needs, shaping solutions that align with the organization's broader strategic goals. Expect to lead requirements-elicitation sessions with stakeholders across the business and IT, document current-state and future-state process flows, and dive deep into relational databases using SQL to profile, validate, and investigate data. You'll write clear Business Requirements Documents (BRDs), functional specifications, and data dictionaries, while also defining KPIs and metrics that reporting and analytics teams can build on. Along the way, you'll support gap analysis between where the business is today and where it needs to be, and you'll help drive User Acceptance Testing by developing test scenarios grounded in the requirements you've documented.

Required Technical Experience

10+ years: Strong written and verbal communication skills, paired with a bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Information Systems, or a related field (equivalent work experience will be considered in lieu of a degree).

8+ years across each of the following:

  • Business Analyst / Business Data Analyst experience gathering, analyzing, and documenting requirements within enterprise IT environments, including state government or large-enterprise settings following formal SDLC methodologies.
  • Analyzing and documenting current-state ("as-is") and future-state ("to-be") business processes and data flow diagrams.
  • Data analysis and documentation, including profiling, validation, and definition of data elements and business rules.
  • Hands-on, complex SQL work — queries, joins, and aggregations — to analyze and validate data directly against relational databases.
  • Facilitating workshops, interviews, and stakeholder sessions to elicit and validate requirements.
  • Translating business needs into functional and data requirements documents and BRDs for technical teams.
  • Defining and documenting business metrics and KPIs, and partnering with reporting/analytics teams on report specifications and data sourcing.
  • Performing gap analysis between current and desired future-state outcomes.
  • Supporting UAT, including building test scenarios and test cases from documented requirements.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with data governance initiatives, source-to-target mapping, and data lineage documentation will make you stand out.
  • A PMP certification or hands-on project management experience is a strong plus, as is a background supporting enterprise reporting and analytics programs in large or government organizations.

Work Model

This role follows a hybrid schedule based out of the agency's Austin office at 701 W. 51st Street, Austin, TX 78751 — with two remote days (Tuesdays and Thursdays) and three days on-site each week.

Please note: this position is restricted to candidates who currently reside in the Austin, Texas area.

Standard business hours are Monday through Friday, 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM CT, with occasional evening/weekend work possible on a pre-approved basis.

title: Director, Digital Customer Experience, Neuroscience
description:
Title:

Director, Digital Customer Experience, Neuroscience

Company:

Ipsen Biopharmaceuticals Inc.


About Ipsen:

Ipsen is a mid-sized global biopharmaceutical company with a focus on transformative medicines in three therapeutic areas: Oncology, Rare Disease and Neuroscience. Supported by nearly 100 years of development experience, with global hubs in the U.S., France and the U.K, we tackle areas of high unmet medical need through research and innovation.

Our passionate teams in more than 40 countries are focused on what matters and endeavor every day to bring medicines to patients in 88 countries. We build a workplace that champions human-centric leadership and fosters a culture of collaboration, excellence and impact. At Ipsen, every individual is empowered to be their true selves, grow and thrive alongside the company’s success. Join us on our journey towards sustainable growth, creating real impact on patients and society!

For more information, visit us at and follow our latest news on LinkedIn and Instagram.

Job Description:

Ipsen’s Neuroscience franchise has been expanding through both organic growth and in preparation for a potential launch in migraine. There is a critical need for excellence in both strategic planning and in execution to clearly define how we will best drive education of appropriate healthcare providers, deliver successful launches, and innovate for patients in complex and competitive therapeutic areas.

The Director, Digital Customer Experience (Omnichannel Marketing), Neuroscience is a critical member of the marketing team, responsible for defining and executing the digital approach and omnichannel engagement strategy/execution across the portfolio, which includes current approved indications for Dysport and potential approval for preventive treatment of migraine.

This role leads and manages digital assets, tools, and omnichannel engagement to deliver measurable business impact, including:

  • Creation and management of compelling assets to drive engagement and action
  • Orchestration of integrated customer experiences across personal, non-personal, and digital channels for healthcare providers, patients, and caregivers
  • Measurement, assessment and optimization of these experiences to ensure ongoing effectiveness and impact

This role requires deep expertise in omnichannel marketing, marketing technology, data and analytics, and campaign orchestration, as well as the ability to partner with brand teams and cross-functional partners to translate brand strategy into seamless engagement. The ideal candidate will have a strategic mindset, appreciation of good creative, strong technical/analytical skills, and a passion for using channel innovation to make a difference in the lives of patients and the HCPs who treat them.

Main Responsibilities

Asset, Platform & Capability Management

  • Own the strategy, development, prioritization, and lifecycle management of omnichannel assets, platforms, and related customer engagement capabilities across the U.S. Neuroscience portfolio.
  • Develop differentiated digital capabilities that enable personalized customer engagement, including segmentation, next-best-action decisions, patient identification, and other emerging engagement capabilities.
  • Partner across internal teams and external agencies to define requirements, implement new capabilities, and continuously optimize the omnichannel technology ecosystem.
  • Ensure all omnichannel assets, tools, and content are compliant with Medical, Legal, and Regulatory (MLR) requirements and governed through effective review, approval, and lifecycle management processes.

Omnichannel Strategy, Orchestration & Execution

  • Develop omnichannel engagement strategies by defining customer segmentation, engagement objectives, communication strategies, and channel roles aligned to brand priorities.
  • Design integrated customer journeys that seamlessly connect personal, non-personal, and digital channels to deliver differentiated customer experiences.
  • Translate brand strategy into the execution of coordinated omnichannel engagement plans, aligning content, channels, and timing to maximize customer impact.

Measurement, Analytics & Optimization

  • Establish omnichannel measurement frameworks, KPIs, and end-to-end analytics to evaluate performance, engagement, and business impact.
  • Champion identification of observations, implications,, and insights to optimize channel investment, content, customer journeys, and overall omnichannel strategy
  • Continuously lead required optimizations based on this learning
  • Drive governance, prioritization, and alignment between Marketing, Sales and other relevant cross-functional partners
  • Communicate and influence effectively at the executive level, including business reviews and leadership updates.

HOW - Knowledge & Experience

Knowledge & Experience (essential):

  • 12+ years of commercial pharma experience, including U.S. omnichannel/digital roles in neuroscience and/or specialty markets. Toxin/migraine experience highly desirable.
  • Proven success defining and executing portfolio digital and omnichannel strategies and tactics to strengthen customer engagement and drive measurable business impact
  • Extensive experience leading external agencies (media and creative) and managing significant budgets
  • Deep expertise in marketing technology, CRM, content operations, and modular/personalized content
  • Strong data and analytics capability, including closed-loop measurement and channel ROI optimization
  • Experience deploying patient finding tools and digital capabilities
  • Experience with major marketing technology platforms (e.g., CRM, marketing automation, CDP, and Veeva/Salesforce ecosystems)
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills along with the ability to influence others
  • Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functionally and influence senior stakeholders
  • Mentally agile and solutions-oriented, with the ability to navigate ambiguity, adapt quickly, and drive practical solutions in a dynamic environment
  • Ability to work with multiple internal cross-functional teams and successfully manage multiple projects simultaneously
  • Knowledge of regulations associated with promotion and industry-supported scientific education activities.
  • Working within an environment of strict compliance to all appropriate regulatory guidelines

Education / Certifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree (BA/BS) required

Language(s) (essential):

  • Fluent in English.

Compensation

The annual base salary range for this position is $190,500 - $270,000

This job is eligible to participate in our short-term incentives program. At Ipsen we are proud to offer a comprehensive employee benefits package, including 401(k) with company contributions, group medical, dental and vision coverage, life and disability insurance, short- and long-term disability insurance, as well as flexible spending accounts. Ipsen also provides parental leave, paid time off, a discretionary winter shutdown, well-being allowance, commuter benefits, and much more.

The pay range displayed above is the range of base pay compensation within which Ipsen expects to pay for this role at the time of this posting. Individual compensation within this range depends on a variety of factors, including, but not limited to, prior education and experience, job-related knowledge and demonstrated skills.

This means we also want to help you perform at your best when applying for a role with us. title: Bell Attendant
description:
Pyramid Global Hospitality is a leading hospitality management company with a portfolio of more than 200 hotels and resorts and over 18,000 associates across the United States, Caribbean, and Europe. Our platform includes Benchmark Resorts & Hotels, a collection of distinctive independent properties; Axiom Hospitality, our European hotel management company; and PYRAMIDWORKS, which provides integrated workplace and facilities services. With corporate offices in Boston, The Woodlands, Texas, and London, Pyramid combines global scale with a hands-on approach focused on exceptional service, operational excellence, and long-term partnerships.


At Pyramid, our people are at the heart of everything we do. We are committed to creating an environment where associates are respected, supported, and empowered to grow their careers. Team members have the opportunity to collaborate directly with experienced leaders, take on meaningful stretch assignments, and gain exposure to a diverse portfolio of properties, brands, and markets. Whether you are beginning your hospitality career or bringing years of experience, you'll find opportunities to learn, develop, and make an impact.


Our commitment to associates, guests, owners, and the communities we serve has helped make Pyramid and our properties among the most recognized in hospitality. From being named among the best places to work by respected publications such as USA Today, The Boston Globe, and The Houston Chronicle to earning top travel accolades from Travel + Leisure, Condé Nast Traveler, Forbes Travel Guide, and U.S. News & World Report, these recognitions reflect the culture, service excellence, and commitment to people that define the Pyramid experience.

About our property:

Skamania Lodge is a Pacific Northwest resort set on 175 acres, featuring treehouses, glamping, golf, ziplining, a spa, and multiple restaurants. With over 22,000 sq. ft. of event space, it’s a premier destination for retreats, conferences, and celebrations.

#PGH-SKL

What you will have an opportunity to do:

We are looking for a highly motivated individuals to join our Guest Services team as a Bell Attendant. The ideal candidate uses their engaging personality to create a memorable first impression for our guests as they arrive for the first time and throughout their stay. In offering a warm welcome to our hotel/resort, the Bell Attendant assists with the unloading of guest’s luggage and provides a source of knowledge for the guest for everything about the hotel, its amenities, and the local area as they assist the guest to their room.


If you are a person who enjoys engaging with people from all over the world and making meaningful connections, as well as taking steps to “WOW” people, we want you! This is a tremendous opportunity for a driven person to grow a career in hospitality with a world-class property.


Your Role:

  • Help guests discover their “Wanderlust” experience
  • Provide exceptional customer service by being engaging and taking sincere interest
  • Interacts with all guests. The bell person/ guest services attendant will welcome each guest to our hotel.
  • If guests are arriving by motor vehicle, you will open their door as you welcome them to the resort/hotel
  • You will be escorting and orienting the guest to the front desk for check-in.
  • Upon check-in, you will escort the guests and their luggage to their room. As you do so, you will be explaining our amenities and fun facts they should know about our hotel.
  • You will be working together with other attendants to ensure each guest has a personalized experience and will “dive" to open the door for all guests.
  • Assist lobby attendant in keeping entrance area clean and organized
  • "Be the difference" with all guest and employees and do more than just “the norm".

What are we looking for?

Qualifications:

  • At least one year in a customer service role with high guest interaction
  • Hospitality industry experience is a plus.
  • Ability to solve problems when they arise.
  • Ability to work in a team environment is a must.
  • Pleasant and helpful personality.
  • Must be able to work a full shift standing and going back and forth to the valet lot and different areas of the hotel.
  • A strong desire to make an impact on other people
  • An outgoing and engaging personality
  • Excellent verbal communication skills
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced setting
  • Ability to stand for the duration of the shift
  • Must be available to work various shifts including weekends and holidays

Compensation:

$17.13 +Tips!

-

$17.13 +Tips!

Pyramid Global Hospitality is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

Actual compensation packages are based on a wide array of factors unique to each candidate, including but not limited to skill set, years & depth of experience, certifications and specific office location. This may differ in other locations due to cost of labor considerations.

Position Specific Summary

The Recreation Assistant supports the daily operation of City of Tucson Parks and Recreation facilities and assists with the delivery of recreation programs, activities, classes, special events, and services for children, youth, adults, and seniors. Responsibilities include customer service, program and facility support, registrations and payments, recordkeeping, facility opening and closing, safety inspections, and coordination with participants, community partners, and other City staff.

Recreation Assistants may provide task-level assistance to non-permanent employees, interns, and volunteers but do not supervise employees.

Work is performed under the supervision of the Recreation Coordinator. This position does not supervise.

Duties and Responsibilities

  • Answers phones, greets customers, and responds to questions regarding programs, memberships, reservations, facility schedules, fees, rules, and services. Processes registrations, reservations, memberships, and payments using recreation management, point-of-sale, and other computer systems. title: Data Platform Engineer
description:
We're Hiring: Data Platform Engineer!

We are seeking an experienced Data Platform Engineer to design, build, optimize, and support modern analytics platforms and lakehouse solutions. You will play a key role in developing scalable data pipelines, optimizing distributed query workloads, and supporting enterprise analytics platforms across a high-performance data ecosystem. Candidates should possess deep expertise in modern data architectures, MPP platforms, and large-scale analytical processing.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and optimize enterprise data platforms and analytics solutions.
  • Build and maintain scalable data pipelines and lakehouse architectures.
  • Support and optimize MPP query engines, data warehouses, and distributed processing environments.
  • Drive performance tuning, platform modernization, and workload optimization initiatives.
  • Collaborate with architects, analysts, and engineering teams to deliver reliable and scalable data solutions.
  • Support platform automation, CI/CD, governance, and operational best practices.
  • Troubleshoot complex data platform issues and ensure operational excellence.

General Qualifications

  • Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Data Engineering, or a related discipline.
  • 7-8+ years of experience in Data Engineering, Analytics Engineering, Data Platforms, or Big Data ecosystems.
  • Experience working in enterprise-scale analytics and data environments.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and stakeholder management skills.

Mandatory Skills

  • Hands-on experience with Apache Doris (or similar MPP platforms such as StarRocks, ClickHouse, or Greenplum).
  • Advanced SQL development and query optimization skills.
  • Strong understanding of Apache Doris architecture, data models, partitioning, and performance tuning.
  • Experience with Apache Iceberg, Delta Lake, or Apache Hudi.
  • Experience with Snowflake and/or Apache Spark.
  • Hands-on experience with Trino, PrestoSQL, or Presto.
  • Solid knowledge of MPP/distributed query processing, performance optimization, and data architecture concepts.
  • Experience working with cloud object storage, Parquet, and ORC file formats.
  • Proficiency in Python, Java, or Scala.
  • Experience with Git and CI/CD pipelines for data platforms.

POSITION DESCRIPTION:

The Director of Alumni Relations provides strategic leadership for the design, implementation, and implementation of the university's comprehensive alumni engagement program. Operating with a small unit, this role balances high-level vision with direct, hands-on execution to connect a diverse alumni base with Southern Oregon University. Reporting to the Vice President of University Advancement and Director of the SOU Foundation, the Director is responsible for building lifelong affinity, increasing volunteerism, managing community traditions, and generating active support for the university.

This position requires a highly energetic, organized, and collaborative professional capable of working in tandem with the SOU Alumni Association and the Assistant Director of Engagement to integrate alumni engagement initiatives directly into broader university advancement and development goals.

Minimum Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree from a regionally accredited college or university.
  • At least four years of progressive, professional experience in alumni relations, higher education administration, admissions, public relations, fundraising, or nonprofit management.
  • Demonstrated ability to build programs, manage complex projects independently, and execute major public events with minimal administrative support.
  • Exceptional public speaking, presentation, writing, and interpersonal communication skills.
  • Flexibility and willingness to work evenings and weekends for campus events, regional programs, and professional travel.
  • Must possess and maintain a current, valid Driver License.
  • Proficiency in managing social media platforms as well as in standard Microsoft 365 software.

Preferred Requirements

  • Master's degree in higher education administration, communications, business administration, or a related field.
  • Supervisory experience.
  • Direct experience working within a university environment.
  • Proficient working knowledge of advancement databases and donor management software (such as Raiser's Edge or Salesforce).

Essential Functions

Duties - The following examples are typical work activities that are meant to illustrate the general range of work functions and are not meant to be all-inclusive or restrictive:

(35%) Strategic Leadership and Administration

  • Plan and execute an annual strategic alumni engagement operating plan aligned with University Advancement objectives.
  • Plan, develop, and exercise budget authority over the Alumni Relations operational budget to maximize program return on investment.
  • Utilize data analytics and assessment tools to evaluate the effectiveness of programming, develop and maintain alumni tracking metrics, and report trends to leadership.
  • Partner with development staff to align alumni activity with the university's ongoing major giving priorities and philanthropic pipeline.
  • Provide executive staffing and logistical support to the SOUAA Board of Directors; partner directly with the Board Development & Nominating Committee to manage board recruitment, facilitate regular elections, coordinate the orientation program for newly elected board members, and maintain oversight of bylaws and governing policies

(35%) Event Planning and Program Management

  • Serve as chair and logistical lead for major high-visibility campus milestones, working alongside the SOUAA Alumni Engagement & Programming Committee to coordinate Homecoming, reunions, and family weekends.
  • Identify, recruit, and guide volunteer leadership to develop and approve official charters for regional alumni chapters and industry-specific affinity networks across the state and country.
  • Establish engagement opportunities tailored specifically to diverse subgroups, such as first-generation graduates, young alumni, and athletic or academic affinity cohorts.
  • Partner with the SOUAA Career Services & Mentorship Committee and the campus career center to expand internship pipelines, promote professional development webinars, and mobilize the digital Raider Network platform to support student-to-alumni mentoring channels.
  • Oversee the selection and distribution of institutional alumni distinction awards in collaboration with the SOUAA Awards and Recognition Committee.

(25%) Communications, Marketing and Data Integrity

  • Design and deploy demographic-driven communication strategies through newsletters, web portals, targeted email marketing, and editorial content for The Raider alumni magazine.
  • Direct the university's official alumni social media platforms to promote alumni programs, manage digital content, boost event registrations, and elevate campaign visibility in collaboration with the university's marketing department.
  • Partner with Advancement Services to regularly update contact info, business records, and biographical fields within the central database; execute trace strategies with the committee to enrich missing information for "lost" alumni.
  • Serve as an official face, liaison, and informational spokesperson for the university's alumni base, publicizing outstanding professional, civic, and philanthropic milestones to boost institutional pride.

(5%) Supervisor responsibility and other duties as assigned

Skills, Knowledge, and Abilities

  • Excellent communication skills; demonstrated ability to effectively communicate information in a clear and understandable manner, both verbally and in writing.
  • Demonstrated customer service experience requiring a very high level of diplomacy and professionalism to effectively handle a broad range of sensitive interpersonal situations.
  • Demonstrated ability to interpret and consistently apply a wide variety of complex policies and procedures where specific guidelines may not always exist.
  • Expressed ability to work with frequent changes in policies and procedures, under pressure of deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong analytical and research skills; demonstrated ability to gather, evaluate, and to develop well-reasoned conclusions and recommendations.
  • Demonstrated ability to proactively assess work operations and anticipate potential problems; ability to develop and implement strategies for preventing/resolving problems.
  • Great ability to effectively perform work of a highly sensitive and confidential nature that requires access to information. Must be able to exercise sound judgment and discretion, tact, and diplomacy.
  • Takes initiative in independently planning, organizing, and performing work assignments within broadly defined parameters
  • Demonstrated ability to work with a high level of productivity and accuracy/attention to detail.
  • Excellent organizational and time management skills with the demonstrated ability to set own priorities to coordinate multiple assignments with fluctuating and time-sensitive deadlines.
  • Expressed skill to independently analyze software functionality through technical documents, and design and document efficient/effective work processes; ability to independently analyze software problems, test probable causes, and recommend sound solutions.
  • Excellent computer skills and proficiency with a variety of computer applications including word processing, spreadsheets, databases, online systems, social media platforms, Internet as well as online calendaring and email.
  • Demonstrated ability to initiate, establish, and foster communication and teamwork by maintaining a positive, cooperative, productive work atmosphere in and outside the University with the ability to establish and maintain effective working relationships within a diverse population and with those from various cultural backgrounds.
  • Willingness to and work effectively in a heavily bureaucratic environment which requires regular interaction with a number of levels within the organization and multiple outside agencies.
  • Working knowledge or ability to quickly learn, university infrastructure, policies, and procedures.
  • Demonstrated skills in an institutional/educational environment utilizing a customer-oriented and service-centered attitude.

Physical Demands

  • Normal office activities such as sitting/standing at a desk, using a computer, answering phones, and communicating in person both in writing and via phone with others.
  • Event setup, including but not limited to move/transport trade show type equipment .
  • Travel to and from events.

Special Conditions

  • Must be willing to travel and attend training programs off-site for occasional professional development.
  • Must be able to work additional hours and adjust working hours to meet special jobs. May be called back periodically to perform work as needed on an emergency basis.
  • Must be able to successfully pass a pre-employment background check.
  • This position classification has been defined as exempt and is not subject to the overtime provisions of the Fair Labor Standards Act (FLSA).
  • The person holding this position is considered a mandatory reporter under the Oregon Revised Statutes and is required to comply with the requirements set forth by the Oregon Department of Human Services.
  • This position requires driving for university business. Final candidates will be contacted by Human Resources to complete the university’s driver clearance process. SOU Land Acknowledgement
We want to take this moment to acknowledge that Southern Oregon University is located within the ancestral homelands of the Shasta, Takelma, and Latgawa peoples who lived here since time immemorial. These Tribes were displaced during rapid Euro-American colonization, the Gold Rush, and armed conflict between 1851 and 1856. In the 1850s, the discovery of gold and settlement brought thousands of Euro-Americans to their lands, leading to warfare, epidemics, starvation, and villages being burned. In 1853 the first of several treaties were signed, confederating these Tribes and others together – who would then be referred to as the Rogue River Tribe. These treaties ceded most of their homelands to the United States, and in return, they were guaranteed a permanent homeland reserved for them. At the end of the Rogue River Wars in 1856, these Tribes and many other Tribes from western Oregon were removed to the Siletz Reservation and the Grand Ronde Reservation. Today, the Confederated Tribes of Grand Ronde Community of Oregon () and the Confederated Tribes of Siletz Indians () are living descendants of the Takelma, Shasta, and Latgawa peoples of this area. title: Data Engineer with experience in AdTech / MarTech or Ecommerce
description:
We are seeking an Experienced Data Engineer on behalf of a prominent player in the digital marketing technology and adtech space. This company relies on high-volume, real-time data to drive performance for top global brands---and they need a skilled engineer to strengthen their core data platform.


In this role, you will own the end-to-end data lifecycle: building resilient ingestion pipelines across major ad platforms (Google Ads, Meta, Amazon Ads, GA4), harmonizing complex multi-currency and attribution metrics, and designing cost-efficient data models in BigQuery. You will work closely with marketing analysts, cloud engineers, and business stakeholders while utilizing modern DevOps practices, including Infrastructure as Code (Terraform) and CI/CD (GitHub Actions).


If you are looking for an opportunity to lead technical implementations, work with cutting-edge GCP tools, and solve real-world data engineering challenges at scale, this is the role for you.


Main Responsibilities:



  • Build & Scale Data Ingestion: Design robust ingestion pipelines across major adtech and martech APIs (Google Ads, DV360, Meta, GA4, Amazon Ads) using REST, GraphQL, file transfers (SFTP/S3/GCS), and native transfer services.

  • Data Quality & Harmonization: Standardize multi-platform data across varying currencies, time zones, and attribution models while implementing validation checks for schema drift and late-arriving data.

  • Orchestration & Modeling: Create clean, maintainable SQL-based transformations and orchestrate workflow pipelines using dbt or Dataform.

  • Cloud Infrastructure as Code: Provision, automate, and manage scalable cloud resources using Terraform.

  • CI/CD & Monitoring: Build automated CI/CD deployment pipelines using GitHub Actions while maintaining cloud monitoring and alerting systems (focused on GCP).

  • Streaming & Real-Time Data: Develop and expand real-time messaging and pipeline architectures using tools like Apache Beam, Dataflow, Pub/Sub, or Kafka.

  • Data Privacy & Compliance: Implement privacy-first standards (GDPR/TCF, PII minimization, hashing, consent signals) directly within data workflows.


Core Skills / Experience:



  • Experience: 3+ years in Data Engineering, ideally with exposure to adtech, martech, e-commerce, or retail media data ecosystems.

  • Data Warehousing & SQL: Advanced SQL skills with hands-on experience building cost-optimized, partitioned schemas in GCP BigQuery or AWS Redshift.

  • Programming & Frameworks: Proficiency in Python (Pandas, FastAPI, Flask); familiarity with Java is a strong plus.

  • DevOps & Automation: Practical experience with Terraform, GitHub Actions, and Google Cloud Platform (GCP) environments.

  • Soft Skills & Autonomy: Strong problem-solving ownership, self-directed execution, and the ability to communicate technical ideas clearly to marketing, product, and engineering teams.

title: AI Scaling Lead

description:
Use Your Power for Purpose

As the AI Scaling Lead, you will play a critical role in accelerating AI adoption and value realization across GBM's global manufacturing network. Acting as the bridge between site innovation, network priorities, and enterprise transformation, you will lead the identification, development, scaling, and sustainment of AI-enabled solutions that improve operational performance, productivity, quality, and colleague experience.

The Lead will connect Sites, AI Squads, Site AI Champions, and Network resources through disciplined, sprint-based execution, ensuring successful solutions are rapidly replicated, standardized, and embedded across the network. The role requires a unique blend of manufacturing expertise, strategic thinking, change leadership, and AI/digital acumen to help build an AI-native organization.

This role will be instrumental in helping GBM realize its vision of becoming an AI-native manufacturing organization by transforming successful global and local innovations into scalable enterprise capabilities that deliver measurable value.

Lead and prioritize AI Squad initiatives across GBM, ensuring delivery against business priorities and measurable outcomes.

Focus Areas

    • Lead AI Squads through sprint-based delivery of new AI solutions, holding teams accountable for outcomes and timelines.

  • Bachelor's degree with at least 10 years of experience; OR a master's degree with at least 7 years of experience; OR a PhD with 5+ years of experience.

  • Experience bridging operations with digital and AI-enabled capabilities.
  • Experience leading cross-functional teams through sprint-based or agile delivery.
  • Strong program management skills, with experience prioritizing and delivering multiple initiatives at once.
  • Adaptable and resourceful in a fast-changing, ambiguous environment.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Experience with AI, advanced analytics, or automation applied to manufacturing operations.
  • Lean, Six Sigma, or IMEx leadership experience.
  • Experience building playbooks or standards for scaling solutions across multiple sites.
  • Experience as a Site AI Champion or similar grassroots capability-building role.

title: We’re Hiring: Full Stack WordPress Developer
description:
About Us

Skift is the leading business intelligence and media company in travel, delivering news, research, and global events that power smarter decisions across the industry. We convene senior leaders and innovators who rely on Skift for clarity, insight, and meaningful connection in a fast-moving global market.

The Opportunity

We’re looking for a highly skilled, proactive Full Stack WordPress Developer to join Skift. This role is ideal for an engineer who thrives in a collaborative environment and wants a major voice in the technical decisions shaping our digital platforms. You will work alongside our existing development and editorial teams. We are actively looking for candidates based in the UK.

Why This Role Matters

As a reader-first company relying on hard and metered paywalls across a portfolio of properties—including Skift.com, Airline Weekly, Skift Research, Daily Lodging Report, and Skift Meetings—our technical infrastructure is the lifeblood of our business. By building robust back-end architecture and intuitive custom features, you ensure that our teams can seamlessly publish influential travel industry coverage, while delivering a high-performing, secure experience to our global audience.

Some of What You’ll Do

Architecture & Custom Development


  • Build and maintain our suite of WordPress sites with a heavy focus on back-end architecture and peak performance.

  • Develop custom themes, custom post types, taxonomies, hooks, filters, and dynamic WordPress templates.

  • Model and flawlessly manage structured content using Advanced Custom Fields (ACF) Pro.

Integration & Modern Tooling


  • Build and integrate RESTful APIs seamlessly within the WordPress ecosystem.

  • Develop and maintain custom Gutenberg blocks to empower our content creators.

  • Utilize modern development tooling, including wp-scripts, Webpack, Composer, and BEM CSS architecture using Sass.

Collaboration & Code Quality


  • Partner directly with our editorial and design teams to scope, create, and deploy new pages and features.

  • Uphold rigorous WordPress performance, security, and coding standards across all properties (including WPVIP environments).

  • Participate actively in collaborative code reviews and version control workflows using Git and GitHub, while supporting existing projects when external teams require assistance.

What You’ll Bring


  • Proven WordPress Expertise: Deep experience building hybrid WordPress themes, custom Gutenberg blocks, and structured content modeling (ACF).

  • Back-End Mastery: Expert-level proficiency in PHP 8+, MySQL, REST APIs, and core WordPress architecture.

  • Front-End Competency: Strong working knowledge of JavaScript (ES6+), jQuery, SCSS/PostCSS, and a comfort level with shipping for older browser baselines.

  • Agility and Organization: The ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously, meet strict deadlines, and thrive while working asynchronously across U.S. and European time zones.

  • Strong Communication Skills: You are friendly, highly organized, and can articulate technical choices clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

  • Bonus: Experience with ReactJS, NodeJS, MongoDB, HubSpot, or a portfolio of public GitHub repositories we can review is a significant plus.

Success Metrics


  • Platform Stability & Performance: Consistent upkeep of high-performing, secure code that adheres to strict WordPress and WPVIP standards across all our subscription platforms.

  • Feature Velocity: On-time deployment of reliable custom themes, blocks, and API integrations that directly support our editorial and design goals.

  • Code Quality: Clean, scalable architecture, demonstrated through successful peer code reviews and effective use of Git/GitHub workflows.

  • Seamless Collaboration: Proactive, clear communication and a proven ability to work efficiently and independently across multiple time zones.

What We Offer


  • Opportunity to grow within a respected and innovative media company.

  • Exposure to the intersection of media, events, and travel intelligence.

  • Collaborative, supportive, and remote-friendly work environment.

How We Work

Skift's culture is diverse, cohesive, and full of people who love what they do and bring the best of themselves to work. We are remote but very connected and caring about each other.

How To Apply

If this role sounds like a fit, we’d love to hear from you. PLEASE SEND US A COVER LETTER ALONG WITH YOUR RESUME sharing why you’re interested and how your experience aligns with Skift's mission.

Skift is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to building a team that reflects the diversity of travelers around the world. We welcome applicants from all life experiences and encourage members of traditionally underrepresented backgrounds to apply.

Here’s what you can expect next

If selected to interview, a Skift team member will reach out to schedule next steps.

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
At cloudandthings.io, we are an engineering-led consultancy focused on building modern Data and AI Platforms for enterprise clients.

We don't just design architectures; we build real systems that power analytics, decision-making, and AI at scale. We operate with high standards, strong ownership, and a bias for execution.

We are looking for people who think from first principles, challenge conventional thinking, and take deep ownership of what they deliver - engineers who don't simply identify problems, but solve them and see them through to a running system in production.

About cloudandthings.io

At cloudandthings.io, we are an engineering-led consultancy focused on building modern Data and AI Platforms for enterprise clients.

We don't just design architectures; we build real systems that power analytics, decision-making, and AI at scale. We operate with high standards, strong ownership, and a bias for execution.

We are looking for people who think from first principles, challenge conventional thinking, and take deep ownership of what they deliver - engineers who don't simply identify problems, but solve them and see them through to a running system in production.

The Role

As a Senior Data Engineer, you will lead the design, build, and operation of modern, cloud-native data platforms across AWS and Azure, using Databricks, Microsoft Fabric, and cloud-native services. You will own delivery across the full data lifecycle — ingestion, transformation, modelling, and serving — enabling real-time analytics, reporting, and AI use cases.

This is a hands‑on senior role. You will still be in the code every day, but you will also be the person clients and engineers look to for technical direction: shaping the architecture, making the trade‑off calls, setting the standards, and raising the level of everyone around you.

Much of our work centres on lakehouse platforms, so proven depth in Databricks and/or Microsoft Fabric is essential.

Key Responsibilities

The list below is broad. We expect production‑grade experience across a substantial portion of it, and the judgement to know which tools a given problem actually calls for.

Technical Leadership and Delivery Ownership

  • Act as technical lead on client engagements: own the solution design end to end, from discovery and architecture through to a supported production platform.
  • Translate ambiguous business requirements into pragmatic designs, and communicate them credibly to engineers and senior client stakeholders.
  • Make and justify architectural trade‑offs.
  • Set and enforce engineering standards: code review, testing, branching and release strategy, definition of done.
  • Mentor and grow junior and mid-level engineers through pairing, review and feedback; contribute to hiring and technical assessment.
  • Contribute to internal capability: reusable accelerators, reference architectures, and solution‑shaping input.

Software Engineering Foundations

  • Strong grounding in software engineering fundamentals (data structures, algorithms, design patterns), and the ability to hold others to that standard.
  • Advanced proficiency in Python and SQL (additional languages advantageous).
  • Deep experience with Git and CI/CD — able to design a branching and deployment strategy for a team, not just work within one.
  • Hands‑on Infrastructure as Code with Terraform or Bicep, including the Databricks provider and Fabric deployment automation; able to own a platform's IaC estate.
  • Promoting data assets as code: Databricks Asset Bundles and Repos, Fabric Git integration and deployment pipelines.
  • Comfortable in Linux environments.

Ingestion and Streaming

  • Design scalable ingestion across hybrid and cloud environments, and the standards other engineers will follow.
  • Streaming: AWS Kinesis / MSK (Kafka), Azure Event Hubs, Databricks Structured Streaming, Fabric Eventstream and Real‑Time Intelligence (Eventhouse / KQL).
  • Incremental and batch: Auto Loader, Lakeflow Connect, Fabric Dataflows Gen2 and Copy Job, AWS DataSync / DMS, Azure Data Factory / Synapse / Fabric Data Pipelines.
  • Integration via APIs, JDBC/ODBC and CDC, including Fabric Mirroring (Azure SQL, Cosmos DB, Snowflake, Unity Catalog) and Delta Sharing.

Storage and Lakehouse

  • Design and manage data lakes on Amazon S3 and Azure Data Lake Storage Gen2, and architect lakehouse platforms using:
  • Databricks — Delta Lake, Unity Catalog (catalogs, schemas, external locations, storage credentials, volumes), managed vs external tables, streaming tables and materialised views, Lakehouse Federation, Delta Sharing.
  • Microsoft Fabric — OneLake and shortcuts, Lakehouse, Warehouse, Fabric SQL Database, workspace and domain design, capacity (F SKU) sizing and CU management.
  • Table optimisation: partitioning, liquid clustering, Z‑ordering, OPTIMIZE / VACUUM, V‑Order and statistics, small‑file management, time travel and retention.
  • Open formats and standards: Delta Lake, Parquet, Avro, JSON, Apache Iceberg / Delta UniForm.
  • Relational (Postgres, SQL Server, Aurora), NoSQL (DynamoDB, Cosmos DB) and caching (Redis).

Processing and Transformation

  • Build scalable ETL/ELT pipelines using:
  • Databricks — PySpark and Spark SQL, Delta Live Tables / Lakeflow Declarative Pipelines, Workflows, serverless and job compute, Photon, cluster policies, dbt.
  • Microsoft Fabric — Spark notebooks and job definitions, environments and library management, Warehouse T‑SQL and stored procedures, Dataflows Gen2.
  • AWS / Azure native — Glue, Lambda, EMR, Synapse Spark.
  • Own the data model: medallion architecture (Bronze/Silver/Gold), dimensional models (star schemas, SCD handling), and platform‑wide modelling standards.
  • Build reusable, testable pipelines: modular notebooks and Python packages, parameterisation, unit and integration testing, idempotent and restartable loads.
  • Lead Spark performance and cost tuning: skew and shuffle management, caching, right‑sizing compute, autoscaling — and diagnose the problems others cannot.

Analytics and AI Enablement

  • Design platforms that support BI, advanced analytics, machine learning and AI use cases:
  • Databricks — SQL warehouses, AI/BI dashboards and Genie, MLflow, Unity Catalog model registry, Model Serving, Mosaic AI (Vector Search, agent and RAG patterns), feature engineering.
  • Microsoft Fabric — semantic models and Direct Lake, Power BI report and dataset design, DAX, Fabric Data Science, Data Agents and Copilot.
  • AWS — Redshift, Athena, SageMaker and Bedrock where relevant.
  • Partner with data scientists and analysts on feature engineering and real‑time decisioning systems.
  • Establish data quality, observability and lineage frameworks: DLT expectations, Unity Catalog lineage and system tables, Fabric monitoring hub, freshness and volume alerting.

Security, Governance and Compliance

  • Design secure, enterprise‑grade platforms: AWS IAM, Azure Entra ID, RBAC, managed identities and service principals.
  • Governance: Unity Catalog (namespace design, grants and inheritance, row filters and column masks, attribute‑based access, audit logs); Fabric (workspace roles and item permissions, OneLake security, sensitivity labels, domains, Purview); AWS Lake Formation.
  • Networking: VPC / VNets, private endpoints, Direct Connect / ExpressRoute, Databricks secure cluster connectivity and Private Link, Fabric private links and managed VNets.
  • Encryption: KMS / Key Vault / TLS, customer‑managed keys, secret scopes.
  • Engage with client security and architecture forums to get designs approved.

Orchestration and Operations

  • Orchestrate with Databricks Workflows, AWS Step Functions / MWAA (Airflow), ADF / Synapse and Fabric Data Pipelines.
  • Monitoring and observability: CloudWatch, Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, Databricks system tables and query history, Fabric Capacity Metrics and monitoring hub.
  • Own the operational posture of what you build: SLAs, alerting, incident response, root cause analysis, and runbooks.
  • Drive reliability, performance and cost optimisation (FinOps): compute policies, serverless vs classic, tagging and chargeback, Fabric capacity smoothing and pause/resume.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field.
  • Typically 7+ years in data or software engineering, with at least 3 years building data platforms on AWS and/or Azure.
  • A track record of delivering production data solutions end‑to‑end — including at least one platform you can talk through in depth: the constraints, the decisions, and what you'd do differently.
  • Substantial hands‑on production experience with at least one lakehouse platform (Databricks or Fabric), working knowledge of the other, and the appetite to build depth.
  • Experience leading a workstream or small team: setting technical direction, reviewing work, and mentoring.
  • Confident client‑facing communication. Able to run a design workshop, defend an architecture, and explain a trade‑off to a non‑technical audience.
  • Certifications advantageous, professional or expert level especially: Databricks (Data Engineer Professional / Associate, Machine Learning Associate); Microsoft (DP‑700, DP‑600, DP‑203, AZ‑305); AWS (Data Engineer Associate, Solutions Architect Associate / Professional).
  • Experience with Docker, Kubernetes and CI/CD for data workloads.
  • Strong working knowledge of data security and compliance standards.
  • Strong problem‑solving skills, with the judgement to know when a simple solution beats a sophisticated one.
  • Self‑organising, able to prioritise across multiple tasks and competing stakeholders.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication, and a collaborative approach with clients and colleagues.
  • Willingness to travel to clients as and when required.

What We Offer

  • A culture of engineering and an environment where ideas are heard, and builders can build.
  • Competitive compensation and bonus structure.
  • A flexible, supportive environment that values diversity, work‑life balance and personal growth.
  • Career advancement, mentorship and ongoing development.
  • Cutting‑edge technology, engaging client projects, and a talented team around you.

title: AI Agent Engineer / Full Stack Experience (Python)
description:
Orbio AI builds agentic workforces for large global employers, focusing on scalable AI-driven solutions that enhance productivity and operational efficiency. The company specializes in deploying intelligent agents that can integrate with existing systems and workflows across diverse industries. Team members collaborate closely with enterprise clients to design, develop, and refine AI agents that deliver measurable business impact. Orbio AI values innovation, practical problem-solving, and a product mindset oriented toward real-world deployment and continuous improvement.

This is a full-time AI Agent Engineer / Full Stack Experience (Python) position based in Madrid, with a hybrid work model that combines on-site collaboration and some work-from-home flexibility. The role involves designing, implementing, and maintaining AI agents, including building backend services and integrating them into production environments. Day-to-day responsibilities include developing and optimizing Python-based services, integrating APIs, working with data pipelines, and collaborating with product, design, and ML teams to turn business requirements into robust technical solutions. The engineer will also debug and troubleshoot production issues, write clean and testable code, document systems and workflows, and contribute to architectural decisions for scalable, secure, and reliable AI products.   • Comfort with cloud platforms and deployment environments (e.g., AWS, GCP, or Azure) and containerization tools such as Docker or similar.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to translate business needs into technical solutions and prioritize tasks in a dynamic environment.

Culture at Orbio

description:

  • Accomplish tasks, department objectives, financial goals, whole hotel hospitality goals, and other projects as assigned within the boundaries and scope of your job.

  • Complete inventory at the end of each month

REQUIRED KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES

  • High school education or equivalent education/experience.
  • Three to Six months in a food and beverage services environment or establishment. Hotel experience preferred.
  • Able to mix drinks correctly. Provide exceptional service to all guests.
  • Able to multitask and handle all the equipment especially in a bar that uses modern technology. Must have manual coordination to punch buttons, grasp items in hand and to balance and carry trays loaded with food and beverage.
  • Able to read, speak, and understand English. Able to lead in a productive, diligent, and guiding manner. Communicate information and hotel services to management, staff, and guests.

PHYSICAL DEMANDS

  • Continuous Standing as needed
  • Lift, pull, push, bend, and move items to support the hotel and outlets

BENEFITS PACKAGE

  • Competitive Salary

  • Daily Pay!

  • Team Member Hotel Discount Program

  • Uniforms Provided for most positions

  • Benefits - Health, Dental, Vision, Life Insurance, and other supplemental options

  • Paid PTO

  • 401k with employer match

  • Food and Beverage Discounts

  • Tuition Reimbursement

WHY THE HARPETH:

As historic downtown Franklin's only hotel, we pride ourselves on being a home away from home for our guests and our team members are a large part of that experience. From benefits like special hotel rates around the world to discounted food and beverage items, we are made for those who love to travel as much as our guests.

At The Harpeth, we are dedicated to being open minded and implementing new ideas to assure a high level of productivity and professionalism. We do our best to encourage communication and listening to every team member equally. We are committed to you and your career advancement by providing you the opportunity to be successful through career growth and internal promotions.

If you think you bring the ideal blend of skills, attitude and teamwork, sprinkled with a love of history and a small-town vibe, this could be the perfect home for you! Are you passionate and creative with a desire to grow? Let’s talk!

description:

This is a full-stack engineering position where you'll work across Angular front-end applications, .NET services and APIs, and PostgreSQL databases. You'll collaborate closely with Product Management, Software Quality, and fellow developers to deliver high-quality software that is secure, scalable, and maintainable.

Whether you're enhancing existing functionality, building new features, or solving complex customer challenges, you'll have the opportunity to make a meaningful impact on products used in quality and manufacturing environments worldwide.

What You'll Do

Design and Build Software Solutions

  • Develop and maintain applications using C#, .NET, Angular, TypeScript, SQL, and PostgreSQL.
  • Design, implement, and support REST APIs and database solutions.
  • Create scalable, high-performing software while following established architecture and coding standards.
  • Contribute to technical specifications, API contracts, and data model designs.

Deliver High-Quality Software

  • Develop and execute unit, integration, and end-to-end testing strategies.
  • Validate analytical and statistical results against reference data.
  • Apply secure coding practices and resolve vulnerabilities.
  • Support software releases, upgrades, and ongoing maintenance activities.

Collaborate Across Teams

  • Partner with Product Management and quality engineering teams to understand requirements and deliver effective solutions.
  • Participate in code reviews and knowledge sharing.
  • Help onboard and support junior team members, interns, or apprentices.

What We're Looking For

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, Industrial Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field.
  • 4+ years of professional software development experience building commercial web applications.
  • Strong experience with:
    • C# and .NET
    • Angular, TypeScript, or a comparable modern front-end framework
    • SQL and relational database design
  • Understanding of software development lifecycle practices, version control, CI/CD, automated testing, and defect tracking.

  • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to quickly learn new technical domains.

Preferred Qualifications

Why Join Metrologic?

  • Collaborate with a highly skilled and supportive development team.
  • Gain exposure to advanced analytics, quality engineering, and industrial software applications.
  • Expand your technical expertise across the full software stack.
  • Receive structured mentorship and opportunities for professional growth.

Apply Today

If you're passionate about building high-quality software, solving complex technical challenges, and working in an innovative manufacturing technology environment, we'd love to hear from you. Join us and help shape solutions that drive quality and performance for manufacturers around the world.

title: Chief Traffic Engineer
description:
Hanson Values

Integrity | Commitment | Quality | Relationships | Innovation

If you’re looking for a firm that encourages innovative thinking and challenges you every day, with an opportunity to learn and advance, a career at Hanson is right for you. The belief in sustainability within our company’s practices creates a focus on client success and partnerships that are important to our communities and our environment.

Excited to grow your career?

At Hanson Professional Services, Inc., we are committed to transforming communities through innovative engineering solutions. We provide a full range of traffic engineering services to a broad range of clients, including state DOTs, the Illinois Tollway, local public agencies, and private industry.

We are seeking a full- or part-time Chief Traffic Engineer for our active and growing traffic engineering discipline. Our traffic team is dynamic, forward-thinking, and passionate about making a difference. For a candidate hired full-time, this position is eligible for a $10,000 signing bonus. This position may be considered for part-time hours for a well-qualified candidate.

A Day in the Life of the Chief Traffic Engineer

Here’s a snapshot of what you would do in this role:

  • Quality Leadership:
    • Lead QA/QC reviews of traffic simulation models, intersection and interchange design studies, engineering reports, and traffic signal/ITS design documents to support consistent standards across project teams.
    • Monitor the quality and progress of traffic engineering tasks on active projects, ensuring production requirements and project expectations are met.
    • Collaborate with project managers, senior technical staff, and other disciplines to execute significant projects across the country.

  • Technical Oversight:
    • Lead traffic and transportation engineering analysis and design tasks.
    • Serve as a senior technical advisor and trusted partner to clients across markets.
    • Help recruit, mentor, and develop traffic engineering staff across multiple office locations.
    • Participate in the development of an internal and external professional development program.

  • Client and Business Development Leadership:
    • Help market Hanson’s traffic engineering expertise to clients, potential recruits, and professional organizations.
    • Provide technical support for project proposals, presentations, and interviews.
    • Assist in the development of project scopes, budgets, and schedules.

What We’re Looking For

The following qualifications would set you up for success in this role:

Required Skills:

  • Traffic analysis of intersections, interchanges, and corridors using modeling software such as Highway Capacity Software, Synchro, and Vissim.
  • Understanding of HSM, HCM, MUTCD, AASHTO Green Book, and PROWAG.
  • Strong communication abilities, especially in explaining technical concepts to engineers, clients, and public stakeholders.

Preferred Skills:

  • Experience with geometric design of intersections and interchanges.
  • CAD experience with Microstation/OpenRoads.
  • Familiarity with travel demand modeling concepts, including experience with Visum, Cube, and/or TransCAD software, is desirable.

Work Environment:

  • Occasional travel (typically 1–2 days/month) for visiting staff in other locations, client meetings, and site visits.
  • We believe in a strong work-life balance and support reasonable schedules and flexible work arrangements.
  • Flexible full-time or part-time arrangements may be considered based on candidate qualifications and business needs.

Education/Experience:
