title: Lead Patient Navigator
description:
Current Employees:

If you are a current Staff, Faculty or Temporary employee at the University of Miami, please click here to log in to Workday to use the internal application process. To learn how to apply for a faculty or staff position, please review this tip sheet.

UMHC - SCCC Site Disease has an exciting opportunity for a Lead Patient Navigator position. The incumbent provides support and guidance throughout the patient’s care continuum by helping patients “navigate” through the maze of doctors’ offices, clinics, hospitals, outpatient centers, insurance and payment systems, patient-support organizations, and other components of the healthcare system. The Lead Patient Navigator also acts as a resource for Patient Navigators 1 and Sr. Patient Navigators to ensure the timely delivery of high quality care and patient satisfaction.

CORE JOB FUNCTIONS

  • Maintains a working knowledge of medical symptoms, signs, and anatomical systems to identify and differentiate type and urgency of medical need.

  • Conducts patient evaluations to obtain information necessary for the development of an effective treatment plan.

  • Provides patient reminders of upcoming appointments and acts as liaison between patients and providers.

  • Identifies and resolves real or perceived barriers to care.

  • Intervenes as liaison/advocate for patients, physicians, and staff in facilitating ease of care. Assists in identifying trouble spots and problem patterns in the provision of care.

  • Educates and counsels patients on issues related to their health and life situations.

  • Maintains current knowledge of community health, welfare resources, and any other programs available to patients.

  • Assists in building partnerships with local community physicians and referral sources to the UHealth systems.

  • Travels within the facility and campus to retrieve records, images, CDs, and pathology specimens.

  • Explain HIPPA to patients and obtain consents.

  • Maintains accurate clinical records per hospital policy while preserving confidentiality of patient information.

  • Trains, develops, and empowers new team members and current staff to effectively do their jobs.

  • Assists lower-level Patient Navigators as needed.

  • Adheres to University and unit-level policies and procedures and safeguards University assets.

This list of duties and responsibilities is not intended to be all-inclusive and may be expanded to include other duties or responsibilities as necessary.


CORE QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor’s degree preferred.

  • Minimum 4 years of relevant work experience


DEPARTMENT ADDENDUM
Department Specific Functions: (SDG) Navigation Program
1. Telephone responsibilities include, but are not limited to speaking to the patient, and contacting a variety of health care facilities to obtain patient medical record information.
2. Address barriers and gaps in care with the nurse navigator.
3. Follow-up on interventions from the nurse navigator to remove barriers (i.e. referrals-internal/external).
4. Provides related internal, local, or national resources to the patient, family, or caregiver.
5. Explains consent for obtaining outside records, and HIPAA (if applicable) to patient; obtains signatures (may be done via email)
6. Submits signed consent to health care centers as appropriate to initiate retrieval of medical records, pathology slides, x-rays and any other pertinent report.
7. Tracks pending records to ensure delivery prior to clinic visit such as pathology reports etc.
8. Communicates to the appropriate SDG Nurse Navigator, if difficult or unable to obtain a pertinent record
9. Travels within the facility and campus to retrieve records/films/CD/s as needed.
10. Prepares pathology slides and submits for consultation.
11. Returns pathology slide to appropriate institution or patient.
12. Assembles, completes, and processes patients’ charts as indicated.
13. Maintains confidentiality of patient information.
14. Maintains an accurate clinical record, recording information per hospital policy.
15. Reports unusual incidents in a timely manner to appropriate supervisory personnel.
16. Assist nursing staff in collaboration of multidisciplinary meetings, including tumor conference coordination. (TB Coordinator)
17. Assists with other clerical duties, not limited to faxing, scanning, copying.
18. Assists navigation leadership team conducting monthly documentation audits as needed.
19. Uses tracking system and databases to accurately document placement of all medical records.
20. Copies, faxes, emails, and mails medical records while ensuring patient confidentiality.
21. Answers telephones and responds to questions, concerns, and directs calls or obtains messages.
22. Adheres to University and unit-level policies and procedures and safeguards University assets.
23. Trains, develops, and empowers new team members and current staff to effectively do their jobs.

Department Specific Qualifications
Education:
Bachelor’s degree preferred.
Certification and Licensing:
• Certification in translation of secondary language if applicable.
• George Washington Patient Navigator Certification Required.
Experience:
Minimum of 4 years relevant work experience required in a healthcare setting.

The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and primary responsibilities of this job classification. Specific duties and tasks may vary based upon departmental needs. Other duties may be assigned to the above consistent with the knowledge, skills, and abilities required for the job. This a job profile description and not all duties may be assigned to a specific position in each individual department.

The University of Miami offers competitive salaries and a comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental, tuition remission and more.

UHealth-University of Miami Health System, South Florida's only university-based health system, provides leading-edge patient care powered by the ground breaking research and medical education at the Miller School of Medicine. As an academic medical center, we are proud to serve South Florida, Latin America and the Caribbean. Our physicians represent more than 100 specialties and sub-specialties, and have more than one million patient encounters each year. Our tradition of excellence has earned worldwide recognition for outstanding teaching, research and patient care. We're the challenge you've been looking for.

title: Senior Experiential & Spatial Designer (Freelance)
location: New York, New York, United States
description:
Who We Are

Food Truck Promotions creates mobile brand experiences that bring brands into the real world through custom vehicles, pop-ups, and interactive activations.

We're looking for an imaginative experiential and spatial designer to help us push our creative work further. Someone who can take a brand, a brief, and a footprint and turn them into an experience people want to walk into, interact with, photograph, and remember.

Your work will shape everything from the overall activation environment to the smallest custom detail: a sculptural product display, a playful customization station, an unexpected serving window, or a dimensional sign that makes someone stop across the street.

What You'll Do

  • Develop original concepts for mobile tours, brand activations, pop-ups, sampling experiences, and retail environments.
  • Translate brand identities and campaign objectives into physical spaces through form, materials, color, lighting, graphics, and interaction.
  • Design complete activation footprints, including vehicle placement, guest entry, queues, activity zones, product displays, photo moments, staff workspaces, and storage.
  • Design custom fabrication elements such as bars, counters, shelving, display fixtures, seating, oversized props, interactive games, and personalization stations.
  • Design vehicle interiors and exteriors, including dimensional signage, rooftop features, serving windows, integrated displays, and surrounding scenic elements.
  • Develop mood boards, sketches, spatial layouts, 3D models, and compelling renderings that clearly communicate your ideas to clients.
  • Prepare dimensioned design drawings, material and finish references, and annotated details so production partners can estimate and develop the build.
  • Collaborate with producers, graphic designers, fabricators, and installers to refine concepts around budgets, timelines, transportation, and site conditions.
  • - Review fabrication drawings, samples, and progress photos to help preserve the design through execution.
  • - Develop reusable and modular elements that can adapt across brands, vehicles, and tour stops.

Your Design Approach

  • You know when a brand calls for something whimsical and theatrical, and when it needs restraint and precision. You can make a compact footprint feel intentional, immersive, and visually distinctive.
  • You think about how an experience works as carefully as how it looks: where guests stand, what catches their attention, how they interact, how staff replenish products, and how the installation packs up for its next stop.
  • You bring fresh ideas and can explain the creative reasoning behind them. You're also comfortable simplifying a design when needed while protecting the element that makes it special.

What You Bring

  • A strong portfolio of experiential, spatial, exhibit, scenic, retail, or hospitality design, including examples that were physically built.
  • Experience owning projects from initial concept through design development and fabrication collaboration.
  • Excellent understanding of scale, proportion, materials, finishes, lighting, and environmental storytelling.
  • Proficiency in a professional 3D design workflow, such as SketchUp, Rhino, Cinema 4D, Blender, or equivalent, plus presentation and drawing tools.
  • Ability to create both persuasive client visuals and clear design documentation.
  • Practical understanding of fabrication methods, modular construction, durability, assembly, and transport.
  • Awareness of accessibility, guest circulation, outdoor conditions, and site constraints, with the judgment to involve production and engineering specialists when needed.
  • Clear communication, reliable delivery, and comfort working through feedback with a fast-moving team.
  • Experience with mobile activations, vehicle conversions, beauty and fashion pop-ups, customization experiences, or interactive installations is especially relevant.
  • AI visualization tools are welcome as part of your process. You should also be able to translate your concepts into dimensionally coherent designs and editable project files.

Typical Project Deliverables

Depending on the scope, your work may include:

  • Concept directions with a clear creative rationale.
  • Mood boards and material palettes.
  • Scaled activation layouts and guest flow plans.
  • 3D models and renderings of key views and interactions.
  • Dimensioned plans, elevations, and custom element details.
  • Material, finish, lighting, and signage specifications.
  • Organized source files and a coordinated handoff to production. Final engineering and fabrication shop drawings will be coordinated with the appropriate production partners.

What Success Looks Like

Your designs help clients see possibilities they hadn't considered. They feel specific to the brand, function smoothly for guests and staff, and retain their visual impact when built within the agreed budget and timeline.

title: Clinical Application Specialist, Oncology  - Northwest - Blue Earth Diagnostics
description:
About Blue Earth Diagnostics

Blue Earth Diagnostics, a subsidiary of Bracco Imaging, is a global company advancing precision molecular imaging to support timely decisions and better patient outcomes. Founded in 2014, we work closely with clinicians and collaborators, bringing deep expertise to the development and delivery of positron emission tomography (PET) radiopharmaceuticals. Our growing portfolio helps uncover disease sooner and guide treatment choices across multiple disease states, including oncology and cardiology. Backed by a dedicated team, we deliver clear answers when decisions matter most. For more information, please visit: .


-

Job Purpose

The Clinical Application Specialist (CAS) is responsible for the education and training of Company products to existing and prospective customers through clinical presentations, product evaluations, ongoing clinical support, and consultative interactions as may be required to maintain and grow the Blue Earth Diagnostic US market. The ideal candidate fosters relationships with key decision makers and maintains core relationships as defined in this document. The CAS will address the identified needs of key stakeholders by providing relevant and compliant clinical and scientific support to ensure appropriate education regarding radiopharmaceuticals and disease state.

This position will focus on the territory encompassing the West region which includes the following states: WA, OR, ID, MT, WY, CO, UT, AZ, and SD. The ideal candidate for this territory would be located in Phoenix, Denver, or Seattle.

The salary range for this position is $125,000–$150,000 annually.

Main Responsibilities, Activities, Duties and Tasks

  • Conducts comprehensive product evaluations and timely clinical follow-up at target accounts consistent with business plans.

  • Attends first scans and follows up per business requirements to assure customer service expectations are being met.

  • Provides product training and presentations ensuring customers can properly, and effectively optimize product utilization.

  • Initiates and develops contacts with existing and potential customers.

  • Develops and maintains relationships with KOLs, imaging administrators, and site technical staff.

  • Maintains thorough and up-to-date knowledge of imaging techniques, clinical information, and product data within the relevant diagnostic and radiopharmaceutical arena.

  • Develops and implements on-site training programs for appropriate use of BED products for PET customers and prospective customers.

  • Works collaboratively with Area Sales Directors, Strategic Account Managers, and Regional Sales Managers to ensure customers have a positive experience with the company and its products.

  • Collaborates in the creation and implementation of Territory Business Plans aligned with business strategy specific to the assigned region.

  • Attends national congresses and meetings and as requested, provide commercial support in compliance with industry regulations. Gain and share knowledge from educational sessions

  • Contributes to development and implementation plans to increase market share in existing accounts.

  • Contributes to the development and maintenance of accurate account profiles utilizing company tools.

  • Effectively manages time through territory management techniques, systems, and other company resources.

  • Collaborates on effective account targeting to assure successful product conversions.

  • Provides clinical/technical customer and sales support as well as a consultative resource for BED products through:

  • Aligns with BED business marketing and sales strategies, both regionally and nationally.

  • Contributes to the development of sales strategy and tactics within target accounts.

  • Understanding of current health care economics with regard to the BED market.

  • Participates in on-label product demonstrations and discussions.

  • Implements approved educational presentations.

  • Acts as internal (sales) and external (customers/prospects) resource for BED product and modality.

  • Cooperates with marketing to identify and collect case studies that are relevant to approved indications.

  • Networks with prospects, customers, professional societies, OEM representatives and ultrasound industry to promote BED products and offerings at local, regional and national trade shows and conventions.

  • Maintains up-to-date and accurate T&E/sales records by utilizing Concur and the CRM respectively; comply with company policies and procedures.

  • Other duties as determined by business needs

Professional Experience, Knowledge, & Technical Skills

  • A candidate with clinical experience that includes knowledge of nuclear radiography with appropriate imaging or medical credentialing is highly preferred.

  • Industry experience includes a minimum of at least five years in either/or:

  • Clinical Applications experience in nuclear radiography.

  • Nuclear imaging technologist/nursing position with experience in a hospital or nuclear medicine imaging center.

Certificates, Licenses, Registrations

  • Registered nuclear medicine technologist preferred

  • Must be a licensed driver without restrictions and able to drive a car

  • Field Sales Credentialing demands various vaccinations and background check requirements. Candidates have to comply with all credentialing obligations, including a 10-panel drug screen, in order to have access to the medical facilities conducting business with Bracco.

WORK ENVIRONMENT:

  • The position is field based

  • Ability to travel up to 70% (approx. 10-12 overnights per month)

  • Some weekend work is required for sales meetings and industry related events and conventions.

  • The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Why Blue Earth Diagnostics?

We are seeking motivated individuals with drive and determination to succeed in an innovative and respectful team environment. Our employees are empowered to achieve great things and thrive in our exceptionally co-operative culture. As a young and dynamic company experiencing rapid growth, Blue Earth Diagnostics prides itself on providing a clear focus and incentives to achieve our business-critical objectives. We aim to have fun and celebrate each milestone along the way.

If you are seeking a job where you have a clear impact on business success, are working with talented and collaborative colleagues daily, and are doing something great for human healthcare, then this job is for you.

Blue Earth Diagnostics offers a highly competitive salary for high-caliber candidates. We also offer a comprehensive benefits package including a complete healthcare plan, 401k with matching, work/life harmony, and generous paid holidays.

Blue Earth Diagnostics is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without discrimination on grounds of disability, age, race, color, religion, sex, national origin or any other characteristic protected by law.

So that thinking about what to have for lunch doesn't take up your time or your cravings.

Partnering closely with Operations, Engineering, EH&S, and Manufacturing Technology teams, this role provides technical leadership for process safety compliance, capital projects, process optimization, root cause analysis, and manufacturing performance improvements.

title: Timmerman Nieuwbouw
description:
Ben jij een timmerman die zonder veel uitleg precies weet wat er moet gebeuren? Of sta je juist aan het begin van je carrière en wil je het vak graag leren van ervaren collega’s?

Werk jij graag mee aan nieuwbouwprojecten waar je aan het einde van de dag met trots naar kunt kijken? Dan hebben wij een mooie uitdaging voor jou bij Van Wijnen Groningen.

Welkom bij Van Wijnen Groningen

Bij Van Wijnen Groningen ben je onderdeel van een grote familie met 32 vestigingen door heel Nederland. Hier combineer je de kracht van een landelijke organisatie met het warme contact van een lokaal team. Als Timmerman bouw jij bij Van Wijnen elke dag aan iets dat ertoe doet. Samen maken we Nederland een stukje mooier, stap voor stap, steen voor steen. Dát bouwen wij.

Groningen wordt jouw thuisbasis. Onze vestiging is actief in zowel nieuwbouw- als renovatie-, transformatie- en restauratieprojecten in de domeinen wonen, werken, zorgen en recreatie. We werken aan een grote variatie aan projecten vanuit onze vestiging, om zo een steentje bij te dragen aan de mooie leefomgeving van Groningen en omstreken. Zo hebben we bijvoorbeeld in Noord-Groningen meer dan 200 woningen versterkt, met tevreden bewoners als resultaat. En zijn we actief in het verbouwen van scholen en uitvoeren van renovaties voor drie grote woningcorporaties.

Van Wijnen Groningen: nuchter en saamhorigheid. Gewoon samen werken aan mooie projecten, in de provincies Groningen en Drenthe. Samen met elkaar, want samenwerken staan hoog in het vaandel. Bereidwilligheid ligt ontzettend hoog, elkaar willen helpen is niet meer dan normaal. Zoals collega’s zelf aangeven; het voelt aan als een kleine aannemer, plus de conform van een groot bedrijf erachter. Echt onderdeel zijn van het team, plus alle voordelen om jezelf te kunnen blijven ontwikkelen.

Dit bouw jij

Als Timmerman Nieuwbouw werk je dagelijks mee aan uitdagende bouwprojecten in de regio Groningen. Samen met je collega’s zorg je ervoor dat ieder project veilig, kwalitatief en volgens planning wordt uitgevoerd.

Jouw werkzaamheden bestaan onder andere uit:

  • Het uitvoeren van uiteenlopende timmerwerkzaamheden binnen nieuwbouwprojecten;

  • Het lezen en toepassen van bouwtekeningen en werkinstructies;

  • Het uitvoeren van zowel ruwbouw- als afbouwtimmerwerk;

  • Het bewaken van de kwaliteit van het uitgevoerde werk;

  • Het signaleren van knelpunten en meedenken over praktische oplossingen;

  • Het samenwerken met collega’s, onderaannemers en andere bouwpartners;

  • Het werken volgens de geldende veiligheidsvoorschriften;

  • Het bijdragen aan een nette, veilige en goed georganiseerde bouwplaats.

Aan het einde van iedere werkdag weet je: dit is werk dat telt.

Wat jij zoekt in een baan

Natuurlijk wil je niet alleen uitdagend werk, maar ook een werkgever die goed voor zijn mensen zorgt. Daarom kun je rekenen op:

  • Een goed salaris volgens de cao Bouw & Infra;

  • Vakantiegeld en een aantrekkelijke gratificatieregeling;

  • Hoogwaardig draadloos elektrisch gereedschap;

  • Een smartphone van de zaak;

  • Goede werk- en veiligheidsmiddelen;

  • Volop opleidings- en ontwikkelmogelijkheden via het Van Wijnen College;

  • Een prettige werksfeer met betrokken collega’s;

  • Een bijdrage aan je aanvullende zorgverzekering;

  • Werken aan mooie en zichtbare nieuwbouwprojecten in de regio Groningen.

Hier herken jij jezelf in

Jij bent een vakman met passie voor de bouw. Je haalt voldoening uit het leveren van kwaliteit en bent pas tevreden als de opdrachtgever dat ook is. Je denkt vooruit, ziet kansen voor verbetering en neemt verantwoordelijkheid voor je werk. Samenwerken vind je belangrijk, maar je kunt ook prima zelfstandig uit de voeten.

Daarnaast breng je het volgende mee:

  • Ervaring als timmerman binnen de nieuwbouw;

  • Je kunt zelfstandig werken vanaf bouwtekeningen;

  • Een afgeronde timmeropleiding of vergelijkbare praktijkervaring;

  • Oog voor kwaliteit, veiligheid en een nette afwerking;

  • Een proactieve instelling en de motivatie om iedere dag het beste resultaat neer te zetten.

Bouw jij met ons mee? Wil jij werken aan nieuwbouwprojecten in Groningen en onderdeel worden van een team waar vakmanschap, samenwerking en plezier centraal staan? Dan maken wij graag kennis met jou.

Bij Van Wijnen krijg je de ruimte om jezelf verder te ontwikkelen, werk je samen met betrokken collega’s en lever je een zichtbare bijdrage aan projecten waar mensen jarenlang met plezier wonen en werken.

Toe aan een baan waarin jij écht het verschil maakt? Kom bouwen aan de toekomst van Groningen met collega’s die trots zijn op hun vak. Enthousiast? Reageer dan snel via de button hieronder. Wie weet bouwen we binnenkort samen aan iets moois!

title: Rolling Stock Lead
description:
SYSTRA is one of the world's leading engineering and consultancy groups specialising in public transport and sustainable mobility. With over 10,300 employees, SYSTRA's mission is to design safe and sustainable transport solutions to bring people together, develop social inclusion and facilitate access to employment, education and leisure throughout the world.

For 65 years, the Group has been working alongside cities and regions to contribute to their development by creating, improving and modernising their infrastructure and transport systems, throughout the life cycle of their projects. SYSTRA is involved from the earliest stages of design through to the testing, deployment and maintenance phases. The company provides all its services in over 80 countries worldwide and generates 74% of its turnover internationally. With its new services, SYSTRA supports its clients and partners in their digital, ecological and energy transition, in order to invent the mobility of tomorrow.

Context

SYSTRAis looking for an experienced Lead Rolling Stock professional to join our team. The Lead Rolling Stock will lead the team in effectively delivering technical services for the installation, testing, and commissioning of rolling stock and depot equipment systems. This role ensures that project requirements are met within budget and in line with key performance indicators, while providing safe and fit-for-purpose vehicles and infrastructure.

Reporting to the Systems Manager, the Lead Rolling Stock will be responsible for developing and reviewing engineering, quality, and operational standards, as well as specifications, procedures, and instructions for electronic rolling stock systems and related equipment. These will be designed to ensure fitness for purpose and to support the safe, reliable, and cost-effective management of all assets.

Missions/Main Duties

  • Oversee all rail systems, rail infrastructure and rolling stock testing & commissioning activities and monitor sub-contractors' testing, commissioning and handover work

  • Review and comment on all testing & commissioning programs, procedures, reports, etc. in due consideration of operation and maintenance requirements

  • Monitor all testing activities (Type Testing, Performance Testing, Routine Testing, Dynamic Testing and Final Testing) and identify issues and opportunities for improvements

  • Ensure accuracy of the work produced by the designers, design & build contractors, etc. in terms of system integration, test and commissioning

  • Review system integration management activities so that the system can be properly integrated in terms of equipment, data, etc.

  • Coordinate and monitor rolling stock related interfaces and integration with other disciplines (Platform Screen Doors, Signaling, SCADA and Power Supply).

  • Monitor (maintainer manages the process) and ensure the implementation of the preventive and corrective maintenance of the rolling stock and related features.

  • Liaise with other disciplines and contractors to ensure proper integration and configuration of the system for all aspects of the project;

  • Liaise with System Interface Managers of the contractors to plan and schedule integration tests and documentation and submission of result reports; and

  • Identify, initiate, and implement corrective actions and process improvement methodologies in line with cost reduction and lean organization.

Profile/Skills

  • University degree in Electrical, Mechanical, or Industrial Engineering (Bachelor of Sciences minimum) or Business engineering (Bachelor of Sciences or equivalent minimum).

  • Minimum of 15 years’ experience in metro system testing and commissioning with solid understanding of Systems Engineering Life Cycle.

  • Knowledge of fundamental of rail engineering disciplines and systems.

  • Possess strong commitment to the organization mission and is highly motivated to combine energy and expertise with other colleagues to achieve a common objective.

  • Ability to deploy available processes, tools and time management methodologies that increase efficiency and productivity to fulfil objectives.

  • Exceptional communication skills, fluent in report writing and group facilitation; presentation skills, and fluency in English spoken and written. Knowledge of Arabic language preferred.

  • Analytical thinking, problem solving, business innovation, and customer service orientation.

  • GCC Experience

Systra is an equal opportunities company; this position is open to all applicants.

On-site

title: Senior Director, Public Policy
description:
Enterprise is a national nonprofit that exists to make a good home possible for the millions of families without one. We support community development organizations on the ground, aggregate and invest capital for impact, advance housing policy at every level of government, and build and manage communities ourselves. Since 1982, we have invested $92.0 billion and created 1.1 million homes across all 50 states, the District of Columbia, Puerto Rico and the U.S. Virgin Islands – all to make home and community places of pride, power and belonging.

Join us at enterprisecommunity.org

Working at Enterprise

At Enterprise, you’ll be part of a diverse, committed team making a difference every day. You will collaborate with some of the smartest minds and biggest hearts in our field. You’ll be empowered to drive systems change and take bold steps to advance racial equity. And you will find a career home where you’re valued and supported in your growth journey.

Enterprise offers career opportunities in our offices across the country with an exceptional benefits package.

Job Description Summary

The Senior Director of Public Policy is a leader on Enterprise’s best-in-class federal policy team. The Senior Director will be responsible for setting the advocacy strategy around tax policy specific to affordable housing and community development and then managing execution and driving outcomes.

Job Description


Responsibilities:

  • Develop and execute Enterprise’s federal tax policy and advocacy agenda, spearheading a portfolio that includes but is not limited to:

  • LIHTC

  • New Markets Tax Credits

  • Opportunity Zones

  • Neighborhood Homes Tax Credit

  • Additional Treasury Department programs such as the CDFI Fund and Capital Magnet Fund

  • Housing Finance Reform and advocacy around the Community Reinvestment Act, GSEs, and FHFA

  • Lobby on statutory and regulatory policy priorities with Congress and the Executive Branch.

  • Build and maintain strong, ongoing relationships with key Congressional staff, the Administration, and relevant federal agencies.

  • Serve in leadership and management positions and otherwise represent Enterprise within key coalitions to advance our federal tax policy priorities. Co-chair the ACTION Campaign on behalf of Enterprise.

  • Monitor and analyze federal legislation, regulations, and new proposals that impact Enterprise’s public policy, programmatic, and financial products.

  • Serve as a subject matter expert on the federal policy landscape; inform federal, state, and local policy efforts and partner and serve as a resource to other Enterprise divisions and external partners.

  • Work with Enterprise’s External Affairs team on internal and external communications and research content, utilizing social media, press releases, op-eds, and other earned media to advance advocacy efforts.


Qualifications:

  • Eight (8) years of relevant experience; graduate degree may be substituted for up to two (2) years of experience.

  • Federal government relations and policy development experience required; experience working in Congress or the executive branch preferred.

  • Deep understanding and expertise on a range of housing and community development policies, in particular LIHTC, NMTC, and OZs.

  • Leadership, strategy, and management skills; previous experience managing staff required.

  • Relationships with policymakers in the legislative and executive branch required, preferably with tax writing committees and Treasury Department.

  • Experience working with tax policy stakeholders required.

  • Excellent communication skills, including the ability to effectively communicate complex policy issues to a broad audience. Public speaking, media relations, and public relations experience preferred.

  • Demonstrated professionalism, diplomacy, composure, flexibility, and ability to adapt to change and overcome obstacles.

  • Strong initiative and autonomy.

  • Strong organizational skills and ability to coordinate complex activities, prioritize conflicting demands and meet deadlines.

  • Ability to work independently, solve problems, and take responsibility for moving tasks forward with minimal supervision.

  • Occasional travel and evening/nontraditional hours required.

  • Positive contribution to work culture and effective, collaborative team member.

Salary Transparency

You will be joining a team of talented professionals motivated by serving the community and addressing the need for affordable housing.

Enterprise offers a comprehensive total rewards package for you and your family. The pay range for this position is $130,000-$155,000. The salary range represents the low and high end of what may be paid for this position. It is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the pay range, and compensation decisions may be influenced by a variety of factors, including skills, qualifications, experience, and location.

Total Rewards at Enterprise

This range is just one component of our total rewards package, which also includes annual performance bonuses and generous paid leave programs.

Our benefits form a major part of the total rewards package. These include dental, health, and vision care plans, as well as family-building benefits such as adoption and surrogacy support. Enterprise supports flexible work arrangements to promote work-life balance and offers health advocacy, an Employee Assistance Program (EAP), and mental health benefits. We round out our package with financial education, wellness programs, and auto-enrollment in the company’s 401(k) plan with employer matching contributions.

Finally, you will have access to learning and development opportunities, including tuition reimbursement for job-related courses and certifications. Thank you for your interest in joining the Enterprise team and contributing to our mission to serve others.

Why work for Texas A&M Engineering?

Engineering has been part of Texas A&M University since its opening in 1876 as the Agricultural and Mechanical College of Texas. Today, the College of Engineering is the largest college on the College Station campus with more than 25,000 engineering students enrolled in 15 departments. Its mission is to serve Texas, the nation and the global community by providing engineering graduates who are well-founded in engineering fundamentals, instilled with the highest standards of professional and ethical behavior, and prepared to meet the complex technical challenges of society.

As the research arm of Engineering, the Texas A&M Engineering Experiment Station (TEES) is a state agency within the Texas A&M University System with a mission to improve lives through basic and applied engineering research, workforce development and technology transition. Our collaborations with industry, academia and government provide cutting-edge solutions to global technical challenges.

We are deeply committed to recruiting and retaining a talented workforce that embraces our core values of Respect, Excellence, Leadership, Loyalty, Integrity, and Service, by offering competitive salaries, an array of benefits, an extensive support network, and above all, an enriching and highly collaborative working community that is deeply passionate about our vision for higher education, research, and public service.

Job Description

Purpose:

The Project Manager III (Lead Scheduler) manages and oversees complex scheduling operations, space utilization, and stakeholder coordination for the Texas A&M University Space Institute in Houston. This position serves as the central point of contact for all facility scheduling activities, ensuring efficient, equitable, and strategic use of Institute resources across internal and external stakeholders.

The Lead Scheduler is responsible for managing competing priorities, resolving scheduling conflicts, and coordinating high-demand spaces including the auditorium, Moon and Mars simulation environments, conference rooms, and other shared facilities. This role supervises scheduling staff and supports tenant engagement, facility tours, and external rentals within a dynamic, multi-tenant environment.


Responsibilities:

60% Scheduling Operations

  • Defines scheduling priorities, workflows, and policies to support efficient and equitable use of Institute facilities

  • Manages scheduling portfolios across multiple spaces within the facility, aligning with Institute priorities and operational needs

  • Coordinates and leads scheduling discussions with staff, tenants, faculty, and external partners

  • Oversees booking and utilization of high-demand spaces, including auditorium, Moon/Mars environments, and conference areas

  • Resolves complex scheduling conflicts requiring judgment, prioritization, and negotiation

  • Establishes and enforces scheduling standards, service expectations, and facility usage policies

  • Ensures consistency, accuracy, and reliability of scheduling processes and systems

  • Ensures compliance with university policies and facility usage guidelines

  • Maintains accurate scheduling records, calendars, and documentation

  • Documents procedures and best practices for scheduling operations

20% Stakeholder Coordination

  • Serves as the primary point of contact for tenants and stakeholders regarding scheduling and facility use

  • Facilitates coordination across faculty, staff, tenants, and external partners

  • Coordinates scheduling needs for tours, events, and Institute programs

  • Supports engagement with external organizations seeking to use Institute facilities

  • Communicates scheduling policies, updates, and expectations clearly

20% Leadership

  • Supervises and directs scheduling staff, including one or two schedulers

  • Establishes daily scheduling priorities and delegates work to ensure timely service delivery

  • Serves as the central coordination point for all Institute space scheduling

  • Leads real-time problem solving and deconfliction of competing priorities

  • Coordinates external rentals of the auditorium and other spaces, including scheduling and logistics

  • Supports planning and execution of facility tours, conferences, and events

  • Collaborates with Facility Manager and Assistant Director to align scheduling with operational capacity

  • Continuously improves scheduling workflows, processes, and stakeholder experience

What We Need:

  • Bachelor’s degree in related field. An equivalent combination of education and experience may be considered.

  • Seven years of related experience.

What is Helpful:

  • Experience managing complex scheduling in multi-use or high-demand environments

  • Experience in higher education, research facilities, or multi-tenant operations

  • Supervisory experience

  • Experience working with external clients, partners, or tenants

  • Strong problem-solving and organizational skills

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:

  • Ability to manage multiple competing priorities and resolve conflicts effectively

  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills

  • Ability to collaborate across diverse stakeholder groups

  • Strong organizational, planning, and coordination abilities

  • Ability to exercise sound judgment in complex operational situations

Work Location:

  • Houston, TX.

About The Texas A&M Space Institute:

The Texas A&M University Space Institute will advance commercial, government, military, and academic research and development partnerships in support of national and international space endeavors. With a $200 million investment from the State of Texas, a 400,000 square foot facility is under construction at NASA-Johnson Space Center's Exploration Park. This unique facility, featuring the world's largest indoor climate-controlled landscapes to emulate surface operations on the moon and Mars, is expected to open in the fall of 2026 and will support space system research, testing, training, and workforce development initiatives.

Texas A&M Engineering provides an outstanding benefits package including but not limited to:

  • Competitive medical insurance benefits through Blue Cross and Blue Shield of Texas and Prescription coverage by Express Scripts.
  • Options for Vision, Dental, Life, and Long-Term Disability insurance.
  • A defined benefit retirement plan with the Teacher Retirement System of Texas (TRS) with 8.25% employer contribution.
  • Additional Voluntary Retirement Programs: Tax Deferred Account 403(b) and a Deferred Compensation Program 457(b).
  • Flexible spending account options for medical and childcare expenses
  • Generous paid time off with holidays, vacation and sick leave.
  • Robust free training access through LinkedIn Learning plus professional development opportunities.
  • Tuition assistance and Educational release time to further your academic pursuits.
  • Access to Engineer Your Wellness programs that provide opportunities for employees to engage in health and fitness.
  • Wellness release time offered to employees to promote work/life balance.

Helpful Applicant Information

Required Materials for Application:

  • Resume/CV
  • Three work references with their contact information; at least one reference should be from a supervisor/former supervisor.
  • Letter of interest

Applications received by Texas A&M Engineering must have all required job application data entered.

Compensation Philosophy:

  • Recruit and retain a high-performing workforce through competitive compensation and career development including career pathing, coaching and skills development.
  • Recognize and reward exceptional performance based on individual and team contributions to the growth and success of Texas A&M Engineering.
  • Offer total rewards through flexible benefits, professional development, and work-life balance. Maintain an equitable and transparent process for compensation decisions.

Adolescents

Adults

Geriatric

Challenged/Disabled

Performs CPR as needed.

title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
Job Description

Kleinanzeigen reaches 36M+ monthly users and is Germany’s leading online classifieds market. We are a sustainability-focused platform where you won't just write code; you will power the services that bridge our high-traffic backend with seamless user experiences.

Joining the Edge team means working on the bedrock of Kleinanzeigen, dealing with high-throughput, low-latency and highly-efficient services that require a 'you build it, you run it' mindset, offering you deep exposure to modern infrastructure and platform architecture.

Job Requirements

What You’ll Own

As a Backend-Heavy Full Stack Engineer, you’ll be a central driver for the services that power user privacy and media delivery at scale. You will own the full development lifecycle: from design and implementation to deployment and maintenance. Your impact will include:

  • Core Systems Architecture: Designing and scaling critical microservices using mostly Java and Spring Boot that support 36M+ monthly users.
  • Full Lifecycle Responsibility: Applying "build it, run it" mentality—you aren't just writing code; you’re ensuring robustness, scalability, and observability in production.
  • End-to-End Delivery: Crafting seamless user experiences by integrating our robust backend APIs with high-quality, maintainable frontends in TypeScript and React.
  • Strategic Engineering: Driving improvements in our development practices, testing standards, and CI/CD pipelines to keep our team velocity high and our systems healthy. For frontend components, you will maintain high standards using tools like Vitest and Playwright.

Our Tech Toolbox

We believe in picking the right tool for the job. Our core environment is built on modern technologies, including:

  • Backend: Java, Spring Boot, Golang, python
  • Frontend: NextJs, React, TypeScript
  • Infrastructure & Messaging: AWS, Kafka, CloudFormation, Kubernetes

We value technology-agnostic engineers who are comfortable navigating this stack and are open to learning new technologies as our systems evolve.

How We Work

  • Autonomy: We operate in a highly autonomous, cross-functional environment where teams own their services end-to-end.
  • Methodology: We follow Agile methodologies with a focus on code quality, pair programming, and CI/CD best practices.
  • Balance: We work in a hybrid configuration that values flexibility, deep focus time, and collaborative problem-solving.

Job Responsibilities

Who You Are

  • Architectural Mindset: You have proven experience building systems at scale (load balancing, service discovery, dynamic routing, circuit breakers). You understand not just how to build features, but how they perform under load.
  • Owner’s Mentality: You seek out challenges, take the lead on troubleshooting complex production issues, and are proactive in proposing long-term technical solutions.
  • Technical Mentor: You elevate the engineers around you through thoughtful code reviews, collaborative pair programming, and a commitment to sharing best practices.
  • Effective Communicator: You can navigate trade-offs between speed and technical debt and explain your decisions clearly to the wider team.
  • Tech Stack: You have strong experience in Java/Go, and you are comfortable balancing that deep backend work with frontend execution using React/TypeScript.

Job Benefits

We believe that doing great work requires an environment that supports your professional and personal well-being. Here is what you can look forward to:

  • Competitive compensation package
  • A unique position in an international and dynamic environment
  • Opportunity to shape the way we work. Your feedback and opinions are valued at all levels of the organization
  • The chance to be a key player in a growing, highly skilled team
  • Great colleagues and a healthy working environment
  • Benefits like private health insurance.
  • Career development, including individual training budget.
  • Flexible benefits program (transport, restaurants, child-care, etc)
  • 28 days of holidays

title: Timmerman Renovatie en Verduurzaming
description:
Ben jij een timmerman die zonder veel uitleg precies weet wat er moet gebeuren? Of sta je juist aan het begin van je carrière en wil je het vak graag leren van ervaren collega’s?

Werk jij graag aan projecten waarbij je bestaande woningen en gebouwen een nieuw leven geeft? Vind je het leuk om niet alleen met je handen te werken, maar ook contact te hebben met bewoners? Dan hebben wij een mooie uitdaging voor jou bij Van Wijnen Groningen.

Welkom bij Van Wijnen Groningen

Bij Van Wijnen Groningen ben je onderdeel van een grote familie met 32 vestigingen door heel Nederland. Hier combineer je de kracht van een landelijke organisatie met het warme contact van een lokaal team. Als Timmerman bouw jij bij Van Wijnen elke dag aan iets dat ertoe doet. Samen maken we Nederland een stukje mooier, stap voor stap, steen voor steen. Dát bouwen wij.

Groningen wordt jouw thuisbasis. Onze vestiging is actief in zowel nieuwbouw- als renovatie-, transformatie- en restauratieprojecten in de domeinen wonen, werken, zorgen en recreatie. We werken aan een grote variatie aan projecten vanuit onze vestiging, om zo een steentje bij te dragen aan de mooie leefomgeving van Groningen en omstreken. Zo hebben we bijvoorbeeld in Noord-Groningen meer dan 200 woningen versterkt, met tevreden bewoners als resultaat. En zijn we actief in het verbouwen van scholen en uitvoeren van renovaties voor drie grote woningcorporaties.

Van Wijnen Groningen: nuchter en saamhorigheid. Gewoon samen werken aan mooie projecten, in de provincies Groningen en Drenthe. Samen met elkaar, want samenwerken staan hoog in het vaandel. Bereidwilligheid ligt ontzettend hoog, elkaar willen helpen is niet meer dan normaal. Zoals collega’s zelf aangeven; het voelt aan als een kleine aannemer, plus de conform van een groot bedrijf erachter. Echt onderdeel zijn van het team, plus alle voordelen om jezelf te kunnen blijven ontwikkelen.

Dit bouw jij

Als Timmerman Renovatie & Verduurzaming werk je aan uiteenlopende renovatie- en verbeterprojecten. Geen dag is hetzelfde. De ene keer werk je aan het vernieuwen van een woning, de andere keer draag je bij aan een grootschalig renovatieproject.

Je bent verantwoordelijk voor de uitvoering van de werkzaamheden op locatie en zorgt ervoor dat het werk veilig, netjes en volgens planning wordt uitgevoerd.

Jouw werkzaamheden bestaan onder andere uit:

  • Het uitvoeren van diverse timmerwerkzaamheden binnen renovatie- en verduurzamingsprojecten;

  • Het lezen en toepassen van bouwtekeningen en werkinstructies;

  • Het vervangen, herstellen en verbeteren van bestaande bouwkundige onderdelen;

  • Het bewaken van de kwaliteit van het uitgevoerde werk;

  • Het signaleren van knelpunten en meedenken over praktische oplossingen;

  • Het onderhouden van contact met bewoners tijdens de werkzaamheden;

  • Het samenwerken met collega's, onderaannemers en andere bouwpartners;

  • Het werken volgens de geldende veiligheidsvoorschriften;

  • Het bijdragen aan een nette, veilige en goed georganiseerde werkplek.

Werken in renovatie betekent ook werken in een omgeving waar mensen wonen. Daarom ben jij niet alleen een vakman, maar ook een prettig aanspreekpunt voor bewoners. Je begrijpt hoe belangrijk goede communicatie en respect voor de leefomgeving zijn.

Aan het einde van iedere werkdag weet je: dit is werk dat telt.

Wat jij zoekt in een baan

Binnen team Renovatie & Verduurzaming Groningen werk je samen aan uiteenlopende projecten in de regio. Je collega's bestaan uit timmermannen, uitvoerders, projectleiders, werkvoorbereiders en stagiaires. Veel van hen zijn regelmatig op de projecten aanwezig, waardoor de samenwerking prettig en laagdrempelig is. De sfeer binnen het team is open en collegiaal. We helpen elkaar waar nodig, delen kennis en vieren successen samen.

Natuurlijk wil je niet alleen uitdagend werk, maar ook een werkgever die goed voor zijn mensen zorgt. Daarom kun je rekenen op:

  • Een goed salaris volgens de cao Bouw & Infra;

  • Veel vrije dagen conform de bouw-cao;

  • Vakantiegeld en een aantrekkelijke gratificatieregeling;

  • Een uitstekend pensioen;

  • Hoogwaardig elektrisch gereedschap;

  • Een smartphone van de zaak;

  • Goede werk- en veiligheidsmiddelen;

  • Een gezonde balans tussen werk en privé;

  • Een bijdrage aan je aanvullende zorgverzekering;

  • Volop opleidings- en doorgroeimogelijkheden via het Van Wijnen College;

  • Fijne collega's en een hecht team;

  • De voordelen van een landelijke organisatie met het gevoel van een familiebedrijf.

Hier herken jij jezelf in

Jij bent een vakman met passie voor renovatie. Je levert graag kwaliteit, denkt vooruit en begrijpt dat jouw werkzaamheden plaatsvinden in de leefomgeving van bewoners. Je bent communicatief sterk, klantgericht en weet hoe belangrijk het is om afspraken na te komen.

Daarnaast breng je het volgende mee:

  • Ervaring als timmerman binnen renovatie, onderhoud of woningverbetering;

  • Je kunt zelfstandig werken vanaf bouwtekeningen;

  • Een afgeronde timmeropleiding of vergelijkbare praktijkervaring;

  • Oog voor kwaliteit, veiligheid en een nette afwerking;

  • Je begrijpt dat bewoners centraal staan tijdens de uitvoering van het werk;

  • Technisch inzicht en verantwoordelijkheidsgevoel;

  • Een proactieve instelling en de motivatie om iedere dag het beste resultaat neer te zetten;

  • Je werkt graag samen, maar kunt ook uitstekend zelfstandig aan de slag.

Bouw jij met ons mee?

Wil jij werken aan projecten waarmee woningen en gebouwen weer jaren vooruit kunnen? Wil jij onderdeel zijn van een team waar vakmanschap, samenwerking en trots op het werk centraal staan? Dan maken wij graag kennis met jou.

Bij Van Wijnen krijg je de ruimte om jezelf verder te ontwikkelen, werk je samen met betrokken collega's en lever je een zichtbare bijdrage aan projecten die een directe impact hebben op bewoners en de leefomgeving van Groningen.

Toe aan een baan waarin jij écht het verschil maakt? Kom bouwen aan de toekomst van Groningen met collega's die trots zijn op hun vak. Enthousiast? Reageer dan snel via de button hieronder. Wie weet bouwen we binnenkort samen aan iets moois!

title: Senior Embedded Software Engineer - ADAS Radar
description:

You'll have the opportunity to work on cutting-edge applications, develop breakthrough technologies, and deliver innovative solutions to some of the world’s leading automotive brands. See your work come to life on the road, helping make mobility safer, greener, and more connected. Ready to shape the future of mobility with us?

As a Software Engineer (Embedded Radar), you will work on next-generation RADAR products and embedded software solutions that enable advanced vehicle safety and autonomous driving features. You will collaborate with global engineering teams to develop, integrate, test, and optimize software that powers the future of mobility.

· Perform algorithm and feature integration in an embedded environment.
· Handle all phases of the software development lifecycle, including requirements analysis, design, coding, unit testing, and software integration testing.
· Execute unit and functional testing activities to ensure software quality and reliability.
· Debug and resolve internally and customer-reported issues using industry-standard development and debugging tools.

· Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electrical, Electronics, Instrumentation Engineering, or a related field.
· 6 to 10 years of experience in Embedded Software Development within the automotive domain.
· Strong expertise in Embedded Software, AUTOSAR, Multicore OS, and C/C++ development.
· Hands-on experience with VxWorks, Linux/QNX architecture, Ethernet, and automotive processors such as S32, Aurix, or TDA4.
· Working knowledge of ASPICE, Agile methodologies, and tools such as VectorCAST, Polarion, Jira, EA, and configuration management tools.
· Exposure to Functional Safety, Cyber Security, or ADAS technologies is an added advantage.

· You can have an impact. Safety is a core Aptiv value; we want a safer world for us and our children, one with: Zero fatalities, Zero injuries, Zero accidents.

· You have support. We ensure you have the resources and support you need to take care of your family and your physical and mental health with a competitive health insurance package.


YOUR BENEFITS AT APTIV


· Higher Education Opportunities (UDACITY, UDEMY, COURSERA are available for your continuous growth and development)

· Life and accident insurance

· Sodexo cards for food and beverages

title: Data Engineer
description:
Our Mission: Why Lighthouse?

At Lighthouse, we're on a mission to revolutionize commercial strategy as hospitality's most powerful AI platform. We take the world's largest hotel data network and transform it into real-time intelligence that drives action. We don't just deliver insights; we empower businesses to make decisions that move revenue.

With $370M in Series C funding and over $100M in ARR, we are scaling at lightspeed. Our 850+ teammates across 35 countries aren't just building software—they are leveraging cutting-edge AI to help hoteliers be the first to act. Tens of thousands of hotels across 185 countries trust Lighthouse to execute their commercial strategy, including every one of the top 15 global chains and thousands of independent hotels that consistently outperform their markets. With Lighthouse AI, the intelligence gets deeper. Decisions get smarter. Actions get faster. We help hoteliers be first to act.

We Lumineers. Our shared values keep us on a collaborative path fostering a cultural and customer centric environment

  • Pursuit of greatness: We're innovators who care deeply about our customers' success. Our team brings their best work, stays curious, and delivers excellence through attention to detail
  • Meaningful work matters: We make every moment count by knowing what to deliver, why it matters, and how it drives Lighthouse forward
  • Elevate each other: We don't just work together - we grow together. What unites us is understanding each other as people and working toward shared goals

We're more than just a workplace – we're a community. Collaborative, fun, and deeply committed, we work hard together to revolutionize the hospitality sector. Are you ready to join us and shine brighter in the industry's most exciting rocket-ship?

Job details

  • Engineering Team
  • Belgium - Ghent
  • Full-Time/Hybrid

As a Data Engineer in our new Accommodation Facts team, you will play a key role in shaping the quality and business value of our hotel and short term rental property data in close collaboration with our data scientists. You will be hands‑on in designing, building, and maintaining the data pipelines that serve ML models and other parts of the business. You will act as a bridge between our data and the business, collaborating with stakeholders and ensuring our data effectively enables its consumers.

Where you will have impact

  • Become the expert for our hotel and short term rental property data, understanding the full data lifecycle, quality, and business applications.
  • Design, implement, and maintain the streaming and batch data pipelines that power our products and internal analytics.
  • Collaborate directly with data consumers to understand their needs, gather requirements, and deliver data solutions.
  • Deliver improvements in data quality, latency, and reliability.
  • Show a product engineering mindset, focusing on delivering value and solving business problems through data.
  • You will be at the forefront of our AI evolution, helping to embed intelligence into our platform. You'll not only build AI features for our customers but also champion an AI-first development culture within the engineering team.

About our team

The Accommodation Facts Team owns the single source of truth for hotel and short term rental property data at Lighthouse, sitting at the foundational layer of our data ecosystem.

Our core mission is to model and deliver high-quality, foundational data products that are essential ingredients for all downstream product features, machine learning models, and data science initiatives across the company:

  • Data Modeling & Ownership: Defining and optimizing core hotel and short term rental data entities for product, analytics and commercial teams.
  • Pipeline Engineering: Building robust ETL/ELT pipelines to transform raw integrated data into trusted domains.
  • Data Quality: Establishing standards and monitoring the health of our foundational property data assets.

We are a core part of the Lighthouse platform. We take raw data from many sources, turn it into usable data products, and provide that clean output to serve Engineering and Commercial teams. We rely on internal platform teams for infrastructure support and tooling.

What's in it for you?

  • Flexible time off: Autonomy to manage your work-life balance.
  • Alan Flex benefits: 160€/month for food or nursery.
  • Flexible retribution: Optional benefits through tax-free payroll deductions for food, transportation and/or nursery.
  • Wellbeing support: Subsidized ClassPass subscription.
  • Comprehensive health insurance: 100% Alan coverage for you, your spouse, and dependents.
  • Impactful work: Shape products relied on by 85,000+ users worldwide.
  • Referral bonuses: Earn rewards for bringing in new talent.

Who you are

  • Experience in a data engineering role, with a proven track record of building scalable data pipelines.
  • A product engineering mindset, with a focus on understanding business context and stakeholder needs.
  • Professional proficiency in Python for data processing and pipeline development.
  • Strong knowledge of cloud database solutions such as BigQuery, Snowflake, or Databricks.
  • Hands‑on experience with dbt or a similar data transformation framework.
  • You are a forward‑thinking builder who views AI as a core component of modern architecture. You have a proven interest (or experience) in working with LLMs, agentic workflows, or AI‑assisted coding tools to ship higher‑quality code, faster.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

We welcome

  • Experience with microservice architectures and data streaming systems like Kafka or Google Cloud Pub/Sub.
  • Familiarity with data governance or data quality tools such as Atlan or Soda.
  • Experience with entity resolution, fuzzy matching, or data deduplication.
  • Experience mentoring other engineers.

Technologies you will work with

Mostly, but not limited to: GCP, Python, BigQuery, Kubernetes, Airflow, dbt, Terraform, Atlan (data governance tool), Soda.

Diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging

Thank you for considering a career with Lighthouse. We are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace that values equal opportunity for all. We welcome candidates from all backgrounds, regardless of age, gender, race, religion, sexual orientation, and disability. Our commitment to equality is part of our culture. If you require reasonable accommodation at any point during the application or interview process, please notify your recruiter.

Not ticking every box? No problem! We value diverse backgrounds and unique skill sets, and we encourage individuals from all walks of life to apply. If your experience looks a little different from what we've described, but you're passionate about what we do and are a quick learner, we'd love to hear from you!

title: Senior Full Stack Engineer (m/f/d)
description:
About Cakewalk

Cakewalk is access management for the entire workforce: AI agents and human identities. We built a single platform to govern and secure access in companies through policy-first access management, runtime provisioning, and identity-linked lifecycles.

We are looking for a Senior Full-Stack Engineer (m/f/d) to join our ambitious engineering team and help accelerate our product development.

You will join a team of 10 engineers as a senior individual contributor, reporting to an Engineering Manager. This role is for someone who combines technical strength, grit, and self-reflection, and who is excited to take meaningful ownership in a fast-moving environment.

About the Role

As a Senior Full-Stack Engineer, you will build and improve customer-facing functionality across our frontend and backend. You will own features from early product discussions through implementation, testing, release, and ongoing maintenance.

You will collaborate closely with Product and Customer Success to understand customer needs and turn them into reliable, maintainable solutions. You will also help us improve and expand our AI-augmented engineering workflows while remaining fully accountable for the quality, security, and architecture of the resulting code.

The approximate focus of the role is:

  • 45% backend engineering
  • 25% frontend engineering
  • 20% AI tooling and agentic engineering workflows
  • 10% infrastructure and platform engineering

What You’ll Do

Build and own product functionality

  • Design, build, test, and release new frontend and backend features.
  • Take end-to-end ownership of your work, including technical design, implementation, testing, documentation, deployment, and maintenance.
  • Make sound architectural decisions around design patterns, reusable components, APIs, data models, and system boundaries.
  • Help expand a product that governs access for both human users and AI agents.

Contribute to product development

  • Collaborate with Product during the early stages of feature design.
  • Provide both technical and functional input on proposed solutions.
  • Work closely with Customer Success to understand customer needs and implementation challenges.
  • Translate customer and product requirements into reliable technical solutions.

Advance AI-augmented engineering

  • Use AI-assisted development tools such as Claude Code, Cursor, or comparable IDE-integrated agents to build, test, document, and review software.
  • Work with our existing agentic engineering workflows and help improve and expand them.
  • Create and maintain reusable agent skills, contextual instructions, and related patterns that accelerate development and promote architectural consistency.
  • Standardize the context provided to coding agents through approaches such as AGENTS.md, skills, and similar mechanisms.
  • Maintain strict human-in-the-loop accountability for code quality, security, and architectural decisions.
  • Act as the final reviewer of AI-generated output and ensure that it meets our engineering standards.

Maintain a high quality bar

  • Write clean, reliable, secure, and maintainable code.
  • Apply effective testing practices.
  • Review code critically, regardless of whether it was written by a human or generated with AI assistance.
  • Treat bugs as an immediate priority. We do not knowingly leave defects in the platform: when we identify a bug, we fix it.
  • Contribute to technical documentation and Architecture Decision Records.
  • Communicate technical decisions and trade-offs clearly across engineering and non-engineering teams.

What We Expect

You should have:

  • At least four years of professional experience as a Full-Stack Engineer.
  • Strong professional experience building backend services and single-page web applications.
  • Strong experience with TypeScript, React, C# and .NET Core or closely comparable frontend technologies.
  • Practical experience using AI-assisted coding tools such as Claude Code, Cursor, or comparable development agents.
  • Experience managing or contributing to agentic development workflows.
  • A strong understanding of domain-driven design and experience applying it to production systems.
  • Strong experience designing and consuming REST APIs.
  • A good understanding of HTTP, OAuth, OpenID Connect, encryption, and API security.
  • Experience making data-informed technical decisions and clearly explaining the reasoning and trade-offs behind them.
  • Experience writing technical documentation, including Architecture Decision Records.
  • Experience implementing integration testing strategies.
  • Experience working with component libraries or design systems such as Material UI, styled-components, or comparable technologies.
  • An understanding of LLM capabilities and limitations, together with the analytical skills needed to verify and refine AI-generated solutions.
  • Fluent English and the ability to communicate comfortably with both technical and non-technical colleagues.
  • Availability during our core collaboration hours of 10:30 a.m.-5:00 p.m. CET.

A bachelor’s degree in software engineering, computer science, or a related subject is an advantage, but not a strict requirement.

Prior experience in Identity and Access Management or cybersecurity is not required. However, we expect the security awareness and foundational understanding appropriate for a senior software engineer.

Our Technology

Our current technology stack includes:

Frontend

  • TypeScript
  • React
  • Material UI
  • TanStack Query

Backend

  • C#
  • .NET Core
  • PostgreSQL
  • Redis
  • RabbitMQ

Platform and observability

  • AWS
  • Kubernetes
  • Grafana
  • Sentry

Our system is organized around modular monoliths and domain-driven design. We value engineers who understand architectural trade-offs and can help the system evolve as the product and organization grow.

What Success Looks Like

In your first three months

You will:

  • Develop a solid understanding of our codebase and engineering practices.
  • Build a strong foundational understanding of the Identity and Access Management domain.
  • Release your first backend feature.
  • Release your first frontend feature.
  • Begin contributing effectively to product and technical discussions.

After 6-12 months

You will:

  • Operate autonomously as a senior individual contributor.
  • Collaborate directly with Product to understand customer needs.
  • Turn those needs into well-designed, reliable, and maintainable software.
  • Own features throughout their complete lifecycle.
  • Contribute meaningfully to the evolution of our architecture and engineering practices.
  • Improve and expand our AI-assisted and agentic development workflows.

Some of the challenges you may work on include integrations with different products, protocols, AI agents, Model Context Protocol servers, and other emerging technologies.

Our Principles

Put Simplicity First

Our reason for existing is to simplify IAM. We make our product intuitive and powerful, our customer interactions valuable, and our internal processes efficient. We support our coworkers to ensure our collective success.

Think Big. Iterate Fast. Reflect Openly.

We focus on what is possible, prioritize outcomes over busy activity, and work in short cycles. We value deep thinking, radical transparency, and root-cause analysis over blame.

Everyone Sells Cakewalk

We are a product-driven organization, but our North Star is commercial success. Everything we do is ultimately for our customers.

Enjoy the Baking

Building a company is a challenge. We are here to win, but also to enjoy the ride. We foster an environment of growth and collaboration with fantastic humans.

What You Can Expect

  • An environment where strong reasoning and execution matter more than titles.
  • A technically pragmatic team that challenges the status quo in security and cares deeply about both product and sales.
  • Colleagues who combine brilliance in their fields with grit and self-reflection.
  • Teammates who support one another so that everyone can contribute their best work.
  • Direct collaboration with Product and Customer Success throughout the development process.
  • Founders who take a genuine interest in their people, build long-term relationships, and support every Cakewalker’s professional and personal growth.

Interviewing at Cakewalk

During the interview process, we want to understand:

  • Whether you can drive meaningful technical impact.
  • How you approach challenging engineering problems.
  • How you make and communicate technical decisions.
  • Whether our culture and working style align with the environment in which you do your best work.
  • How you can grow professionally and personally at Cakewalk.
  • How AI has affected your engineering workflow and judgment.

We openly use AI in our engineering work, but we place a high value on genuine human interaction. Please do not use AI tools during live interview conversations. It is always better to acknowledge that you do not know something than to rely on AI for an immediate answer.

Be prepared to discuss engineering principles, design patterns, clean architecture, domain-driven design, testing strategies, API design, and API security. We will be interested in your decision-making process, how you solve problems, and how you write and review code.

When sharing examples from your experience, we recommend using the CARR model:

  • Context: What was the situation or problem?
  • Action: What did you do?
  • Results: What was the outcome?
  • Reflection: What did you learn, and how did you grow?

Humility drives learning. During the process, you may receive direct feedback. We value candidates who listen carefully, reflect openly, and apply what they learn.

Before interviewing, we encourage you to learn about Cakewalk, our product, and the Identity and Access Management industry. Think about what distinguishes our approach and how your experience could help us build the governance layer for a workforce made up of both humans and AI agents.

A Final Note

We welcome candidates with different backgrounds and experiences. Studies have shown that people from underrepresented groups are less likely to apply unless they meet every listed qualification.

We are using these programs every day to handle a large amount of data coming from our products worldwide. Your work will influence users of our products as well as internal staffs from other departments. You will work collaboratively with other colleagues to make decisions on technologies and product features.

  • Collect data from various data sources, clean and ingest them into data warehouse

Requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree or higher in Computer Science, Business Analytics, Mathematics, or related disciplines

IT Threat & Vulnerability Mgmt

Day

POSITION SUMMARY
This position is responsible for implementation of information security policies, standards, and procedures on all organizational information systems. This position is also responsible for auditing user access, security logs and user permissions. Duties include developing security processes, participating in security investigations, and maintaining documentation. This position supports and maintains the information security infrastructure, including both applications and networking components. This position performs ticket focused tactical incident support, monitors Security Operation Center (SOC) communications and audits Information Technology (IT) controls.

Performs all functions according to established policies, procedures, regulatory and accreditation requirements, as well as applicable professional standards.

CORE FUNCTIONS
1. Conducts and participates in security reviews, evaluations, and risk assessments, assisting in the development and implementation of appropriate recommendations. Participates in the handling of security incidents, recoveries, breaches, intrusions, and system abuses.

2. Analyzes the company's information security architecture, including hardware and software components, with the objective of standardizing security throughout company’s infrastructure. Maintains Information Security controlled applications/systems, updating and monitoring for compliance.

3. Evaluates and assists in the development of security policies and procedures. Evaluates security risk assessments of new systems and upgrades to determine impact to Information Security/Risk Management and the enterprise.

4. Provides technical expertise and support for security software, including operational aspects of the software. Participates in, and on occasion, leads information security projects, including the development of project scope requirements, budgeting, and project planning.

5. Provides guidance, direction, and oversight for compliance with all federal, state, and local mandated information security laws, rules, and guidelines. Remain current with the latest industry technical information.

6. Performs audits of users’ system access and work areas. Performs audits of endpoint security controls. Mitigates any issues with systems that are not in compliance. Monitors anti-virus/malware systems, DLP, encryption, network logs, and users’ Internet access.

7. Participates in problem resolution and incident support. Investigates security incidents that may negatively impact the company (including hacking attempts, intrusions, virus infections, mishandling of information, and other security threats); provide support during large incidents and investigations; participate in threat hunting activities.

8. Monitors Service Operations Center (SOC) communications from Information Security applications.

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS AND ABILITIES

  • Receptive to learning and mentoring

  • Actively completes routine tasks of moderate complexity and small scope

  • Demonstrates competency in appropriate range of technical skills

  • Good judgement and decision-making ability

  • Effective time management skills

  • Project management and organizational skills

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS

  • Associates degree in Information Security, Computer Information Systems, or another relevant field, or have equivalent education and experience.

  • One (1) year of relevant experience of any combination of IT, Information Security, Compliance, or Risk Management experience.

  • Certification in one of the following areas within in one year of entering the position: Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP), Systems Security Certified Practitioner (SSCP), HealthCare Information Security & Privacy Practitioner (HCISSP), Payment Card Industry - Internal Security Assessor (PCI-ISA), CompTIA Security+, HIPAA Security, Information Security Technology Fundamentals, Internet Security or ITAA Information Security Awareness.

  • Must demonstrate general knowledge of information technology and healthcare.

  • Needs experience in small scale project planning and reporting either individually or in a team.
